column1: You meet Heena, who was worried the sun would damage her skin. You should get a mirror from her sister, Sera, so she can check.
column2: 去和希娜说话。你遇到了担心阳光会晒伤皮肤的希娜。她想照照镜子，于是你需要去找她的妹妹莎丽借一面镜子。希娜拜托你从她妹妹那里拿镜子，所以你一路走到了莎丽那里。

column1: You must be the new traveler. I'll be giving you important information, so listen up. First, if you want to talk to anyone, click that person with your mouse.
column2: 你一定是新来的旅行者。我将向您提供重要信息，所以请听好。首先，如果您想与任何人交谈，请用鼠标单击该人。

column1: The left and right arrows allow you to move. Press Alt to jump. Press a direction key and Alt at the same time to jump left or right.
column2: 左右箭头允许您移动。按Alt键跳跃。同时按下方向键和 Alt 可向左或向右跳跃。

column1: Man, it's scorching hot today! The sun is burning my beautiful skin! Can you get me my mirror from Sera , please? I have to check my skin!
column2: 哥们儿，今天可真热啊！阳光正在灼烧着我美丽的肌肤！你能从 莎丽 那里给我拿镜子吗？我得检查一下我的皮肤！

column1: If you want to keep track of your progress on a quest, open your Quest Window , then press Quest Helper to register it. Quests registered to the Quest Helper will display on your screen while you play.
column2: 如果您想跟踪任务进度，请打开任务窗口，然后按任务助手进行注册。当您玩游戏时，注册到任务助手的任务将显示在您的屏幕上。

column1: Thank you. Sera is on the hill to the east, hanging laundry. The mirror looks like this: Sera's Mirror.
column2: 谢谢你。色拉在东边的山上，正在晾衣服。镜子看起来像这样：色拉之镜。

column1: Don't want to? Fine, come back when you change your mind.
column2: 不想？好吧，等你改变主意就回来。

column1: Haven't met up with Sera yet? She is up on the hill to the east. It shouldn't be hard to find her.
column2: 还没见过莎丽吗？她在东边的山上。找到她应该不难。

column1: Talk quest, no items required or rewarded.
column2: 对话任务，不需要任何物品或奖励。

column1: You got the mirror from Sera, who was doing her laundry. You have to take it to Heena.
column2: 你从正在洗衣服的莎丽那里拿到了镜子。现在要把它交给希娜。你把从莎丽那里借来的镜子带给了希娜。

column1: How am I going to hang all these up? What a hassle. What? You want my mirror? Please don't tell me Heena asked you for this.
column2: 我该如何把这些都挂起来呢？真麻烦啊。什么？你想要我的镜子吗？请不要告诉我希娜向你要这个...

column1: Seriously, she should have come to get it herself. She is sooo lazy. Fine, fine, here's the mirror.
column2: 说实话，她应该自己来拿的。她太懒了。好吧好吧，镜子在这儿。

column1: Oh? Why aren't you accepting the mirror? Do you no longer wish to see Heena ?
column2: 唔嗯？你为什么不收镜子？是不想替希娜完成委托吗？
column4: 同任务代码中文资料（语义对齐 0.48）

column1: Oh wow! You brought Sera's mirror! Thank you so, so much. Let's see... No skin damage whatsoever... Whew! That's a relief.
column2: 啊！莎丽你带姐姐的镜子来了！非常感谢。看看…皮肤有没有被晒黑吧…？ 哦呵~
column4: 同任务代码中文资料（语义对齐 0.51）

column1: If you go right, you will see a shiny aura. We call that a portal. If you press up arrow , you will teleport to the next area. So long!
column2: 如果你向右走，你会看到闪亮的光环。我们称之为门户。如果您按向上箭头，您将传送到下一个区域。这么久！

column1: Did you lose the mirror? Ask my sister for it again, then.
column2: 你丢了镜子吗？那你再问问我姐姐吧。

column1: It looks like you haven't delivered the mirror to Heena yet. Please hurry!
column2: 看来你还没有把镜子交给希娜。请快点！

column1: How am I going to hang all these up? What a hassle. What? You want my mirror? Please don't tell me Heena asked you for this.
column2: 我该如何把这些都挂起来呢？真麻烦啊。什么？你想要我的镜子吗？请不要告诉我希娜向你要这个...

column1: Seriously, she should have come to get it herself. She is sooo lazy. Fine, fine, here's the mirror.
column2: 说实话，她应该自己来拿的。她太懒了。好吧好吧，镜子在这儿。

column1: By pressing the hotkey I, you can consume k in the Use window. Now talk to Roger.
column2: 和罗杰说话。按下快捷键 I 后，可以在消耗栏使用 Unknown(2001000)。现在去和罗杰说话吧。你学会了如何使用道具！以后冒险会方便很多！

column1: Eat the Roger's Apple I gave you by opening your inventory and clicking the Use tab . Double-click the Roger's Apple to recover some HP.
column2: 打开你的物品栏并点击“使用”选项卡，吃掉我给你的罗杰的苹果。双击罗杰的苹果可以恢复一些生命值。

column1: Nina is wondering what to make her brother, Sen, for dinner. Go talk to Sen, who's in the house next to Nina, and ask him what he wants to eat.
column2: 和妮娜说话。妮娜正在烦恼晚饭要给弟弟珊做什么。去妮娜旁边的屋子找珊，问问他想吃什么。你问了妮娜的弟弟珊晚饭想吃什么，他说想喝蘑菇汤。

column1: Oh, a traveler! Nice, right on time... I have a favor to ask. Head towards your right and you'll find a kid there.
column2: 妈呀…这不是旅行者吗！来的正是时候啊。哦…有件事想请你帮忙，可以帮我吗？在这里稍微往东边走，那里就有水世界景观的水族箱。
column4: 同任务代码中文资料（语义对齐 0.44）

column1: That's my little brother, Sen . Will you please ask him what he wants for dinner?
column2: 那是我的弟弟，森。你能问他晚餐想吃什么吗？

column1: Oh, I guess you're very busy. Still, it's not too difficult of a job, so please help if you can.
column2: 哎呀，是不是有什么急事，这不是很难的事情所以可以的话还是帮帮我吧。
column4: 同任务代码中文资料（语义对齐 0.56）

column1: You didn't talk to Sen yet? Please, open your eyes!
column2: 你还没跟森谈过吗？请睁开眼睛！

column1: Talk quest, no items required or rewarded.
column2: 对话任务，不需要任何物品或奖励。

column1: Sen wants Mushroom Soup for dinner. Better tell Nina now.
column2: 珊晚饭想喝蘑菇汤。赶快告诉妮娜吧。你把珊想吃的晚饭告诉了妮娜。

column1: Ahhh, sooo hungry. Where's my sister?! I was gonna ask her to make me mushroom soup. Sooo hungry!
column2: 啊啊啊好饿啊我妹妹在哪儿？！我本来想请她给我做蘑菇汤。好饿啊！

column1: Please tell my sister I really, really want mushroom soup for dinner!
column2: 请告诉我姐姐我晚餐真的非常非常想吃蘑菇汤！

column1: What...? Aren't you gonna deliver it?
He wants mushroom soup? I guess that's our dinner then. Thanks for helping me out.
column2: 他想要蘑菇汤吗？我想这就是我们的晚餐了。谢谢你帮我。

column1: Todd asks you to attack and defeat Tutorial Jr. Sentinels, then talk to Peter.
column2: 听说透德可以教你打猎的方法……透德让你攻击并打倒教学用小石球，然后去找彼得。你按照透德的指示打倒了怪物。

column1: A new traveler, eh? Want to learn how to hunt? The Tutorial Jr. Sentinels you see here are normally too powerful for you to handle, but Grendel the Really Old , the head of all magicians, sealed up their power. So take down three, pick up what they drop, and go see Peter , who should be around here somewhere.
column2: 一个新旅行者，是吗？想学习如何狩猎吗？你在这里看到的教程小哨兵通常都太强大了，你无法应对，但所有魔法师的领袖格伦德尔·老格伦德尔封印了他们的力量。所以拿下三个，捡起他们掉落的东西，然后去见彼得，他应该就在这附近的某个地方。

column1: Look at your mini map ( M ), located at the top left corner of the screen. You should see something green blinking on the northeast side of the map. That's Peter . You'll run into Jr. Sentinels on your way to meet Peter . Defeat them, pick up 3 Jr. Sentinel Shellpieces , then talk to Peter.
column2: 查看位于屏幕左上角的迷你地图（M）。您应该会在地图的东北侧看到一些绿色的东西在闪烁。那是彼得。你会在去见彼得的路上遇到小哨兵。击败他们，捡起 3 个小哨兵贝壳，然后与彼得交谈。

column1: Oh, you know how to hunt already? Well, you can still test your abilities!
column2: 哦，你知道怎么打猎了吗？好吧，你仍然可以测试一下你的能力！

column1: Are you the one Todd is training? He mentioned you... Let's see if you've trained correctly.
column2: 你是托德训练的那个人吗？他提到了你……让我们看看你是否训练正确。

column1: Someday, long after you leave this place, you'll be powerful enough to take on real Jr. Sentinels. Oh, and when you level up, check your Ability Points in your Character Info. To move on to the next map, either press the up arrow key in front of the portal to the right or just talk to me again.
column2: 总有一天，在你离开这个地方很久之后，你就会强大到足以对抗真正的小哨兵。哦，当你升级时，请检查你的角色信息中的能力点。要进入下一张地图，请按右侧门户前面的向上箭头键，或者再次与我交谈。

column1: Huh? You're not carrying 3 Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece . After you've defeated a Tutorial Jr. Sentinel , it'll drop a Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece . Then press Z to pick up the item.
column2: 啊？你没有携带 3 小石球碎片 。当你击败初级哨兵教程后，它会掉落初级哨兵外壳。然后按Z键拾取该物品。

column1: Hmm, you should have seen a small Tutorial Jr. Sentinel at the bottom of the map. Press Ctrl to attack it. Pick up the item it drops once you defeat it, and then come talk to me.
column2: 嗯，你应该在地图底部看到一个小教程 Jr. Sentinel。按 Ctrl 对其进行攻击。打败它后，捡起它掉落的物品，然后来跟我说话。

column1: What? Haven't you gone to Peter yet? You need to defeat 3 Tutorial Jr. Sentinels and take 3 Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece with you!
column2: 什么？你还没去找彼得吗？您需要击败 3 个初级哨兵并带走 3 个初级哨兵外壳！

column1: When you talk to Sam, he tells you to head to the east and hunt 10 Snail before meeting Mai.
column2: 叁有一些给新手冒险家的建议……和叁交谈后，他让你往东走，狩猎 10 只蜗牛，然后去见麦加。按照叁的建议，你打倒了 10 只蜗牛，然后见到了麦加。这个人是高手吗？确实散发着很强大的气场。

column1: Hello, I'm Sam . I'm helping guide the beginner adventurers. You look like someone who should go talk to Mai . What do you think?
column2: 你好，我是萨姆。我正在帮助引导新手冒险者。你看起来应该去和麦谈谈。你怎么认为？

column1: Mai is one of the very best fighters in Maple World. To prepare yourself, I suggest you take down 10 Snails before seeing her.
column2: 麦是枫叶世界中最优秀的战士之一。为了做好准备，我建议你在见到她之前先拿掉 10 只蜗牛。

column1: After defeating 10 Snails , go see Mai , who should be standing on a fork in the road out to the east.
column2: 击败10只蜗牛后，去找麦，麦应该站在东边的岔路口上。

column1: Trust me. You'll want to prepare yourself before meeting Mai.
column2: 相信我。在见到麦之前你需要做好准备……

column1: Are you the one that Sam mentioned? Do you need me for something...?
column2: 你就是山姆提到的那个人吗？你需要我做点什么吗...？

column1: Well, defeating 10 Snails is a piece of cake! Haha!
column2: 嗯，打败 10 只蜗牛是小菜一碟！哈哈！

column1: I will allow you to proceed onto the next training after you increase your abilities.
column2: 等你能力提升之后，我才会允许你进行下一次的训练。

column1: I'm sure I told you to defeat 10 Snails . Check your quest progress in the Quest Log.
column2: 我确信我告诉过你要打败 10 只蜗牛。在任务日志中检查您的任务进度。

column1: Have you not gone to Mai yet? She is the pretty gal at A Split Road . Don't forget to eliminate the Snails before you see her!
column2: 你还没去麦吗？她是岔路 的漂亮女孩。别忘了在见到她之前消灭蜗牛！

column1: Maria needs someone to help her. She wants you to deliver a letter to Lucas inAmherst.
column2: 玛丽亚需要有人帮忙……玛丽亚希望我把信送给阿姆斯特的卢卡斯。我把玛丽亚的信交给了阿姆斯特的卢卡斯。

column1: I'm getting anxious. I need to get this letter to Lucas fast. It's urgent! But I have things to do here, so I can't leave this spot.
column2: 我开始着急了我需要尽快把这封信交给卢卡斯。很紧急！但我这里还有事要做，所以不能离开这里……

column1: Can you take this letter to Lucas in Amherst ? It'll only take a minute.
column2: 你能把这封信带给阿默斯特的卢卡斯吗？只需要一分钟...

column1: Are you going to help me? I'm so relieved... Now I can finally relax. Please take this letter, and make sure to give it to the chief of Amherst.
column2: 你要帮我吗？我松了口气……现在我终于可以放松了。请收下这封信，并务必将其交给阿默斯特的酋长。

column1: Amherst is northeast from here. Lucas is the chief of Amherst . He is probably walking in front of the general store today. Please make sure to bring me Lucas's reply.
column2: 阿默斯特位于这里的东北方。卢卡斯是阿默斯特的酋长。他今天可能正走在杂货店前面。请务必将卢卡斯的回复带给我。

column1: Ahhh, this is not good. If I don't get this to the town chief... Please reconsider!
column2: 啊啊，这可不好。如果我没有把这个告诉镇长……请重新考虑！

column1: It's about time I received a letter from Maria ... I wonder if something happened? Ugh, I wish someone would bring me some news.
column2: 差不多该收到玛丽亚的来信了……不知道是不是发生了什么事情呢？呃，我希望有人能给我带来一些消息……

column1: You haven't met with Lucas in Amherst yet? Please bring him my letter. It's urgent.
column2: 您还没有在阿默斯特见过卢卡斯吗？请把我的信带给他。事情很紧急。

column1: You lost my letter! Be more careful! Good thing I made a copy. This time, be more careful!
column2: 你把我的信弄丢了！要更加小心！还好我复印了一份。这一次，要小心一点！

column1: You delivered Maria's Letter to Lucas who was in Amherst. He wrote her a reply, which you should bring to Maria.
column2: 你把玛丽亚的信送到了阿姆斯特的卢卡斯手中。他写了一封回信，要你带回给玛丽亚。玛丽亚读完卢卡斯的回信后松了一口气。现在你也想看看里面写了什么。真好奇这到底是怎么回事……

column1: Ohhh, the letter from Maria ! I was beginning to worry. Okay, here's the reply letter . Head back to Maria and deliver it. Thanks.
column2: 哦哦，玛丽亚的来信！我开始担心了。好的，这是回信。返回玛丽亚并交付它。谢谢。

column1: Oh... Are you really busy? Sigh. This letter needs to be delivered right away.
column2: 哦……你真的很忙吗？叹。这封信需要立即送达...

column1: Oh, the reply letter! Thank you! I want to give you something to show my appreciation.
column2: 噢，回信！谢谢你！我想送你一些东西以表达我的谢意。

column1: Ta da! A hat! It has a level limitation, but I think you're strong enough to wear it. Thanks again for all your help!
column2: 哒哒！一顶帽子！它有等级限制，但我认为你足够强大可以佩戴它。再次感谢您的所有帮助！

column1: If you don't know how to equip items yet, open the Equip tab in your Inventory. You can freely switch between menus using the Tab key. To equip an item, just double-click on it. To check if it's equipped properly, open the Equipment window.
column2: 如果您还不知道如何装备物品，请打开库存中的“装备”选项卡。您可以使用 Tab 键在菜单之间自由切换。要装备某个物品，只需双击它即可。要检查其是否已正确装备，请打开“装备”窗口。

column1: Have you not gone to the chief yet? Or did you lose the letter? Please deliver the letter soon and bring back Chief Lucas's reply.
column2: 你还没去见首领吗？或者你把信弄丢了？请尽快把信送来，并带回卢卡斯局长的回信。

column1: You didn't deliver my reply to Maria yet? If you lose my reply, just tell me. I suppose I can write up another one.
column2: 你还没给玛丽亚回信吗？如果你失去了我的回复，请告诉我。我想我可以再写一篇。

column1: You lost my reply letter? Bah, such carelessness! I have a town to run, you know. But fine, I'll rewrite the letter. Here, take it, and don't lose it this time.
column2: 我的回信你丢了？呸，真是大意啊！你知道，我有一座城镇要经营。不过好吧，我会重写这封信。给，拿着吧，这次别弄丢了。
随机奖励 - 以下之一：

column1: You're under the tutelage of the famous swordmaster, Mai, in A Split Road. She wants you to hunt Blue Snails, Shrooms, and Red Snails. Ah, Mai also said to meet with Biggs in Southperry to get another quest.
column2: 在岔路口的麦加看起来像是能训练新手的武术专家。你接受了著名剑术大师麦加的指导。她让你狩猎蓝蜗牛、蘑菇仔和红蜗牛。啊，麦加还说要去南港找比格斯接另一个任务。经过麦加的训练后，你感觉自己变强了。

column1: Hmm, you look like you're in serious need of my guidance. Is it your first time here? What you need more than anything right now is FOCUS. So...want me to train you?
column2: 嗯，看来你很需要我的指导。你是第一次来这里吗？现在你最需要的是专注。那么……要我训练你吗？

column1: It's simple actually. All you need to do right now is hunt monsters. I'll assign you a few tasks, and you'll be surprised to see how much you grow.
column2: 其实很简单。你现在需要做的就是猎杀怪物。我会给你分配一些任务，你会惊讶地发现你成长了多少。

column1: Head out of town, and you'll run into lots of monsters. The weakest is the Blue Snail , a tiny blue snail, and it's a piece of cake. Next are the Shrooms and the Red Snails . Listen, hunt weaker monsters until you can handle bigger, stronger, and faster monsters. It's all about hunting the right ones.
column2: 走出城镇，你会遇到很多怪物。最弱的是蓝蜗牛，一种蓝色的小蜗牛，小菜一碟。接下来是蘑菇和红蜗牛。听着，猎杀较弱的怪物，直到你能对付更大、更强、更快的怪物。这一切都是为了寻找合适的人。

column1: Your training task is to defeat 10 Blue Snail , 10 Shroom , and 5 Red Snail and then return. It may seem tough at first, but you'll be able to do it quickly, so don't worry. Just remember to start with the weaker ones and take it slow! Staying calm is the key to hunting!
column2: 你的训练任务是击败10只蓝色蜗牛、10只蘑菇和5只红色蜗牛然后返回。一开始可能看起来很难，但你很快就能做到，所以不用担心。只要记住从较弱的开始，慢慢来！保持冷静是狩猎的关键！

column1: Oh, and press W to see the World Map and locate Southperry . Go there and meet Biggs . He may have something for you. You can accept Biggs's quest while training with me, so I suggest you meet him pronto.
column2: 哦，然后按 W 查看世界地图并找到 南港 。去那里见见比格斯。他可能有东西给你。你可以在和我一起训练的时候接受比格斯的任务，所以我建议你尽快和他见面。

column1: Hmm... So, you don't want to receive training? It's good that you have so much confidence. But if you change your mind, come talk to me again.
column2: 嗯……所以，你不想接受训练了？你有这么大的信心真是太好了。但如果你改变主意，请再跟我谈谈。

column1: Have you been training by preying on the weak? Let me see.
column2: 难道你一直在以弱肉强食来训练吗？让我看看...

column1: I don't think you understood what I told you. You haven't defeated enough monsters. You can check your quest progress in the Quest Log, right?
column2: 我认为你不明白我告诉你的话。你还没有打败足够多的怪物。你可以在任务日志中查看你的任务进度，对吧？

column1: Mai believes that while knowing your abilities is important, defeating stronger monsters is also great training to improve them. They asked you to defeat Orange Mushroom. Orange Mushroom...? It sounds really strong. Do you think you can defeat it?
column2: 麦加的训练虽然只是打倒怪物，但似乎非常适合学习狩猎的方法。继续接受麦加的训练吧。麦加认为，了解自己的能力固然重要，挑战更强的怪物也是提升实力的好训练。她让你打倒绿蘑菇。绿蘑菇……听起来很强。你能打倒它吗？完成麦加的训练后，你感觉自己变得强多了。是时候离开冒险岛了！去南港坐船前往维多利亚岛吧。

column1: Wow, you're fast! That's awesome. We'll head straight to the next quest. It's important to know your limits, but it's also important to test your abilities. Want to try defeating some powerful monsters?
column2: 哇，你真快！太棒了。我们将直接前往下一个任务。了解自己的极限很重要，但测试自己的能力也很重要。想尝试打败一些强大的怪物吗？

column1: This time, you'll be hunting Orange Mushroom , which you WON'T find just casually wandering around. You'll have to go into every portal to find them. I want you to defeat 1 !
column2: 这次，您将狩猎橙色蘑菇，您不会在随意闲逛时找到它。你必须进入每个门户才能找到它们。我要你打败1！

column1: Also, I've heard that Biggs is collecting something from the Orange Mushrooms ... If you haven't filled Biggs's request yet, you might want to try doing so while you train.
column2: 另外，我听说比格斯正在从橙色蘑菇中收集一些东西......如果你还没有满足比格斯的要求，你可能想在训练时尝试这样做。

column1: If it seems too difficult for you, come back after training against easier monsters.
column2: 如果这对您来说太难了，请在对抗更简单的怪物之后再回来。

column1: So you've taken care of the Orange Mushroom ? Weren't they hard to find? Let's see how strong you have become.
column2: 那么你已经照顾好橙色蘑菇了吗？他们不是很难找到吗？让我们看看你变得有多强...

column1: Great job! You're now strong enough to hold your own against any monster here. You'll have to start making job decisions once you reach level 10. If you haven't met Rain from Amherst yet, you should go see her. She'll give you a lot of information with her challenges. If we meet again someday, let's catch up. Goodbye!
column2: 干得好！你现在已经足够强大，可以对抗这里的任何怪物了。一旦你达到10级，你就必须开始做出工作决定。如果你还没有见过来自阿默斯特的瑞恩，你应该去见她。她会给你很多关于她的挑战的信息。如果有一天我们再见面，我们就再聊聊吧。再见！

column1: I don't think you're quite done yet. Press Q to check the quest.
column2: 我认为你还没有完成。按Q检查任务。

column1: You meet Biggs in Southperry. He wants you to get him 1 Orange Mushroom Cap and 10 Blue Snail Shells. He doesn't look too convinced that you can do it, but it sounds like a piece of cake.
column2: 南港的比格斯有事情拜托你。你在南港见到了比格斯。他想让你带来 1 个绿蘑菇盖和 10 个蓝蜗牛壳。他看起来不太相信你能做到，不过听起来很简单。你为南港的比格斯收集到了 1 个绿蘑菇盖和 10 个蓝蜗牛壳。他给你的奖励武器还算不错。

column1: I'll give you something nice if you get me 1 Orange Mushroom Cap and 10 Blue Snail Shells ! Eliminate Orange Mushroom and Blue Snail to get them. But looking at you, I don't know if you're up to the challenge.
column2: 如果你给我 1 个橙色蘑菇帽和 10 个蓝色蜗牛壳，我会给你一些好东西！消除橙色蘑菇和蓝色蜗牛即可获得它们。但看着你，我不知道你是否能接受挑战......

column1: Oh, you sound so confident! Let's put your money where your mouth is. Make sure to bring back 1 Orange Mushroom Cap and 10 Blue Snail Shells . I'll be waiting!
column2: 哦，你听起来很自信！让我们把钱放在嘴边。确保带回 1 个橙色蘑菇帽和 10 个蓝色蜗牛壳。我会等待！

column1: You'll regret not taking the opportunity to get a good item like this one!
column2: 您会后悔没有抓住机会获得这样的好东西！

column1: Wow! You really managed to gather all the stuff I asked for! Here's an item, like I promised.
column2: 哇！你真的设法收集了我想要的所有东西！这是一个项目，就像我承诺的那样。

column1: Wow, I didn't really think you would be able to gather everything. Okay, I'll give you the item, as promised. I don't need it anyhow... Here you go!
column2: 哇，我真的没想到你能收集到所有东西。好的，我会按照承诺把东西给你。无论如何我不需要它......给你！

column1: You don't have 1 Orange Mushroom Cap and 10 Blue Snail Shells yet, right? Don't worry about it. I'll be here for a while.
column2: 您还没有 1 个橙色蘑菇帽和 10 个蓝色蜗牛壳，对吧？别担心。我会在这里呆一段时间。
随机奖励 - 以下之一：

column1: You ran into Pio, who is famous in Amherst for fixing broken goods. He asks you to break down scrap boxes from around town and bring back Rusty Screws and Old Wooden Boards.
column2: 阿姆斯特的皮奥想让你帮忙收集可回收物。你遇到了皮奥，他在阿姆斯特以修理破损物品而出名。他让你打破镇上的废箱子，带回生锈的螺丝和旧木板。你打破箱子并为皮奥收集到了材料。箱子里还能找到其他有用的东西，挺有意思的。

column1: My goodness. I've been wandering around town, and I see so many recyclable items just being thrown away! Say, can you help me collect some of them? Don't worry, I'll reward you well for your effort.
column2: 天哪。我在城里闲逛，看到很多可回收的物品被扔掉了！说吧，你能帮我收集一些吗？别担心，我会好好奖励你的努力的。

column1: That's right! Please collect 'trash' from around town.
column2: 没错！请收集城镇周围的“垃圾”。

column1: I don't know if you saw any abandoned wooden boxes on your way here, but your job is to break those boxes apart into Rusty Screws and Old Wooden Boards . Collect 3 of each for me, okay? Rusty Screw 0 /3 Old Wooden Board 0 /3
column2: 我不知道你来这里的路上是否看到过废弃的木箱，但你的工作就是把这些木箱拆成生锈的螺丝和旧木板。给我各收集3个，好吗？生锈的螺丝 0 /3 旧木板 0 /3

column1: Come on! Think about the planet!
What? You brought them all? Okay, let's see.
column2: 什么？你把它们都带来了？好吧，让我们看看...

column1: See what I'm talking about? So many recyclable items, just carelessly tossed away. Hopefully there are more people like you in the world.
column2: 明白我在说什么吗？这么多可回收的物品，不小心就被扔掉了。希望世界上有更多像你这样的人。

column1: No, no, no! Open Quest Info to check what you need to do!
column2: 不，不，不！打开任务信息来检查您需要做什么！

column1: You're not a beginner anymore. Talk to Rain and take the Maple Quiz!
column2: 你已经不再是新手了。去阿姆斯特找瑞恩参加冒险岛问答吧！瑞恩的第一题是关于如何挂在梯子或绳子上。好！是方向键上，一定要记清楚。

column1: Hello! How're you liking Maple World so far? Let me give you a brief rundown of the place, and then I'll give you a quiz. If you answer my questions correctly, I'll give you something handy. Interested?
column2: 你好！到目前为止，您对冒险岛世界的评价如何？让我向您简要介绍一下这个地方，然后我会给您一个测验。如果你正确回答我的问题，我会给你一些方便的东西。感兴趣的？

column1: Hehe! Let me warn you, don't underestimate my quiz. There's a lot to learn, so pay attention!
column2: 呵呵！让我警告你，不要低估我的测验。有很多东西要学，所以要注意！

column1: How is your adventure on Maple Island so far? You can go left with the left arrow key and right with the right arrow key , right? Do you also know that if you press the down arrow key , you can crouch, and then jump while crouching, to leap down to a lower platform? If you press the up arrow key in front of a portal, you can enter it, and if you press the up arrow key in front of a ladder or rope, you can climb or hang from it.
column2: 到目前为止，你在冒险岛的冒险经历怎么样？您可以使用左箭头键向左移动，使用右箭头键向右移动，对吧？你还知道吗，按下向下键，可以蹲下，然后蹲着跳，跳到较低的平台上？如果你在传送门前按向上箭头键，你可以进入它，如果你在梯子或绳子前面按向上箭头键，你可以攀爬或悬挂在上面。

column1: You can also use the Key Config on the bottom right of your screen to recalibrate the buttons to your liking. Hmm. I think this explanation might have gotten a little too complicated. Don't worry, you'll get the hang of it as you spend more time here and get used to things.
column2: 您还可以使用屏幕右下角的按键配置根据您的喜好重新校准按钮。唔。我认为这个解释可能有点太复杂了。不用担心，随着您在这里度过更多的时间并习惯一切，您就会掌握它的窍门。

column1: But what you haven't experienced yet is Job Advancement. To become a more powerful traveler, you need a job! To get one, you'll first have to leave this place, Maple Island, and head to Victoria Island. You need to be at least at level 10 to become a Warrior, Bowman, Magician or Thief . Each job has its pros and cons, so choose carefully.
column2: 但你还没有经历过工作晋升。要成为更强大的旅行者，您需要一份工作！要想获得它，你首先必须离开冒险岛这个地方，前往维多利亚岛。您需要至少达到 10 级才能成为战士、弓箭手、魔术师或小偷。每个工作都有其优点和缺点，因此请谨慎选择。

column1: I didn't tell you EVERYTHING you need to know for the quiz, so make sure to focus. Ready for the questions?
column2: 我没有告诉您测验所需了解的所有内容，因此请务必集中注意力。准备好回答问题了吗？

column1: Hmm, you could learn a lot through my quiz. I think you should try it!
column2: 嗯，通过我的测验你可以学到很多东西。我想你应该尝试一下！

column1: That's right! If you press the up arrow key in front of a ladder or rope, you can hang from it!
column2: 没错！如果您在梯子或绳子前面按向上箭头键，您就可以挂在上面！
回答瑞恩的第二个问题。瑞恩的第二题是什么呢？问题是关于可装备道具的，道具可以通过双击来穿戴。

column1: All right, talk to me when you're ready for the next question.
column2: 好吧，当你准备好回答下一个问题时就跟我说话。

column1: Yup, you can wear an item just by double-clicking it from your inventory. If you can't wear something, check that your character meets the level and statistic requirements.
column2: 是的，您只需双击库存中的物品即可佩戴它。如果您无法穿戴某些东西，请检查您的角色是否符合等级和统计数据要求。
瑞恩的第三个问题。现在该回答瑞恩的第三题了。在装备栏里，可以查看自己穿着的装备，也可以双击装备把它脱下来。

column1: My questions aren't that hard because I let you keep trying until you get them right. Nice of me, huh? Tell me when you're ready for the 3rd question.
column2: 我的问题并不难，因为我让你不断尝试，直到你答对为止。对我很好吧？当你准备好回答第三个问题时告诉我。

column1: That's right! You can see what equipment your character is wearing in Equipment Inventory.
column2: 没错！您可以在装备清单中查看您的角色所穿着的装备。

column1: You can answer Rain's questions if you think carefully.
column2: 该回答瑞恩的第四个问题了。只要认真想，就能答出瑞恩的问题。瑞恩的第四题是关于恢复 HP 的方法。原来恢复 HP 的办法有这么多！看到椅子或长椅时，记得坐下来休息。

column1: All right! You're on question number 4, out of 7 questions total. Talk to me when you're ready.
column2: 好的！您正在回答第 4 个问题，总共 7 个问题。等你准备好了就跟我说话。

column1: Yes, that's correct! There are so many ways to recover HP, right? Oh, and here's another tip! If you press the sit key on chairs around the map, you can sit and rest. Whenever you find a chair, try sitting on it. You'll recover faster than with just standing!
column2: 是的，没错！恢复生命值的方法有很多吧？哦，还有另一个提示！如果您按下地图周围椅子上的坐下键，您就可以坐下来休息。每当你找到一把椅子时，请尝试坐在上面。你会比站着恢复得更快！
瑞恩的第五个问题。不知道会问什么呢？第五题问的是转职。战士、飞侠、弓箭手和魔法师都需要至少 10 级才能转职。

column1: You're inching closer and closer toward making your job advancement. I wonder which job you're going to pick. Now, talk to me when you're ready for the 5th question.
column2: 你离工作晋升越来越近了。我想知道你会选择哪份工作。现在，当你准备好回答第五个问题时，请跟我说话。

column1: Ding! To advance for not only Warriors, Bowmen, and Thieves, but also Magicians, you need to be at least level 10. Warriors can advance in Perion, Bowmen in Henesys, Magicians in Ellinia, and Thieves in Kerning City. Think about which job you'd like to choose!
column2: 叮！不仅要升级战士、弓箭手和盗贼，还要升级魔法师，你需要达到 10 级以上。战士可以在佩里安晋级，弓箭手可以在赫尼尼斯晋级，魔术师可以在魔法密林晋级，盗贼可以在废弃都市晋级。想想你想选择什么工作！
该回答瑞恩的问题了。终于到第六题了。你学到升级时会获得 AP。如果把 AP 加到想要提升的能力值上，就能增强这些属性，一定要记住。

column1: Wow, you're pretty good. Are you assigning your Ability Points (AP) well? You know you get those after leveling up, right? Talk to me when you're ready for the 6th question.
column2: 哇，你真不错。你的能力点（AP）分配得好吗？你知道升级后你会得到这些，对吧？当你准备好回答第六个问题时，请告诉我。

column1: That's right. You get 5 AP with each level, and you can use them on the stats you want in Character Info to make your character stronger. Be sure to remember that!
column2: 没错。每个级别你都会获得 5 AP，你可以将它们用于角色信息中你想要的统计数据，使你的角色变得更强。一定要记住这一点！

column1: Finally the last question. After this, you'll no longer be a beginner.
column2: 这是瑞恩的最后一个问题。是不是有点激动？终于到最后一题了。答完之后，你就不再是新手了。瑞恩建议你该离开冒险岛了。在维多利亚岛，你可以选择职业，开始更多新的冒险。前往南港，去维多利亚岛吧！

column1: All right, last question! Talk to me when you're ready.
column2: 好吧，最后一个问题！等你准备好了就跟我说话。

column1: That's absolutely correct. Head over to Southperry , talk to Shanks , and get on the ship that heads to Victoria Island.
column2: 这是绝对正确的。前往南佩里，与香克斯交谈，然后登上前往维多利亚岛的船。

column1: I met Olaf at Lith Harbor. Olaf mentioned that once I reach level 10, I could advance my job, but wondered if I truly had what it takes. To prove myself, Olaf gave me a task to hunt monsters outside the village. I’m feeling a bit nervous since there seem to be stronger monsters on Victoria Island.
column2: 明珠港的奥拉夫似乎有话要对刚到维多利亚岛的新手冒险家说。我在明珠港见到了奥拉夫。奥拉夫说只要达到 10 级就可以转职，但他怀疑我是否真的具备资格。为了证明自己，奥拉夫让我去村外狩猎怪物。想到维多利亚岛上可能有更强的怪物，我有点紧张……我成功通过了奥拉夫的训练。但这样真的就够了吗？

column1: So, you're a fresh-faced adventurer who just landed on Victoria Island, huh? Doesn't matter what you say, it's obvious you're a newbie from a mile away! You might've done well on Maple Island, but here? Hold your horses. If you keep wandering around like that, you'll be face down in the dirt before you know it. You gotta get your head in the game!
column2: 那么，您是一位刚刚登陆维多利亚岛的新冒险家吧？不管你说什么，一眼就能看出你是个新手！你可能在冒险岛做得很好，但是在这里呢？牵住你的马。如果你继续这样徘徊，不知不觉间你就会脸朝下倒在泥土里。你必须在游戏中集中注意力！

column1: Maybe things will change once you hit level 10 and get a job advancement, but I'm not so sure you've earned it yet... Fine! I'll give you some special training to see what you've got. How about it?
column2: 也许一旦你达到 10 级并获得工作晋升，情况就会改变，但我不太确定你是否已经赢得了它......好吧！我会给你一些特殊的训练，看看你有什么能力。怎么样？

column1: Outside Lith Harbor , you'll find monsters that you've never even seen before on Maple Island. Take down 8 Stumps and 8 Slimes . They're no pushovers, so don't forget to grab some potions from the shop!
column2: 在利斯港外，你会发现以前在冒险岛上从未见过的怪物。拿下 8 个树桩和 8 个史莱姆。他们可不是好惹的人，所以别忘了从商店里买一些药水！

column1: What's the matter? Getting cold feet about the training? Hahaha! Don't worry; you can come back when you're ready!
column2: 怎么了？对训练临阵退缩？哈哈哈！不用担心;准备好后就可以回来了！

column1: Well, look who's back. I honestly thought you might've bailed. All right, let's see if you actually finished the job.
column2: 嗯，看看谁回来了。老实说，我以为你可能已经保释了。好吧，让我们看看你是否真的完成了工作。

column1: You did that flawlessly, huh? Nice! It's been a while since I've seen such an eager newbie adventurer. You've got me feeling good! Here, take this special item and put it to good use on your journey!
column2: 你做得很完美，是吧？好的！好久没见到如此热心的新手冒险家了。你让我感觉很好！来吧，带上这个特殊的物品，在你的旅途中好好利用它吧！

column1: Hmm... looks like you didn't take down all the monsters I asked you to. If you're even one short, that's a no-go!
column2: 嗯……看起来你并没有消灭掉我要求你消灭的所有怪物。如果你连一个都短，那就不行了！

column1: Let’s head to the Information Broker Phil in Lith Harbor to learn more about job advancement.
column2: 我终于达到 10 级了！说起来，我记得听过达到 10 级后可以选择职业……去明珠港找情报商人菲尔了解转职吧。菲尔告诉我，可以选择成为剑士、魔法师、弓箭手或飞侠。看来一旦选择就不能更改，所以必须慎重考虑……

column1: You look like a novice adventurer who has just arrived on Victoria Island. Welcome to Lith Harbor ! Your real adventure begins now, so you'd better brace yourself.
column2: 你看起来就像一个刚刚抵达维多利亚岛的新手冒险家。欢迎来到利斯港！你真正的冒险现在才开始，所以你最好做好准备。

column1: But it seems you don't even have a proper job yet. At this rate, you'll find it hard to even leave this area. Don't worry, though. That's why I'm here as the town's informant for adventurers like you. So, how about it? Want to hear about the job advancement?
column2: 但看来你还没有找到一份合适的工作。照这样下去，你会发现很难离开这个区域。不过别担心。这就是为什么我作为像你这样的冒险者的城镇的线人来到这里。那么，怎么样？想了解工作进展吗？

column1: Great! To make a job advancement, you need to reach Level 10 and then visit the various towns across Victoria Island. Once you reach Level 10, come back to me and I'll explain the rest in more detail.
column2: 太棒了！要获得工作晋升，您需要达到 10 级，然后访问维多利亚岛的各个城镇。一旦你达到10级，就回来找我，我会更详细地解释剩下的事情。

column1: How do you reach Level 10, you ask? Heading out of town to hunt monsters is one way, but helping out the townsfolk here with their favors will also get you the items you need for your adventure, killing two birds with one stone.
column2: 你问如何达到10级？出城狩猎怪物是一种方法，但帮助这里的镇民也可以获得冒险所需的物品，一石二鸟。

column1: It looks like Olaf and Teo have some favors to ask of adventurers, so why not go hear what they have to say? Come back and find me once you reach Level 10 !
column2: 看来奥拉夫和提奥有一些事情想请冒险者帮忙，何不去听听他们要说些什么呢？等你到了10级再来找我吧！

column1: Turning down my information... you must be pretty confident in yourself!
column2: 拒绝我的信息……你对自己一定很有信心吧！

column1: Seeing how different your eyes look compared to when we first met, you must have reached Level 10! Now you look ready to begin your real adventure.
column2: 看你的眼神和我们第一次见面时的样子有多么不同，你一定已经达到10级了！现在你看起来已经准备好开始你真正的冒险了。

column1: Well, you can't stay a beginner forever, right? All right! Now that you've reached level 10, you can choose to advance to one of the following classes: Swordsman , Magician , Archer , or Rogue.
column2: 嗯，你不能永远保持初学者的状态，对吧？好的！现在您已达到 10 级，您可以选择晋级以下职业之一：剑士、魔法师、弓箭手或盗贼。

column1: To become a Swordsman, you need to go to Perion ; to become a Magician, you need to head to Ellinia ; to become an Archer, you need to go to Henesys ; and to become a Rogue, you need to make your way to Kerning City . They're all towns located on Victoria Island, but it can still be quite a long journey to get to them.
column2: 要成为剑士，就需要前往勇士部落；要成为魔法师，你需要前往魔法密林；要成为弓箭手，你需要去射手村；要成为一名盗贼，您需要前往废弃都市。它们都是位于维多利亚岛上的城镇，但到达它们仍然需要很长的路程。

column1: But, you know, there are always a few... unusual ones. I'm talking about the ones who choose to stay beginners and never advance. Hahaha! But I'm sure you're not the type to make that choice, right?
column2: 但是，你知道，总有一些……不寻常的。我说的是那些选择保持初学者状态而从不进步的人。哈哈哈！但我确信你不是那种会做出这种选择的人，对吧？

column1: Anyway, once you've decided which job you want to advance to, come talk to me again. I can send you to the town you need to get to at a special discounted price, just for beginner adventurers!
column2: 不管怎样，一旦你决定了想要晋升的工作，就再跟我谈谈吧。我可以以特别折扣价将您送到您需要前往的城镇，专为初学者冒险家而设！

column1: In Lith Harbor, I met Jane, a girl wearing bunny ears. Jane says she wants to travel the world, but her dad won't let her. She thinks if I get her 15 Blue Mushroom Caps and 15 s, her father will change his mind.
column2: 去明珠港找珍。在明珠港，我遇到了戴着兔耳朵的女孩珍。珍说她想环游世界，但爸爸不让她去。她觉得如果我帮她收集 15 个蓝蘑菇盖和 15 个刺蘑菇盖，她爸爸也许会改变主意。你把蓝蘑菇盖和刺蘑菇盖交给了珍。不知道这是否真的能让她爸爸改变想法……她可是戴着兔耳朵啊！算了，不关我的事。作为回报，珍给了我一张攻击卷轴。要是卷轴成功，我的武器就会变得很厉害。

column1: My dream is to travel freely around the world, just like you! But, argh, my dad won't let me. I tell him I'm ready to spread my wings a little, but he just won't listen.
column2: 我的梦想是像你一样自由地环游世界！但是，唉，我爸爸不让我这么做。我告诉他我已经准备好展开我的翅膀了，但他就是不听。

column1: Hmm. You look pretty strong. Can... can I ask you a favor? Please defeat 30 Blue Mushrooms and Horny Mushrooms , and collect 15 Blue Mushroom Caps and 15 Horny Mushroom Caps . If you can do this for me, my father might give me permission to travel the world. Please, I'm begging you.
column2: 嗯。你看起来很坚强。我能……能请你帮个忙吗？请击败30个蓝色蘑菇和角质蘑菇，并收集15个蓝色蘑菇帽和15个角质蘑菇帽。如果你能为我做到这一点，我父亲可能会允许我环游世界。拜托，我求求你了……

column1: A Blue Mushroom Cap looks like Blue Mushroom Cap and a Horny Mushroom Cap looks like Horny Mushroom Cap . You can get them from Blue Mushrooms and Horny Mushrooms . Oooh, I'm so excited about this!
column2: 蓝色蘑菇帽看起来像蓝色蘑菇帽，角质蘑菇帽看起来像角质蘑菇帽。你可以从蓝色蘑菇和角质蘑菇中获得它们。哦，我对此感到非常兴奋！

column1: Incredible! You defeated so many Blue Mushrooms and Horny Mushrooms ! Now I can prove to my dad that I'm strong enough to travel by myself! Hehehe! What? It's not dishonest... I could've done it on my own, but I didn't want to leave town behind my dad's back.
column2: 难以置信！你打败了这么多的蓝蘑菇和角质蘑菇！现在我可以向爸爸证明我有足够的能力独自旅行！呵呵呵呵！什么？这并不是不诚实……我本来可以自己做，但我不想背着我爸爸离开小镇……

column1: It's none of your business anyway. Here, just take your reward and don't ask so many questions.
column2: 反正这不关你的事。在这里，你就收下你的奖励吧，别问那么多问题。

column1: This scroll can strengthen certain weapons. Just open the Use tab of your Item Inventory and your Equipment Inventory at the same time, then drag the scroll onto the weapon. There's a chance the scroll will fail, but life's risky like that.
column2: 该卷轴可以强化某些武器。只需同时打开物品清单和装备清单的“使用”选项卡，然后将卷轴拖到武器上即可。卷轴有可能失败，但人生就是这么危险……

column1: If you could just bring me 15 Blue Mushroom Caps and 15 Horny Mushroom Caps , I'll finally be able to start traveling... I'm begging you.
column2: 如果你能给我带来 15 个蓝色蘑菇帽和 15 个角质蘑菇帽，我终于可以开始旅行了......我求你了。

column1: Hmm... It looks like you haven't defeated all the monsters I asked you to.
column2: 嗯……看起来我让你打败的怪物你都没有打败。
随机奖励 - 以下之一：

column1: Last time, I got Jane some mushroom caps and boar's teeth to convince her dad to let her travel. That didn't work. Now she has a new dream: she wants to be an alchemist! A bit fickle, but whatever. Now, she needs materials... I can guess where this is going. She wants me to collect 1 Pure Water, 25 Drake Skull, and 25 Medicine With Weird Vibes by defeating several monsters so she can make some Elixirs.
column2: 听说珍有了新的人生目标……上次我帮她收集蘑菇盖和野猪牙，想说服她爸爸让她去旅行，但失败了。现在她有了新梦想：成为炼金术士！有点三分钟热度，不过算了。现在她需要材料……我大概猜到接下来会怎样。她想让我打怪收集 1 个纯净水、25 个飞龙头骨和 25 个奇怪感觉的药，好制作一些万能药。你收集到了珍制作万能药所需的材料。如果她失败了……整个地方会不会爆炸？

column1: Hey! You helped me the other day! You know, even after I showed my dad the items you got me, he still wouldn't let me travel... Hmph. He said he knew I didn't get them myself.
column2: 嘿！那天你帮了我！你知道，即使我把你给我的东西给我爸爸看了，他仍然不让我旅行……哼。他说他知道我自己没有得到它们。

column1: I gave up on that dream shortly after. Ah well. Anyway, I want to ask you for another favor... Do you have time?
column2: 不久之后我就放弃了这个梦想。啊好吧。不管怎样，我想再请你帮个忙……你有时间吗？

column1: I have a new dream. Being a traveler would be too tough for a pretty girl like me anyway, hehe! So my new life ambition is to become a great alchemist! Oh, by the way! Do you know what an alchemist does? Even if you do, I'll give you a simple explanation again, to make sure you really understand.
column2: 我有一个新的梦想。反正对于我这样一个漂亮女孩来说，当一个旅行者也太辛苦了吧，呵呵！所以我新的人生志向就是成为一名伟大的炼金术士！哦，顺便说一下！你知道炼金术士是做什么的吗？即使你明白了，我也会再给你一个简单的解释，以确保你真正理解。

column1: An alchemist is someone who can freely manipulate different things that exist in this world and, with special techniques, transform them into something entirely new. In other words, it's a profession that can craft items imbued with mysterious powers from different materials.
column2: 炼金术士是能够自由操纵这个世界上存在的不同事物，并通过特殊技术将它们转化为全新事物的人。换句话说，这是一个可以用不同的材料制作出充满神秘力量的物品的职业。

column1: But here's the thing... to make different items, I'll need materials. If you're not too busy, could you gather the ones I ask you for? In return, I'll give you whatever I make out of them. I can't promise exactly how it'll turn out... but what do you think?
column2: 但事情是这样的……要制作不同的物品，我需要材料。如果你不太忙的话，可以帮我收集一下我要的东西吗？作为回报，我会把我从它们身上赚到的一切都给你。我不能确切地保证结果会如何......但你觉得怎么样？

column1: Awesome! Let's see... I'm going to need 1 Pure Water , 25 Drake Skull , and 25 Medicine With Weird Vibes . Also, please take care of 50 Copper Drakes and 50 Wraiths . If all goes well, I can make Elixirs !
column2: 太棒了！让我们看看...我需要 1 个纯净水、25 个德雷克骷髅和 25 个带有怪异氛围的药物。另外，请照顾 50 只铜龙和 50 只幽灵。如果一切顺利的话，我就能炼出丹药了！

column1: Well, now. If you don't have time to listen to a poor girl's plea... Fine, just let me know if you change your mind.
column2: 好吧，现在。如果你没有时间听一个可怜女孩的恳求……好吧，如果你改变主意就告诉我。

column1: Yippee! You got 1 Pure Water , 25 Drake Skull , and 25 Medicine With Weird Vibes ! Now, my turn. I just gotta mix these babies together, and.
column2: 耶皮！您获得了 1 个纯净水、25 个龙头骨和 25 个带有奇怪氛围的药物！现在，轮到我了。我只需要将这些婴儿混合在一起，然后...

column1: Voila! You know, this is my first time actually doing alchemy. Am I good or what? Here you go. Please take it as a gift.
column2: 瞧！要知道，这是我第一次真正炼金。我是好人还是什么？干得好。请把它作为礼物。

column1: Wow. I've got a talent for this. I made 10 Elixirs in my very first experiment. You did your part to help, of course! Thank you.
column2: 哇。我有这方面的天赋。我在第一次实验中制作了 10 颗药剂。当然，您也尽了自己的一份力量来提供帮助！谢谢。

column1: You haven't collected 1 Pure Water , 25 Drake Skulls , and 25 Medicine With Weird Vibes yet! I believe some vendors sell Pure Water . You can get the other stuff from monsters.
column2: 您还没有收集 1 个纯净水、25 个龙头骨和 25 个带有怪异氛围的药物！我相信有些供应商出售纯净水。你可以从怪物那里得到其他东西。

column1: Hmm... It looks like you haven't defeated all the monsters I asked you to.
column2: 嗯……看起来我让你打败的怪物你都没有打败。

column1: This time, Jane promises to make a better item, so she needs me to gather 1 Mushmom Spore, 3 vials of Drake's Blood, 25 Medicine With Weird Vibes, and 25 Malady's Experimental Frogs by defeating several monsters. She says it can be used to make an even more powerful elixir…

column1: Did you enjoy the stuff I made you last time? Hehe, now I want to make more complicated stuff. Want to help?

column1: Thanks. I need 1 Mushmom Spore , 3 vials of Drake's Blood , 25 Medicine With Weird Vibes and 25 Malady's Experimental Frogs . And also, please take care of 50 Wraiths and 50 Maladys . This time, I'm hoping to make Power Elixirs , hehe!
column2: 谢谢。我需要 1 个蘑菇孢子、3 瓶德雷克之血、25 种怪异药物和 25 只瘟疫实验青蛙。另外，请照顾好50个幽灵和50个疾病。这次，我希望能够制作出灵丹妙药，呵呵！

column1: Well, now. If you don't have time to listen to a poor girl's plea... Fine, just let me know if you change your mind.

column2: 你得到了 1 个蘑菇孢子、3 瓶德雷克之血、25 种怪异药物和 25 只瘟疫实验青蛙。出色的！是时候混合了……呵呵。

column1: Okay, this is only my second experiment ever. Hope it turns out okay. Check to make sure you have an empty slot in your Use inventory, and then hold out your hand.

column1: Whoa! I'm amazing! I made 15 Power Elixirs ! Whee! What a huge success. Thanks for your help!
column2: 哇！我太棒了！我炼制了15颗强力丹药！哎哟！多么巨大的成功啊。感谢您的帮助！

column1: You haven't collected 1 Mushmom Spore , 3 vials of Drake's Blood , 25 Medicine With Weird Vibes , and 25 Malady's Experimental Frogs yet. You should be able to get them off monsters. Keep trying!
column2: 您尚未收集 1 个蘑菇孢子、3 瓶德雷克之血、25 个怪异药物和 25 个瘟疫实验青蛙。你应该能够把它们从怪物身上弄下来。继续努力！

column1: Hmm... It looks like you haven't defeated all the monsters I asked you to.
column2: 嗯……看起来我让你打败的怪物你都没有打败。

column1: For this last experiment, Jane promises to make me a mysterious Scroll. For that, she needs a Moon Rock, 20 Dragon Skins, and 10 Sap of Ancient Tree. Maybe I should ask the fairies at Ellinia for the Moon Rock.
column2: 珍说她会做出更好的东西。最后一次实验中，珍答应为我制作一张神秘卷轴。为此，她需要一块月石、20 张龙皮和 10 个古木树液。也许我该去魔法密林问问妖精关于月石的事……你把珍需要的材料交给了她，手套卷轴也顺利完成了。太好了！珍表现出继续实验的强烈愿望。也许下次回来时，我就能从她那里买到商店里买不到的东西……

column1: Okay, this time, I'm feeling even more ambitious! Want to help me with my third-ever alchemy experiment?
column2: 好吧，这一次，我感觉更加雄心勃勃了！想帮助我进行第三次炼金术实验吗？

column1: Thank you very much. Can you bring me 1 Moon Rock , 20 Dragon Skins , and 10 vials of Sap of Ancient Tree ? I think I might be able to create a mysterious scroll.
column2: 非常感谢。你能给我1块月石、20张龙皮和10瓶古树汁液吗？我想我也许可以制作出神秘的卷轴……

column1: Well, now. If you don't have time to listen to a poor girl's plea... Fine, just let me know if you change your mind.
column2: 好吧，现在。如果你没有时间听一个可怜女孩的恳求……好吧，如果你改变主意就告诉我。

column1: Ah! You got me 1 Moon Rock , 20 Dragon Skins , and 10 vials of Sap of Ancient Tree . Whew, I need a minute to mentally prepare myself.
column2: 啊！你给了我1块月石，20张龙皮，10瓶古树汁液。呃，我需要一点时间做好心理准备……

column1: While I do this, make sure you have an empty slot in your Use inventory. Okay, okay, breathe, breathe. Steady hands, and mix, and pour, and.
column2: 当我这样做时，请确保您的“使用”库存中有一个空位。好吧好吧，呼吸，呼吸。双手稳住，混合，倒出，然后……

column1: Oh my. Oh my goodness. OH MY! I am sooooo talented! Look! I made a scroll for gloves ! I think I'm going to faint from happiness. I couldn't have done it without you, so here, take it. It's yours.
column2: 天哪。哦，我的天啊。天啊！我真是太有才华了！看！我做了一个手套卷轴！我想我快要幸福得晕过去了。没有你我不可能做到这一点，所以在这里，接受它。这是你的。

column1: You didn't bring me 1 Moon Rock , 20 Dragon Skins , and 10 vials of Sap of Ancient Tree . I heard that someone can create the Moon Rock , and I think the monsters will have the other two items. Good luck!
column2: 你没有给我带来1块月石、20张龙皮、10瓶古树汁液。我听说有人可以制作月亮石，我想怪物们也会有另外两个物品。祝你好运！

column1: Hmm... It looks like you haven't defeated all the monsters I asked you to.
column2: 嗯……看起来我让你打败的怪物你都没有打败。
随机奖励 - 以下之一：

column1: I met a fisherman named John in Lith Harbor. He wanted to get his wife a nice flower basket for their upcoming anniversary. He asked me if I could get him 10 Pink Violas for her. According to him, a Mysterious Statue can lead me to where the flower is. Sleepywood... Sleepywood??? That's FAR!!!
column2: 去明珠港找约翰吧。我在明珠港遇到了一位叫约翰的渔夫。他想在即将到来的结婚纪念日给妻子准备一个漂亮的花篮，问我能不能帮他拿到 10 朵粉色紫罗兰。据他说，神秘雕像能带我到花所在的地方。林中之城……林中之城？那也太远了！！！你收集到了全部 10 朵粉色紫罗兰。有了这些，约翰就能在纪念日给妻子做一个美丽的花篮。作为谢礼，约翰给了我一大堆从船上剩下的螺丝。话说，如果那艘船掉了这么多螺丝，它到底是怎么还能正常航行的……还在载客吗？

column1: How's traveling these days? I actually have a favor to ask you... This time, my wedding anniversary is coming up, and I need flowers. Can you get them for me?
column2: 这几天旅行怎么样？我其实有件事想拜托你……这次我的结婚纪念日快到了，我需要鲜花。你能帮我拿一下吗？

column1: Thank you! This time, I'd like to give my wife Pink Violas ... They have a very pleasant scent, and I heard they're found deep in the forest... They say the place where they exist doesn't let everyone in, only a select few, I think. Something about a Mysterious Statue in Sleepywood and something-something.
column2: 谢谢！这次，我想送给我的妻子粉红中提琴......它们有一种非常宜人的香味，而且我听说它们是在森林深处发现的......他们说它们存在的地方不允许所有人进入，我认为只有少数人可以进入。一些关于沉睡林的神秘雕像的事情以及一些事情......

column1: Please get me 10 Pink Violas . I think 10 will be enough to cover the house with that pleasant scent. Please hurry!
column2: 请给我 10 支粉色中提琴。我想 10 个就足以让整个房子充满宜人的香味了。请快点！

column1: I understand... But my wedding anniversary is coming up, and I am screwed! Please come back if you have some spare time.
column2: 我明白……但我的结婚纪念日快到了，我完蛋了！如果您有空闲时间，请回来。

column1: Ohhh... You got me 10 Pink Violas ! This is awesome... I can't believe you went deep into the forest to get these flowers... There's a story about this flower that says it supposedly stays alive for 100 years. With this, I can make my wife happy.
column2: 噢...你给我买了 10 支粉色中提琴！这太棒了...我不敢相信你深入森林去采这些花...有一个关于这种花的故事，据说它可以活 100 年。有了这个，我就能让我的妻子高兴。

column1: Oh, and... since you worked hard for me, I should reward you well. I found some Screws on the ship. They seem to have been parts from a different ship. They look like something you might need, so take them.
column2: 哦，还有……既然你为我辛苦了，我就应该好好回报你。我在船上发现了一些螺丝。它们似乎是另一艘船的部件。它们看起来像是您可能需要的东西，所以拿走它们吧。

column1: If you have time, why not try going back into the forest? You might find some treasure in there. I can't guarantee it, since I've obviously never been there before, so please don't come back complaining to me if all you find is trash.
column2: 如果你有时间，为什么不尝试回到森林呢？你可能会在那里找到一些宝藏。我不能保证，因为我显然以前从未去过那里，所以如果你发现的只是垃圾，请不要回来向我抱怨。

column1: You haven't gotten the Pink Violas yet. There's a Mysterious Statue in Sleepywood , and I heard that it'll take you to the location where the Pink Violas are. Please go into the forest and collect Pink Violas for me. I need 10 for my wedding anniversary.
column2: 您还没有得到粉红中提琴。沉睡林里有一座神秘雕像，听说它会带你去粉红中提琴所在的地方。请到森林里为我收集粉红中提琴。我的结婚纪念日需要 10 个。

column1: I ran into John the fisherman again in Lith Harbor. This time, he wanted to get his wife Blue Violas for her birthday. He asked me to get 20 Blue Violas for him. The scent of Blue Viola last over 500 years... and according to John, they can be found in the Mysterious Statue again, where the flower may be found. Man... do I HAVE to go in there again??
column2: 再去明珠港见约翰吧。我又在明珠港遇到了渔夫约翰。这次，他想给妻子生日准备蓝色紫罗兰。他让我帮忙收集 20 朵蓝色紫罗兰。蓝色紫罗兰的香味能持续 500 年以上……据约翰说，它们又可以通过神秘雕像找到。唉……我真的还得再进去一次吗？你收集到了全部 20 朵蓝色紫罗兰。香味确实不错，但 20 朵放在一起让我头都晕了……作为谢礼，约翰送了我一只他在船里找到的不错的手套。看起来像是有人不小心落下的……他这样送给我真的可以吗？要是我戴着它在镇上遇到原主人怎么办？

column1: Ohhhh, you're the one that helped me out the other day. You look much stronger now. How's traveling these days? I actually have another favor to ask you... This time, my wife's birthday is coming up, and I need more flowers. Can you get them for me?
column2: 哦哦，那天你就是帮我的人。你现在看起来坚强多了。这几天旅行怎么样？其实我还有件事想拜托你……这次，我妻子的生日快到了，我需要更多的花。你能帮我拿一下吗？

column1: Thank you! This time, I'd like to give my wife Blue Violas ... They have a very pleasant scent, and I heard they're found deep in the forest... column2: 谢谢！这次，我想送给我的妻子蓝色堇菜……它们的气味非常好闻，而且我听说它们是在森林深处发现的……据说它们存在的地方不让所有人进入；我想，只有少数几个。一些关于沉睡林的神秘雕像的事情以及一些事情......

column1: Please get me 20 Blue Violas . I think 20 will cover the house with that pleasant scent. Please hurry!
column2: 请给我20把蓝色中提琴。我想 20 会让房子充满宜人的香味。请快点！
