column1: I ran into John the fisherman again in Lith Harbor. This time, he told me his mother passed away recently, and he wanted to get some White Violas for her. He asked me to get 30 White Violas for him. The scent of White Violas last over 1000 years... and according to John, they can be found through the Mysterious Statue again, where the flowers may be found. Man... do I HAVE to go in there again??
column2: 听说约翰还有最后一件事想拜托我……我又在明珠港遇到了渔夫约翰。这次他告诉我，他的母亲最近去世了，他想为她准备一些白色紫罗兰。他让我帮忙收集 30 朵白色紫罗兰。白色紫罗兰的香味能持续 1000 年以上……据约翰说，它们仍然可以通过神秘雕像找到。唉……我真的还得再进去一次吗？你收集到了全部 30 朵白色紫罗兰。香味确实不错，但 30 朵放在一起让我头都晕了……作为谢礼，约翰送给我一对他母亲的耳环。这耳环看起来像是用普通花朵做成的，但似乎另有玄机……

column1: Ohhh... You're the person that did me huge favors before. You look so much stronger now that I can't even recognize you anymore. By now, it looks like you have gone pretty much everywhere. I have one last favor to ask you. Well, my mother passed away of old age a few days ago. I need a special kind of flower to put on her grave... Can you get them for me?
column2: 呵呵……你就是以前帮过我大忙的人啊。你现在看起来坚强多了，我什至都认不出你了。到现在为止，看起来你已经去过很多地方了。我还有最后一件事要请你帮忙。嗯，我的母亲前几天因年老去世了。我需要一种特殊的花来放在她的坟墓上......你能给我买吗？

column1: Thank you so much! The flowers I want on her grave are called White Violas , and they're a very rare kind. I heard they're found deep in the forest... They say the place where they exist doesn't let everyone in; only a select few, I think. Something about a Mysterious Statue in Sleepywood and something something.
column2: 非常感谢！我想在她的坟墓上种的花叫白堇菜，是一种非常稀有的花。听说他们是在森林深处被发现的……他们说他们所在的地方不让所有人进入；我想，只有少数几个。一些关于沉睡林的神秘雕像的事情以及一些……

column1: Please get me 30 White Violas . I want to get a whole bunch for my mother's grave. Please hurry!
column2: 请给我 30 支白色中提琴。我想为我母亲的坟墓买一大堆。请快点！

column1: I see... My mother loved looking at those flowers while she was alive... I hoped that you could get them for me, and for her... I understand.
column2: 我明白了……我母亲在世时喜欢看那些花……我希望你能为我、也为她买下它们……我理解……

column1: Ohhh... You got me all 30 White Violas ! This is awesome... I can't believe you went deep into the forest and got these flowers... There's a story about this flower that says it supposedly doesn't die for 1,000 years and can glow on its own. I can make a nice wreath out of these and bring it to my mother's grave.
column2: 噢...你给了我全部 30 支白色中提琴！这太棒了...我不敢相信你深入森林并得到了这些花...有一个关于这种花的故事，据说它1000年不会死亡，并且可以自行发光。我可以用这些制作一个漂亮的花圈，然后把它带到我母亲的坟墓上......

column1: Oh, and... since you worked hard for me, I should reward you well. My late mother left me these earrings before passing away. Apparently she had them since she was young. I don't know, but they seem to have some kind of a special power hidden in them... Anyway, please take them.
column2: 哦，还有……既然你为我辛苦了，我就应该好好回报你。我已故的母亲在去世前给我留下了这对耳环。显然她从小就拥有它们。我不知道，但它们身上似乎隐藏着某种特殊的力量……总之，请收下它们吧。

column1: If you have time, why not try going back into the forest? You might find some treasure in there. I can't guarantee it, since I've obviously never been there before, so please don't come back complaining to me if all you find is trash.
column2: 如果你有时间，为什么不尝试回到森林呢？你可能会在那里找到一些宝藏。我不能保证，因为我显然以前从未去过那里，所以如果你发现的只是垃圾，请不要回来向我抱怨。

column1: You haven't gotten the White Violas yet. There's a Mysterious Statue in Sleepywood , and I heard that with that you can go to the place where the White Violas are. Please go into the forest and collect the White Violas for me. I need 30 to make a wreath.
column2: 您还没有获得白色中提琴。沉睡林里有一个神秘的雕像，听说有了它就可以去白中提琴所在的地方。请到森林里帮我收集白色中提琴。我需要 30 个来制作花圈。

column1: I met Olaf again in Lith Harbor. He says my training is still far from over and gave me a mission to hunt stronger monsters outside the town. Will I finally become a true adventurer once I finish this training?
column2: 看起来明珠港的奥拉夫又准备了一轮训练。我再次在明珠港见到了奥拉夫。他说我的训练还远远没有结束，并让我去镇外狩猎更强的怪物。完成这次训练后，我终于能成为真正的冒险家吗？我出色地通过了奥拉夫的第二次训练！等我达到 10 级，就可以准备选择职业了！

column1: You might've passed the first trial, but you're still lacking. At this rate, it wouldn't be strange to find you rotting somewhere on Victoria Island.
column2: 你可能已经通过了第一关，但你仍然有所欠缺。照这样下去，发现你在维多利亚岛的某个地方腐烂也就不足为奇了。

column1: Now, for this test, head further out from the harbor to hunt Pigs and Orange Mushrooms and return. They are much faster and stronger than anything you've faced so far, so watch your back.
column2: 现在，对于这个测试，从港口出发去更远的地方寻找猪和橙色蘑菇并返回。它们比你迄今为止所面对的任何东西都更快、更强，所以要小心你的背后。

column1: Well now, if it isn't you , back from training. To be honest, I thought there was a good chance you wouldn't make it back at all, haha! Since you cleared this trial too, I suppose you deserve some credit. Here, I've prepared something for you.
column2: 好吧，如果不是你的话，从训练回来吧。说实话，我以为你很有可能根本就回不来了，哈哈！既然你也通过了这次考验，我想你应该得到一些荣誉。在这里，我为你准备了一些东西。

column1: That Return Scroll - Nearest Town will take you back to the nearest town whenever you need. It'll come in handy if you get lost or wander too far off. They sell them at the general stores in town too, so keep that in mind.
column2: 回城卷轴 - 最近的城镇将在您需要时带您回到最近的城镇。如果您迷路或走得太远，它会派上用场。镇上的杂货店也有卖，所以请记住这一点。

column1: Well, that's all I can do for you. I'll be looking forward to the day you grow into a proper adventurer.
column2: 嗯，这就是我能为你做的一切。我会期待你成长为真正的冒险家的那一天。

column1: Hmm... looks like you didn't take down all the monsters I asked for. If you're even one short, that's a no-go!
column2: 嗯……看来我要求的怪物你都没有消灭掉。如果你连一个都短，那就不行了！

column1: Teo in Lith Harbor says his hobby is collecting weird things. He asked me to hunt Slimes near the town and bring back 1 Slime Bubble. He warned me that it might be hard to find!
column2: 明珠港的水手特奥似乎在找能帮忙的冒险家。明珠港的特奥说他的爱好是收集奇怪的东西。他让我去镇子附近狩猎绿水灵，带回 1 个绿水灵泡泡。他提醒我这东西可能不太好找！你把 1 个绿水灵泡泡交给了明珠港的特奥。不过看他的表情，他似乎已经开始想要别的东西了……

column1: Hey there, traveler! You look like you have some time on your hands. Mind doing me a favor? Oh, what I meant was, you look strong enough to handle a request from me, haha!
column2: 嘿，旅行者！看来你还有时间。介意帮我一个忙吗？哦，我的意思是，你看起来很坚强，可以满足我的要求，哈哈！

column1: Thanks a ton! To tell you the truth, I have a hobby of collecting weird things. I want to gather every single weird thing in the world, you see? So, could you go out and hunt Slimes past the harbor and bring me 1 Slime Bubble ? It's a pretty delicate item, so it might be hard to get it in one piece. You're going to need some patience!
column2: 非常感谢！说实话，我有一个爱好，就是收集稀奇古怪的东西。我想收集世界上每一个奇怪的东西，你明白吗？那么，你能出去通过港口猎杀史莱姆并给我带来 1 个史莱姆泡泡吗？这是一件非常精致的物品，因此可能很难将其整合在一起。你需要一些耐心！

column1: You're not offended because I said you look like you have time, right? I'll take that as a no, haha!
column2: 你不会因为我说你看起来有时间而生气吧？我就当做不，哈哈！

column1: You're finally back! This is the Slime Bubble I asked for! And look at that, it's perfectly preserved and in great shape!
column2: 你终于回来了！这就是我要的史莱姆泡泡！你看，它保存得非常完好，而且形状非常好！

column1: Thanks to you, I'm one step closer to finishing my weird item collection. It isn't much, but please take this. What?! You think this is leftovers from my dinner last night? No way! It is a bit cold, but I haven't even touched it, haha!
column2: 多亏了你，我离完成我的奇怪物品收藏又近了一步。虽然不多，但请收下这个。什么？！你认为这是我昨晚的晚餐剩菜吗？决不！有点冷，不过我还没碰呢，哈哈！

column1: Still no sign of the Slime Bubble I asked for? That's a problem... It is an absolute must-have for my weird item collection.
column2: 我要的史莱姆泡泡还没出现吗？这是一个问题...它绝对是我的奇怪物品收藏的必备品。

column1: You didn't forget about hunting the Slimes , did you?
column2: 你没有忘记狩猎史莱姆吧？

column1: Teo from Lith Harbor is asking for even weirder items to complete his collection. He says he absolutely needs an intact Pig's Head... Why is he even collecting this kind of stuff?
column2: 看起来明珠港的特奥还有更多奇怪的东西想收集。特奥又提出了更奇怪的收集要求。他说自己一定需要一个完整的猪头……他到底为什么要收集这种东西？你把猪头交给了明珠港的特奥。我想，他这个奇怪的爱好还是让我们两个人知道就好。

column1: Look who it is! My friend who helped me out before! Seeing you still hanging around the harbor, you must be as bored as ever, haha! This is perfect timing. To tell you the truth, there is another item I want to add to my weird item collection.
column2: 看看是谁！之前帮过我的朋友！看你还在港口闲逛，你一定还是一如既往的无聊吧，哈哈！这是完美的时机。说实话，我想将另一件物品添加到我的奇怪物品收藏中。

column1: If you go a bit further from the harbor, you can easily find those fierce Pigs . I need you to hunt them down and bring back a clean Pig's Head without a single scratch. Most people would want other parts from them, but... I trust you understand me, haha!
column2: 如果你离港口远一点，你很容易就能找到那些凶猛的猪。我需要你去追捕他们，带回一个干净的、没有任何划痕的猪头。大多数人会想要他们的其他部分，但是......我相信你理解我，哈哈！

column1: So, how did it go with the item I asked for? Let's see... Now this is a truly intact Pig's Head ! Haha, I knew I could count on you!
column2: 那么，我要求的商品进展如何？让我看看……这才是真正完整的猪头啊！哈哈，我就知道我可以依靠你！

column1: Thanks to you, my weird item collection is finally coming together. My dream is to one day build a museum like the world has never seen before. Here, take this useful potion as a reward.
column2: 多亏了你，我的奇怪物品收藏终于集齐了。我的梦想是有一天建造一座世界上前所未见的博物馆。来，收下这有用的药剂作为奖励吧。

column1: I got this from a pirate I met a while back, but I have no use for it. It might come in handy for someone like you, though. Take care of yourself and drop by every now and then!
column2: 这是我从不久前认识的海盗那里得到的，但我没有用。不过，对于像您这样的人来说，它可能会派上用场。照顾好自己，时常过来看看！

column1: Still no sign of the Pig's Head I asked for? That's a real problem... It is an absolute must-have for my weird item collection.
column2: 我要的猪头还没有出现吗？这是一个真正的问题...它绝对是我的奇怪物品收藏的必备品。

column1: You haven't forgotten about hunting the Pigs , have you?
I ran into Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys, who is overcome with concern. She says there aren't enough decorations for the village festival, and asks you to get 10 Slime Bubbles and 20 s.
column2: 听说明明女士在射手村很担心什么事……我在射手村遇到了满脸忧虑的明明女士。她说村子祭典的装饰不够，拜托我带来 10 个绿水灵泡泡和 20 条猪的丝带。你把明明女士需要的东西都带回来了，不过我总觉得祭典需要的绝不只有这些装饰……

column1: Hey, there. I'm Mrs. Ming Ming . Why am I pacing around like this? The Carnival is coming up really soon, and I need to prepare for a lot of things, but one thing I'm lacking is a helping hand. Can you help me out?
column2: 嘿。我是明明太太。我为什么要这样来回踱步？嘉年华马上就要到了，我需要准备很多事情，但我缺少一件事，就是伸出援助之手。你能帮我一下吗？

column1: The Carnival is all about being extravagant and fancy, but the town is seriously lacking flashy materials to decorate with. Thankfully, the monsters drop some items that we can use. As you can see, however, I'm no good in terms of hunting.
column2: 嘉年华到处都是奢华和花哨的，但小镇却严重缺乏华丽的装饰材料。值得庆幸的是，怪物掉落了一些我们可以使用的物品。然而，如你所见，我不擅长狩猎。

column1: Can you help me gather 5 Slime Bubbles and 20 Pig's Ribbons ? They'll be the perfect decorations! I'll be here waiting for you. Good luck!
column2: 你能帮我收集 5 个史莱姆泡泡和 20 个猪丝带吗？它们将成为完美的装饰品！我会在这里等你。祝你好运！

column1: I thought you were going to help. If you feel like changing your mind, though, then please come see me. I need as much help as I can get!
column2: 我以为你会帮忙。如果你想改变主意，那么请来见我。我需要尽可能多的帮助！

column1: Oh wow, you got them all! This is plenty enough for me to decorate the town! Thank you so much for your help! The job isn't done, however, and I may need your help again soon, so if you have time, please come see me.
column2: 哦，哇，你全都得到了！这足够我装饰小镇了！非常感谢您的帮助！然而工作还没有完成，我可能很快就会再次需要你的帮助，所以如果你有时间，请来见我。

column1: I don't think you have all the items I need. To decorate the town for the Carnival, I'll need 10 Slime Bubbles and 20 Pig's Ribbons . Please get them for me!
column2: 我认为你没有我需要的所有物品。为了为嘉年华装饰小镇，我需要 10 个史莱姆泡泡和 20 个猪丝带。请帮我拿来！

column1: I don't think you have all the items I need. To decorate the town for the Carnival, I'll need 10 Slime Bubbles and 20 Pig's Ribbons . Please get them for me!
column2: 我认为你没有我需要的所有物品。为了为嘉年华装饰小镇，我需要 10 个史莱姆泡泡和 20 个猪丝带。请帮我拿来！

column1: I met Mrs. Ming Ming again in Henesys who was preparing for the village festival. She said she needs food to prepare for the festival, and asked me to collect 10 Pig's Heads, 30 Octopus Legs, and . To get the special sauce, I think I'll have to go find Estelle in The Field South of Ellinia.
column2: 听说射手村的明明女士又有新的烦恼……我再次在射手村见到了正在准备村子祭典的明明女士。她说祭典需要食物，拜托我收集 10 个猪头、30 条章鱼脚和艾斯特尔的特制酱油。要拿到特制酱油，我想得去魔法密林南部森林找艾斯特尔。你在魔法密林南部森林见到了艾斯特尔，想拿她的特制酱油，但她显然不打算免费给你……

column1: Hey, you're back! I'm putting the materials you got me last time to good use. The town is almost ready for the carnival that's coming up really soon. Unfortunately, there's another problem at hand. Do you want to hear me out?
column2: 嘿，你回来了！我正在充分利用你上次给我的材料。小镇已经为即将到来的狂欢节做好了准备。不幸的是，还有另一个问题。你想听我说完吗？

column1: I can't thank you enough for saying yes. Decorating the town for the carnival is important, but it's much more important to offer the tourists some food, you know? The problem is that we've run out of the ingredients for the big feast.
column2: 我非常感谢你的答应。为狂欢节装饰城镇固然重要，但为游客提供一些食物更重要，你知道吗？问题是我们的盛宴食材已经用完了。

column1: Can you bring me 10 Pig's Heads , 30 Octopus Legs , and 1 of Estelle's Special Sauce ? You can get Estelle's Special Sauce from Estelle , who should be in The Field South of Ellinia . Thank you, and good luck!
column2: 你能给我拿10个猪头、30条章鱼腿和1份艾丝黛尔特制酱料吗？你可以从埃斯特尔那里得到埃斯特尔的特制酱料，埃斯特尔应该在魔法密林南部的田野里。谢谢你，祝你好运！

column1: I thought you were going to help. If you feel like changing your mind, though, then please come see me. I need as much help as I can get!
column2: 我以为你会帮忙。如果你想改变主意，那么请来见我。我需要尽可能多的帮助！

column1: I need lots of ingredients for the big feast at the carnival. Can you get me 10 Pig's Heads , 30 Octopus Legs , and 1 of Estelle's Special Sauce ? You can get Estelle's Special Sauce from Estelle , who should be in The Field South of Ellinia . Thank you, and good luck!
column2: 我需要很多狂欢节盛宴的食材。你能给我10个猪头、30条章鱼腿和1份艾丝黛尔特制酱料吗？你可以从埃斯特尔那里得到埃斯特尔的特制酱料，埃斯特尔应该在魔法密林南部的田野里。谢谢你，祝你好运！

column1: Estelle in The Hill East of Henesys wants Garnet in exchange for Special Sauce. She wants to buy a necklace for her mom's birthday.
column2: 射手村东边山丘的艾斯特尔想用石榴石交换特制酱油。她想给妈妈生日买一条项链。你给在射手村东边山丘附近遇到的艾斯特尔带来了 1 个石榴石，用来制作她妈妈的生日礼物。她把艾斯特尔的特制酱油给了你。最好赶快收集其他材料，回去找明明女士。

column1: How may I help you? Ahh... my patented special sauce huh? You need that for the big feast for the Carnival? Hmmm... my mom gave me this, so I don't know if I should give this to a stranger like you, unless you can do me a favor.
column2: 我可以怎样帮助您？啊……我的专利特制酱料啊？您需要这个来参加狂欢节盛宴吗？嗯...这是我妈妈给我的，所以我不知道我是否应该把它送给像你这样的陌生人，除非你能帮我一个忙...

column1: The favor is pretty simple, actually. My mom's birthday is coming up in a few days. I'd love to get her a pretty Garnet necklace, but I'm seriously lacking a Garnet . Can you get me 1 Garnet ?
column2: 事实上，这个恩惠很简单。过几天我妈妈的生日就到了。我很想送她一条漂亮的石榴石项链，但我严重缺乏石榴石项链。你能给我 1 颗石榴石吗？

column1: It's not that difficult a favor, not something you should say no to without even hearing one bit about it. If you really need my special sauce, then please come talk to me. I'll see you around.
column2: 这并不是一件困难的事，你甚至不应该在没有听说过它的情况下就拒绝它。如果你真的需要我的特制酱料，那就来找我吧。我会再见的。

column1: I'd love to get my mom a pretty Garnet necklace for her birthday that's coming up in a few days. Can you get me 1 Garnet in exchange for the special sauce?
column2: 我很想送我妈妈一条漂亮的石榴石项链作为她几天后的生日礼物。你能给我 1 个石榴石来换取特制酱汁吗？

column1: I received the special sauce from Estelle in The Field South of Ellinia. Now, I should deliver it to Mrs. Ming Ming, along with 10 Pig's Heads and 30 Octopus Legs.
column2: 你从魔法密林南部森林的艾斯特尔那里拿到了特制酱油。现在应该把它连同 10 个猪头和 30 条章鱼脚一起交给明明女士。你收集齐了明明女士要求的所有材料，并交给了她。真期待村子祭典！

column1: Oh, I'll be able to get her a really nice necklace with this! Thank you so much. Here, please take this Special Sauce. Also, please tell Mrs. Ming Ming that I hope the carnival is a success.
column2: 哦，有了这个我就能给她买一条非常漂亮的项链了！太感谢了。来，请收下这道特制酱料。另外，请转告明明太太，希望这次嘉年华能够成功。

column1: You're back! How was it? Whew... I was so busy preparing all this food. Let's see what you have... 10 Pig's Heads , 30 Octopus Legs , and 1 Estelle's Special Sauce . Great! I knew you could do it.
column2: 你回来了！它怎么样？哇...我正忙着准备所有这些食物。让我们看看你有什么... 10 个猪头、30 个章鱼腿和 1 个埃斯特尔特制酱料。伟大的！我知道你能做到。

column1: Thanks for helping me. Now, I have all the decorations and ingredients. This one will be great! Thank you so much. Bye.
column2: 谢谢你帮助我。现在，我已经拥有了所有的装饰品和原料。这个会很棒的！太感谢了。再见。

column1: I need ingredients for the food during the festival. Can you please get 10 Pig's Head , 30 Octopus Legs , and 1 Estelle's Special Sauce ? You can ask Estelle in The Field South of Ellinia for Estelle's Special Sauce . Thank you!
column2: 我需要节日期间食物的原料。你能得到10个猪头、30条章鱼腿和1个艾丝黛尔特制酱吗？你可以向艾丽尼亚南部田野的艾丝黛尔索取艾丝黛尔特制酱料。谢谢你！

column1: Please bring this sauce to Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys . She must really need this. I better get going to make a necklace with this Garnet.
column2: 请把这个酱带给轩尼诗的明明太太。她一定很需要这个。我最好用这颗石榴石制作一条项链。

column1: Under the watchtower in Henesys Park, you see Pia, wearing a teddy bear costume. How cute! She tells you that she ran into a bully Blue Mushroom on her way to Ellinia, and now she wants you to show the rude mushroom who's boss! Collect 20 Green Mushroom Caps and 20 Blue Mushroom Caps as proof. You contemplate telling Pia she's asking to be teased, walking around the forest in a bear costume, but you decide against it.
column2: 去射手村公园找皮亚。在射手村公园的瞭望台下，你看见穿着泰迪熊服装的皮亚。真可爱！她说去魔法密林的路上被一只蛮横的蓝蘑菇欺负了，现在想让你给那只没礼貌的蘑菇一点颜色看看！收集 20 个绿蘑菇盖和 20 个蓝蘑菇盖作为证明。你本想告诉皮亚，穿着熊装在森林里走动本来就容易被捉弄，但最后还是忍住了。你把 20 个绿蘑菇盖和 20 个蓝蘑菇盖交给了射手村公园的皮亚。她因为报复了蘑菇而非常高兴，并送给你一张帽子卷轴。只要在道具栏的消耗栏点击它，再拖到装备栏的头盔上就可以使用……哦，还要祈祷卷轴不要失败。

column1: Whew... I had the most difficult time when I ran into a Blue Mushroom the other day. It was so frustrating! If only I had more strength... I would've showed them what for!
column2: 呼……那天我遇到了蓝色蘑菇，这是我最困难的时候。太令人沮丧了！如果我有更多的力量……我就会告诉他们这是为了什么！

column1: Whoa! You look pretty strong! How about you take care of those bullies for me? Bring me 20 Green Mushroom Caps and 20 Blue Mushroom Caps as proof, and I'll give you something in return... Something really sweet! Yeah!
column2: 哇！你看起来很坚强！你帮我解决一下那些恶霸怎么样？给我20个绿色蘑菇帽和20个蓝色蘑菇帽作为证据，我会给你一些回报......非常甜蜜的东西！是的！

column1: HEY! In your hand... Are those the Green Mushroom Caps and Blue Mushroom Caps I asked for? You got so many! Thank you! I feel soo much better. Muahaha, take that, mushrooms. Right back at ya, punks!
column2: 嘿！你手里的……就是我要的绿蘑菇帽和蓝蘑菇帽吗？你有这么多！谢谢你！我感觉好多了。哈哈哈，蘑菇，拿去吧。回到你们身边，朋克们！

column1: Oh yeah. This isn't much, but take it. Great work!
column2: 哦，是的。这虽然不多，但还是拿走吧。干得好！

column1: This scroll... I believe it can strengthen your helmet. It's easy to use too. Just open the Use tab of your Item Inventory, open your Equipment Inventory at the same time, then drag the scroll onto your helmet. There's a chance the scroll can fail, but life's risky like that.
column2: 这个卷轴……我相信它可以强化你的头盔。它也很容易使用。只需打开物品清单的“使用”选项卡，同时打开设备清单，然后将卷轴拖到头盔上即可。卷轴有可能会失败，但人生就是这么危险……

column1: I'll give you something really nice if you bring me 20 Green Mushroom Caps and 20 Blue Mushroom Caps . I always keep my word! Honest!
column2: 如果你给我带来 20 个绿色蘑菇帽和 20 个蓝色蘑菇帽，我会给你一些非常好的东西。我始终遵守诺言！诚实的！
随机奖励 - 以下之一：

column1: I met Camila in Henesys, and given her timid disposition, she asked me to deliver Sparkling Glass Marble to Utah for her. I heard that I can get to Utah's Pig Farm through The Forest East of Henesys.
column2: 听说射手村的卡米拉在担心什么事……我在射手村遇到了卡米拉。她性格有些胆小，拜托我把闪亮的玻璃珠送给犹他。听说可以通过射手村东边森林前往犹他的猪场……你把卡米拉的礼物交给了犹他。能把最珍贵的东西送给对方，他们一定是很亲密的朋友吧。希望我在旅途中也能遇到这样的朋友……

column1: My friend Utah grew up with me and has a birthday coming up in a few days. So, I've decided my gift will be my precious Sparkling Glass Marble.
column2: 我的朋友犹他和我一起长大，几天后就要过生日了。所以，我决定我的礼物将是我珍贵的闪闪发光的玻璃大理石。

column1: There's a problem, though. Utah hasn't been coming uptown lately, probably because he's been swarmed with work. I'd like to go there and give it to him myself, but the Super Ribbon Pigs that he raises scare me to death. Well... if you have any time, can you get this marble to Utah for me?
column2: 但有一个问题。犹他最近没有来住宅区，可能是因为工作繁忙。我很想去那里亲自送给他，但是他养的超级丝带猪把我吓死了。好吧...如果你有时间的话，你能帮我把这块大理石运到犹他州吗？

column1: Really? Thank you, thank you so much! Here's the marble. I even carved a message for Utah on it. You can get to Utah's farm through The Forest East of Henesys . Good luck!
column2: 真的吗？谢谢你，非常感谢你！这是大理石。我什至在上面刻了一条给犹他州的信息。穿过 射手村 东边的森林就可以到达犹他州的农场。祝你好运！

column1: Oh, I see. Sorry for asking. You must be a very busy person... Utah might be disappointed... sigh... what should I do now??
column2: 哦，我明白了。抱歉问了。你一定是个很忙的人...犹他可能会失望...叹息...我现在该怎么办？

column1: Who are you? Whoa, isn't that the marble that Camila so preciously takes care of? How did you get that??? What? Camila asked you to give me that for my birthday? Wow, that's just awesome. This is a very precious item, you know. Now that the farming is almost done, I may have to go see Camila to say thanks.
column2: 你是谁？哇，这不是卡米拉精心呵护的大理石吗？你是怎么得到的？？？什么？卡米拉让你送我这个作为我的生日礼物？哇，那太棒了。这是一件非常珍贵的物品，你知道。现在农事快完成了，我可能得去见卡米拉道谢了。

column1: Thanks for delivering Camila's present to me. Did you get my reward? Hopefully it'll help you on your journey.
column2: 谢谢你把卡米拉的礼物送给我。我的奖励你收到了吗？希望它能对您的旅程有所帮助。

column1: Who are you? This is our farm, and we raise a bunch of Super Ribbon Pigs . They are much stronger than the Ribbon Pigs that are raised out in the wild. Anyway, how can I help you?
column2: 你是谁？这是我们的农场，我们养了一群超级丝带猪。它们比野外饲养的丝带猪要强壮得多。不管怎样，我能帮你什么忙？

column1: Oh, the marble... Have you not seen Utah yet? Please get him the present before his birthday passes. Did you lose your way to Utah's Pig Farm by any chance?
column2: 哦，大理石……你还没见过犹他州吗？请在他生日之前给他送礼物。您是否在前往犹他州养猪场时迷路了？

column1: Head to The Forest East of Henesys and you'll see the entrance to Utah's Pig Farm . Avoid the Super Ribbon Pigs and traps and navigate your way through the hidden paths, and you'll find him.
column2: 前往赫尼西斯东部的森林，您会看到犹他州养猪场的入口。避开超级丝带猪和陷阱，穿过隐藏的小路，你就会找到他。

column1: Ah, did you lose the marble that I gave you by any chance? Someone picked it up from the streets a couple of minutes ago. This is something I really cherish, so please take good care of it, and get it to Utah ASAP.
column2: 啊，我给你的弹珠你是不是不小心弄丢了？几分钟前有人从街上捡到了它。这是我非常珍惜的东西，所以请好好保管它，并尽快将它运到犹他州。
随机奖励 - 以下之一：

column1: A girl named Maya in Henesys Townstreet has been ill for a long time. It looks like she can't live a normal life at all. I agreed to help her. Weird Medicine... What a strange name! She says she'll get a little better by taking that... I should go to Lith Harbor and see this guy Teo.
column2: 听说射手村的玛雅病得很重……射手村街道上有个叫玛雅的女孩长期生病。看起来她根本无法过正常生活。我答应帮助她。奇怪的药……名字真怪！她说吃了那个药会稍微好一点……我应该去明珠港找那个叫特奥的人……玛雅让我去找明珠港的特奥，于是我照做了。他答应只要我帮他拿到闪耀石头，就把奇怪的药给我。唉，他连给生病女孩的药都不肯免费给。

column1: Cough... cough... Oh, hello stranger. Sorry, but may I ask you for a favor? I've been sick for a while, and the doctors can't do anything. Lately, it has gotten so bad I can't even take care of myself.
column2: 咳嗽...咳嗽...哦，你好陌生人。抱歉，我可以请你帮个忙吗？我已经病了一段时间了，医生也无能为力。最近，情况变得如此糟糕，我什至无法照顾自己。

column1: Is there any way you can get me some Weird Medicine ? I am not sure exactly how to get that, but Teo from Lith Harbor may know a thing or two about it. Please help me. Cough, cough... Pardon me.
column2: 你有什么办法可以给我一些奇怪的药物吗？我不确定如何获得它，但来自 明珠港 的 特奥 可能对此略知一二。请帮我。咳咳咳……对不起。

column1: Did you need something from me? Hmm, Weird Medicine ?
column2: 你需要我帮忙吗？嗯，奇怪的药？

column1: You haven't met up with Teo yet? Teo from Lith Harbor can definitely help you find some Weird Medicine . Please... Talk to him for me.
column2: 你还没有和特奥见面吗？来自利斯港的泰奥绝对可以帮助你找到一些奇怪的药物。请...帮我和他谈谈...

column1: Near the ship The Victoria in Lith Harbor, I met a heavily bearded crewmember named Teo. He does have some Weird Medicine, but says that in order to use it properly, he needs a Sparkling Rock. He promised that if I bring it to him, he’ll gladly hand it over. To obtain the Sparkling Rock, I should head to Perion Department Store and speak with Sophia, the daughter of the inn’s owner.
column2: 在明珠港维多利亚号船附近，我遇到了一位满脸胡子的船员特奥。他确实有奇怪的药，但他说为了正确使用药，需要一块闪耀石头。他答应只要我带来闪耀石头，就会爽快把药交给我。要得到闪耀石头，应该去勇士部落杂货店找旅馆老板的女儿索菲亚。我见到了索菲亚。她说要制作闪耀石头，需要阿尔孔之血。

column1: Well, I do happen to have Weird Medicine , but I can't just hand it over. You see, I've tried using this potion several times, but I realized it doesn't work properly without a Sparkling Rock . If you bring that to me, then I'd be more than willing to hand the medicine over.
column2: 嗯，我确实有奇药，但我不能就这么交出去。你看，我已经多次尝试使用这种药水，但我意识到如果没有闪闪发光的岩石，它就无法正常工作。如果你把它带给我，那么我非常愿意把药交给我。

column1: You want to know how to get that rock? If I knew, I wouldn't be asking you for help! Here's the deal, head over to the general store in Perion Department Store , ask for the daughter of the owner, Sophia , and see if she knows anything. She may have a clue.
column2: 你想知道如何获得那块石头吗？如果我知道的话，我就不会向你求助了！话是这么说，去佩里昂百货商店的杂货店问问店主的女儿索菲亚，看看她是否知道什么。她或许有线索……

column1: You know how to get to Perion , don't you? Take the exit on the right from the harbor, go past Kerning City , up northwest. Then keep going east, and you'll find Perion . Sorry, is that common knowledge?
column2: 你知道怎么去勇士部落，不是吗？从港口右侧的出口出发，经过废弃都市，向西北方向行驶。然后继续向东走，你就会找到勇士部落。抱歉，这是常识吗？

column1: Oh, hello. How can I help you?
Didn't get the Sparkling Rock yet? Oh well, it's not the easiest thing to acquire. Ah, it's so gorgeous when it shines like a star... Hurry and go see Sophia at Perion Department Store.
column2: 还没拿到闪闪发光的石头吗？哦，好吧，这不是最容易获得的东西。啊，像星星一样闪闪发光的时候真是太美了……赶紧去勇士部落百货去找索菲亚吧。

column1: I met Sophia in Perion Department Store. She's working on her dream of becoming an alchemist. To make the sparkling rock, she says she needs 30 Squishy Liquids, 30 Leafs, 30 Octopus Legs and 1 Arcon's Blood. Everything looks reasonable enough... wait, Arcon's Blood?! Fortunately, Sophia knows where to get some. She says to have a chat with Manji, who's somewhere around Perion.
column2: 我在勇士部落杂货店见到了索菲亚。她正努力实现成为炼金术士的梦想。为了制作闪耀石头，她需要 30 个粘稠液体、30 片叶子、30 条章鱼脚和 1 个阿尔孔之血。看起来都还合理……等等，阿尔孔之血？！幸好索菲亚知道哪里可以弄到。她说去找勇士部落附近的麦吉谈谈。索菲亚告诉我，麦吉有制作闪耀石头的关键材料阿尔孔之血。

column1: So you're looking for a Sparkling Rock ? That stone is very rare. All right then, get me the items I list. Ready?
column2: 那么您正在寻找一块闪闪发光的岩石吗？那块石头非常罕见。好吧，那么，把我列出的项目给我。准备好？

column1: They say you can make a Sparkling Rock if you have 30 Squishy Liquids , 30 Leafs , 30 Octopus Legs , and 1 Arcon's Blood ... You should be able to get most of them... but Arcon's Blood is going to be a problem. You should ask Manji for help; he is somewhere in town.
column2: 他们说如果你有 30 个软液体、30 个叶子、30 个章鱼腿和 1 个阿肯之血，你就可以制作一块闪闪发光的岩石……你应该能够得到其中的大部分……但阿肯的血液将是一个问题。你应该向万吉寻求帮助；他在城里的某个地方。

column1: If you have 30 Squishy Liquids , 30 Leafs , 30 Octopus Legs , and 1 Arcon's Blood , you can make 1 Sparkling Rock ... You should ask Manji about the Arcon's Blood ... I think he is somewhere around Perion.
column2: 如果你有 30 块软液体、30 片叶子、30 条章鱼腿和 1 个阿尔孔之血，你就可以制作 1 个闪闪发光的岩石...你应该向曼吉询问阿尔孔之血的情况...我认为他在 勇士部落 附近的某个地方。

column1: I found Manji in Perion, and as expected, he was unwilling to give me any Arcon's Blood for free. He told me to go to the underground tunnel in the middle of the island, defeat 75 Zombie Mushrooms, and gather up 40 Charm of the Undead first. I practically shivered at how coldly Manji treated me... I almost regret agreeing to help Maya, but no one else seems willing to.
column2: 我在勇士部落找到了麦吉，果然他不愿意免费给我阿尔孔之血。他让我先去岛中央的地下通道，打倒 75 只僵尸蘑菇，并收集 40 个亡灵护符。麦吉冷淡的态度让我几乎打了个寒战……我差点后悔答应帮助玛雅，但似乎也没有别人愿意帮她……麦吉要求我打倒僵尸蘑菇并收集亡灵护符，作为交换给我阿尔孔之血。

column1: So you want to acquire Arcon's Blood ? Hah, that's not a task for a nobody like you. You can't obtain Arcon's Blood unless you're strong... If you really want it, prove me wrong and show me that you are worthy.
column2: 那么你想获得阿肯之血吗？哈，这不是像你这样的无名小卒能完成的任务。除非你足够强大，否则你无法获得阿肯之血...如果你真的想要它，请证明我错了，并向我证明你是值得的...

column1: There's an underground tunnel in the middle of this island... and in the deepest part live the mutants of Arcon. Take down 75 Zombie Mushrooms in the cave and collect 40 Charm of the Undead . Do you think you can handle it?
column2: 这座岛的中央有一条地下隧道……最深处住着阿尔肯的变种人。取下洞穴中的 75 个僵尸蘑菇并收集 40 个不死符咒。你认为你能应付吗？

column1: That's right... The Charm of the Undead looks like this Charm of the Undead . Get that into your naïve little head.
column2: 没错……亡灵符咒看起来就是这个亡灵符咒。把它记入你天真的小脑袋里。

column1: Hmmm... I may have underestimated you. All right, a promise is a promise. Here's the Arcon's Blood . Take it.
column2: 嗯……我可能低估了你。好吧，承诺就是承诺。这是阿肯之血。拿走吧。

column1: This bottle contains the blood of an Arcon I slew... Hopefully you'll use it wisely, because it's a rare, precious item.
column2: 这瓶里装的是我杀死的阿肯人的血液……希望你能明智地使用它，因为它是一件稀有而珍贵的物品……

column1: If you want the Arcon's Blood from me, go to the underground tunnel, defeat 75 Zombie Mushrooms , and bring me 40 Charm of the Undead . If you don't do at least that, I cannot possibly hand over the Arcon's Blood to a rookie like you.
column2: 如果你想从我这里得到阿肯之血，就去地下隧道，击败75个僵尸蘑菇，给我带来40个不死符咒。如果你连这一点都做不到，我不可能把阿肯之血交给你这样的菜鸟。

column1: What, can't even defeat 75 Zombie Mushrooms ? Hah.
column2: 什么，连75只僵尸蘑菇都打不过？哈...

column1: I gathered up 40 Charm of the Undead from the Ant Tunnel and gave them to Manji of Perion. Still cocky, still arrogant, but following through on his promise, he handed over Arcon's Blood to me. Maybe he isn't so horrible after all. Anyway, now I need to gather up 30 Squishy Liquids, 30 Leafs, 30 Octopus Legs, and the Arcon's Blood for Sophia.
column2: 我在蚂蚁洞收集了 40 个亡灵护符，并交给勇士部落的麦吉。他还是一副自大傲慢的样子，但总算遵守承诺，把阿尔孔之血交给了我。也许他并没有那么糟糕。总之，现在我需要收集 30 个粘稠液体、30 片叶子、30 条章鱼脚，再加上阿尔孔之血交给索菲亚。你把亡灵护符带给麦吉，终于得到了阿尔孔之血。应该赶快回去找索菲亚……

column1: By the way, what are you going to do with Arcon's Blood ? It's used as material for precious items, so... are you going to take it to Sophia ? Well, it's none of my business anyway.
column2: 顺便问一下，你打算用阿肯之血做什么？它被用作贵重物品的材料，所以……你要把它带给索菲亚吗？好吧，反正这不关我的事……

column1: How did you get all these items?? You must be really good! Especially Arcon's Blood . Wow... Anyway, good job! Now we can make a Sparkling Rock.
column2: 你是怎么得到所有这些物品的？你一定真的很优秀！尤其是阿尔孔之血。哇...无论如何，干得好！现在我们可以制作一块闪闪发光的岩石了。

column1: They say you can make a Sparkling Rock if you have 30 Squishy Liquids , 30 Leafs , 30 Octopus Legs , and 1 Arcon's Blood ... As for Arcon's Blood , you can ask Manji in Perion.
column2: 他们说如果你有30个软液体、30片叶子、30条章鱼腿和1个阿肯之血就可以制作闪闪发光的岩石……至于阿肯之血，你可以在佩里安问曼吉。

column1: By the way, what are you going to do with Arcon's Blood ? It's used as material for precious items, so... are you going to take it to Sophia ? Well, it's none of my business anyway.
column2: 顺便问一下，你打算用阿肯之血做什么？它被用作贵重物品的材料，所以……你要把它带给索菲亚吗？好吧，反正这不关我的事……

column1: By the way, what are you going to do with Arcon's Blood ? It's used as material for precious items, so... are you going to take it to Sophia ? Well, it's none of my business anyway.
column2: 顺便问一下，你打算用阿肯之血做什么？它被用作贵重物品的材料，所以……你要把它带给索菲亚吗？好吧，反正这不关我的事……

column1: Sophia looked genuinely surprised when I handed her all the materials needed for the Sparkling Rock. Well, it wasn't easy! Anyway, she hands over a Sparkling Rock made of the materials I gathered. Hmm, the Sparkling Rock...gives off a strange light and then... starts glittering, and... whoa, I understand why people want this! It's mesmerizing! Well, now I just have to trade it with Teo in Lith Harbor.
column2: 当我把制作闪耀石头所需的所有材料交给索菲亚时，她真的很惊讶。毕竟这可不容易！总之，她把用我收集的材料制成的闪耀石头交给了我。嗯，闪耀石头……散发出奇妙的光芒，然后开始闪闪发亮……哇，我明白为什么大家想要它了！真让人着迷！现在只要拿它去和明珠港的特奥交换就行了。索菲亚看到阿尔孔之血时吓了一跳，并为我做出了闪耀石头。那么，现在该回明珠港找特奥了吧？

column1: Here, take this Sparkling Rock . What do you plan on doing with it? It is a special item, indeed, but unless you're collecting stones, it's sort of useless.
column2: 来，拿走这块闪闪发光的岩石。你打算用它做什么？确实，这是一个特殊的物品，但除非你收集石头，否则它没什么用......

column1: Ohhh... This... It's a Sparkling Rock !! How did you get this? That's just incredible! How about trading that stone with me? I'll give you the Weird Medicine in return!
column2: 哦哦……这……是一块闪闪发光的石头！！你是怎么得到这个的？这太不可思议了！跟我交换那块石头怎么样？作为回报，我会给你奇药！

column1: Didn't get the Sparkling Rock yet? Oh well, it's not the easiest thing to acquire. Ah, it's so gorgeous when it shines like a star... Hurry and go see Sophia at the general store in Perion.
column2: 还没拿到闪闪发光的石头吗？哦，好吧，这不是最容易获得的东西。啊，像星星一样闪耀的时候真是太华丽了……赶紧去勇士部落的杂货店找索菲亚吧。

column1: What will you do with the Sparkling Rock ? That stone is coveted by many, but so many materials are needed to make it that you're actually the first one to ever gather all of them. Hopefully you'll put it to good use.
column2: 你会用闪闪发光的岩石做什么？许多人都渴望得到这块石头，但制作它需要大量材料，因此您实际上是第一个收集所有材料的人。希望你能好好利用它...

column1: Here, take this Sparkling Rock . What do you plan on doing with it? It is a special item, indeed, but unless you're collecting stones, it's sort of useless.
column2: 来，拿走这块闪闪发光的岩石。你打算用它做什么？确实，这是一个特殊的物品，但除非你收集石头，否则它没什么用......

column1: I gave the Sparkling Rock to Teo in Lith Harbor and received the Weird Medicine in return. Now, all I need to do is get this to Maya, and I'm done, but the more I think about it, the more I regret saying yes. Anyway, this medicine looks quite tasty. If I ever find myself thirsty and without any water, maybe I should just drink it myself. Hahaha.
column2: 我把闪耀石头交给明珠港的特奥，换来了奇怪的药。现在只要把它交给玛雅就完成了，但越想越后悔自己答应了这件事。话说这药看起来还挺好喝的。如果哪天我口渴又没有水，也许可以自己喝掉。哈哈哈……我回到射手村，把奇怪的药交给了玛雅。希望她喝下后能好起来。作为谢礼，玛雅给了我 5000 金币和一顶褐色竹帽。这顶帽子……看起来在烈日下走路时能派上用场，但实在又旧又破……戴上去还会发出奇怪的声音，感觉里面有虫子在爬……我真的没问题吧……

column1: Thank you!! We can finally use this medicine properly now. It seems that Maya from Henesys has fallen ill again. If you bring this to her, it should help ease her condition a little.
column2: 谢谢你！！现在终于可以正常使用这个药了。 射手村的玛雅似乎又病倒了。如果你把这个带给她，应该能稍微缓解她的状况……

column1: Darn... My whole body's aching... What, oh my... Isn't that the Weird Medicine ?? How did you get it?? Wow, you must be amazing.
column2: 妈的……浑身酸痛……什么，天哪……这不是怪药吗？？你是怎么得到的？？哇，你一定很了不起。

column1: Um... Is it okay if I have that? I'll give you something that I don't really need in return... I urge you... please... I need that medicine.
column2: 嗯……如果我有的话可以吗？我会给你一些我并不真正需要的回报...我恳求你...求你...我需要那种药...

column1: Thank you so much... this may cure my longtime sickness after all... here's something I don't really need... hopefully it'll help you through your journey... here are some mesos too, as a sign of my appreciation.
column2: 非常感谢...这毕竟可以治愈我长期的疾病...这是我并不真正需要的东西...希望它能帮助您完成您的旅程...这里还有一些小金币，作为我的感激之情...

column1: Haven't met Teo yet? Teo from Lith Harbor can definitely help you find Weird Medicine . Please find him.
column2: 还没有见过特奥吗？来自明珠港的特奥绝对可以帮助你找到奇怪的药物。请找到他。

column1: Hurry and give Maya the Weird Medicine that I gave you. Henesys is very far from here, so make sure you don't lose it along the way...!
column2: 快点把我给你的奇怪药物给玛雅。 射手村离这里很远，所以一定要注意别在路上迷路了……！

column1: Thank you!!! Please take this medicine in return. Maya from Henesys is sick again. This will take care of the sickness a little bit.
column2: 谢谢！请服用此药作为回报。 射手村 的玛雅人又病了。这样可以稍微缓解一下病情...

column1: At the dungeon entrance, I met Luke, the guard. He said he wanted to make a nourishing meal for his mother and asked me to hunt 20 Jr. Neckis and 20 Stirges, then bring back 10 Jr. Necki Skins, 10 Stirge Wings, and 1 Salad. He said he’s too busy with his guard duties... but honestly, he just looks like he’s about to fall asleep...?!
column2: 去射手村迷宫入口见警卫鲁克吧。在迷宫入口，我遇到了守卫鲁克。他说想给母亲做一顿滋补餐，拜托我狩猎 20 只小青蛇和 20 只蝙蝠魔，并带回 10 张小青蛇皮、10 个蝙蝠魔翅膀和 1 份沙拉。他说自己忙着站岗……但老实说，他看起来都快睡着了……！你把鲁克要求的材料带给了守在迷宫入口的他。既然他要做“蛇饮”……我自己也想尝尝！作为回报，鲁克给了我一颗在附近发现的精炼宝石。精炼宝石又不会从天上掉下来……是不是有旅人弄丢的？总之，等“蛇饮”做好后我应该再来看看……

column1: Hmmm... Wait! You must be pretty strong, huh? I have a favor to ask you... As a good son, every year I make my mom a special, healthy, and tasty drink, but I don't have any free time these days because of my job guarding this spot. I'm sorry, but can you help me get the ingredients I need for the drink?
column2: 嗯……等等！你一定很强吧？我有件事想拜托你……作为一个好儿子，每年我都会给妈妈做一杯特别的、健康的、美味的饮料，但这些天我因为看守这里的工作而没有任何空闲时间。抱歉，你能帮我找到制作饮料所需的原料吗？

column1: All right! This year, I'm trying to make my mom a very tasty Snake Drink! Can you hunt some monsters and bring me 10 Jr. Necki Skins , 10 Stirge Wings , and, for dessert, 1 Salad please? Please find me once you've gathered everything up!
column2: 好吧！今年，我想给我妈妈做一杯非常美味的蛇饮料！你能猎杀一些怪物并给我带来 10 个 小青蛇 Skins、10 个 蝙蝠 Wings 和 1 份沙拉作为甜点吗？收集完所有东西后请来找我！

column1: Must be busy here and there, huh? Please come back and do me this favor when you have some spare time.
column2: 一定很忙吧？当你有空的时候，请回来帮我这个忙。

column1: Oh wow... You actually got everything!! This will definitely help me make a very tasty Snake Drink... It's a rare drink, so I usually wouldn't share it with anyone else, but I'll make an exception for you... When the drink is done, please drop by and have some with us. Promise?
column2: 哦哇...你真的得到了一切！这肯定会帮助我制作出非常美味的蛇饮......这是一种难得的饮料，所以我通常不会与其他人分享它，但我会破例给你......当饮料喝完后，请过来和我们一起喝一些。承诺？

column1: Oh yeah... Since you worked hard to get me all the ingredients, I need to give you something in return. Now, what would be good... Oh yeah! Around here, you tend to see lots of shiny, sparkling objects. I've collected a lot of them, but as of this moment, this one is yours. It'll help you through your journey. Here, take it.
column2: 哦对了……既然你辛辛苦苦给了我所有的材料，我就得给你点东西作为回报。现在，有什么好的...哦，是的！在这里，您常常会看到许多闪闪发光的物体。我收集了很多，但从现在起，这个就是你的了。它将帮助您完成您的旅程。在这里，拿走吧。

column1: Got it? Thanks for your help... Now I must rush back home! So long!
column2: 明白了吗？谢谢你的帮助...现在我必须赶回家了！这么久！

column1: I'm trying to make my mom a very tasty Snake Drink! Can you get me 10 Jr. Necki Skins , 10 Stirge Wings , and, for dessert, 1 Salad please? Please find me once you have gathered them all up!
column2: 我正在努力给我妈妈做一杯非常美味的蛇饮料！您能给我 10 个 小青蛇 Skins、10 个 蝙蝠 Wings 和 1 份沙拉作为甜点吗？集齐后请来找我！

column1: Don't forget to defeat the monsters too!

column2: 随机奖励 - 以下之一：

column1: I met Luke at the entrance of the dungeon again. The Snake Drink from back then is gone now because he and his mom drank it all... Anyway, Luke said he’s done with the boring life of a security guard and has decided to go on an adventure. To make a glove fit for the journey, Silas Irons of Perion asked for 1 Black Feather, 10 Orihalcon Ingots, 30 Drake Skulls, 20 Dragon Skins, and 20 Screws! I’m guessing he wants me to gather them for him... Oh, and apparently, the fairies of Ellinia might know something about Black Feather~
column2: 听说警卫鲁克下定了某个决心……我再次在迷宫入口见到了鲁克。之前的蛇饮已经没了，因为他和妈妈全喝完了……总之，鲁克说他厌倦了无聊的守卫生活，决定踏上冒险。为了制作适合旅途的手套，勇士部落的西拉斯·艾恩斯需要 1 根黑羽毛、10 个锂矿锭、30 个飞龙头骨、20 张龙皮和 20 个螺丝！我猜他是想让我帮忙收集……哦，听说魔法密林的妖精也许知道黑羽毛的事。我把鲁克制作手套所需的材料带给他，并收到了他家传的宝物头盔青铜十字军头盔作为回报。感觉我好像有点吃亏……不过既然是代代相传的传家宝，也不好抱怨……

column1: Hey! You're the one that helped me make a tasty Snake Drink for my mom! I'm sorry to say this, but... my mom and I drank it all... hehe... Anyway, you look much stronger than before! Maybe you could even surpass me one day... Well, that's not going to happen, hahahaha.
column2: 嘿！你是帮助我为我妈妈制作美味蛇饮料的人！很抱歉这么说，但是……我和妈妈都喝光了……呵呵……总之，你看起来比以前坚强多了！说不定有一天你能超越我……好吧，那是不可能的，哈哈哈哈……

column1: Okay, I think you can do it since you've gotten much stronger since then... I've actually been thinking about going on a journey somewhere... I'm getting tired of being the security guy here... I'm trying to make solid equipment for myself to do that, so I visited Silas Irons in Perion , and... he wants me to get some RIDICULOUS materials for it!!! Those are so rare to begin with.
column2: 好吧，我想你可以做到，因为从那时起你已经变得更强大了......我实际上一直在考虑去某个地方旅行......我厌倦了在这里当保安......我试图为自己制造坚固的设备来做到这一点，所以我拜访了勇士部落的塞拉斯·艾恩斯，并且......他想让我为此获得一些可笑的材料！这些一开始就很少见...

column1: I'm trying to be a warrior, and um... can you get me the materials Silas Irons asked for? I tried, but it's too hard for me... Don't worry, I'll reward you well for your work. What do you think? Isn't it good for both of us?
column2: 我想成为一名战士，嗯……你能给我塞拉斯·艾恩斯想要的材料吗？我尝试过，但这对我来说太难了……别担心，我会好好奖励你的工作的。你怎么认为？这对我们双方都好不是吗？

column1: Yes! Actually, I really wanted to make a nice pair of gloves... and to make it, I need 1 Black Feather , 10 Orihalcon Ingots , 30 Drake Skulls , 20 Dragon Skins , and 20 Screws . Oh, the fairies might know about Black Feather . All right, I'm counting on you! If you get me the materials, I'll definitely give you something nice in return.
column2: 是的！其实我很想制作一双漂亮的手套……而制作它需要1个黑羽毛、10个奥里哈康锭、30个龙头骨、20个龙皮和20个螺丝。哦，仙女们可能都知道黑羽吧。好吧，我就指望你了！如果你给我材料，我一定会给你一些好东西作为回报。

column1: You must be really busy right now. If you ever have spare time, please come back and do me that favor! It's very important to me!
column2: 你现在一定很忙吧。如果你有空的话，请回来帮我一个忙！这对我来说非常重要！

column1: Oh my goodness, I can't believe you got everything! Sweet! If I get this to Silas Irons ... wow, it's going to be one incredible glove... Oh yeah, I'll give you something good for doing me a favor. This helmet has been passed down in my family for generations, so please take good care of it.
column2: 天啊，我不敢相信你已经拥有了一切！甜的！如果我把这个送给塞拉斯·艾恩斯……哇，这将是一只令人难以置信的手套……哦，是的，我会给你一些好东西，因为你帮了我一个忙。这顶头盔是我家世代相传的，请好好保管。

column1: You got the Bronze Crusader Helm , right? Thanks for your hard work. It'll definitely help you on your journey, so use it well! Well then, time to go make these gloves.
column2: 你有青铜十字军头盔，对吧？感谢您的辛勤工作。它一定会对你的旅途有所帮助，所以好好利用它吧！那么，是时候去制作这些手套了......

column1: You haven't gotten all the materials needed for the gloves yet? Get me 1 Black Feather , 10 Orihalcon Ingots , 30 Drake Skulls , 20 Dragon Skins , and 20 Screws ! The fairies may know something about Black Feather . Keep working!
column2: 你还没有拿到手套所需的所有材料吗？给我 1 根黑色羽毛、10 颗奥瑞哈康锭、30 颗龙头骨、20 块龙皮和 20 颗螺丝！对于黑羽，仙子们或许有所了解。继续工作！
随机奖励 - 以下之一：

column1: I got a request from Maya of Henesys, who has been collecting various items. She wanted 20 each of Orange Mushroom Cap, Green Mushroom Cap, Blue Mushroom Cap, and Horny Mushroom Cap. Maybe... well it looks like I can get these from the monsters around the prairie.
column2: 去射手村找玛雅。我接到了射手村玛雅的请求，她一直在收集各种东西。她想要绿蘑菇盖、刺蘑菇盖、蓝蘑菇盖和绿蘑菇盖各 20 个。也许……看起来可以从草原附近的怪物身上获得。你收集齐了玛雅要求的所有东西，但什么时候才能拿到报酬？什么？还要做多少次？

column1: Hey, you're the one who got me the medicine! I'm feeling much better now, thanks to you. And you look good too. You look strong, perhaps even stronger than Athena Pierce ! Hehe, just kidding.
column2: 嘿，你就是给我拿药的人！谢谢你，我现在感觉好多了。而且你看起来也不错。你看上去很强，甚至比赫丽娜还强！呵呵，开玩笑的。

column1: Anyway, can you do me a favor? I'm collecting some odds and ends, in hopes of creating something amazing with them! Can you help me grab a few things?
column2: 不管怎样，你能帮我一个忙吗？我正在收集一些零碎的东西，希望能用它们创造出一些令人惊奇的东西！你能帮我拿一些东西吗？

column1: Thanks! Can you get 20 each of Orange Mushroom Caps , Green Mushroom Caps , Blue Mushroom Caps , and Horny Mushroom Caps ? Do you think it'll be too boring to hunt weak monsters? Hehe... Well, this is just the beginning. Then, I'll leave it to you!
column2: 谢谢！您能获得橙色蘑菇帽、绿色蘑菇帽、蓝色蘑菇帽和角质蘑菇帽各 20 个吗？你是否觉得猎杀弱小怪物太无聊了？呵呵……好吧，这只是开始。那么，就交给你了！

column1: Oh, you must be really busy right now... but please get back to me if you have time later. I would like to get everything myself, but I'm not fully recovered.
column2: 哦，你现在一定很忙……但是如果你稍后有时间的话请回复我。我想自己得到一切，但我还没有完全康复......

column1: Wow! You got them all! This was too easy for you, right? Anyway, thank you for the items, but I'm not done yet.
column2: 哇！你都得到了！这对你来说太容易了，对吧？无论如何，谢谢你的物品，但我还没完成......

column1: I got it. Thank you so much! But I still need many more items, so please talk to me again when you're ready!
column2: 我明白了。太感谢了！但我还需要更多物品，所以请在准备好后再次与我联系！

column1: You haven't collected 20 each of Orange Mushroom Cap , Green Mushroom Cap , Blue Mushroom Cap , and Horny Mushroom Cap ... Keep at it! I'll give you something good if you do.
column2: 您还没有收集到橙色蘑菇帽、绿色蘑菇帽、蓝色蘑菇帽和角质蘑菇帽各 20 个……继续努力！如果你愿意的话我会给你一些好东西。

column1: This time Maya wanted 20 each of Pig's Ribbon, Bubbling's Huge Bubble, Fire Boar's Tooth, and Tablecloth. Apparently, I can get those by hunting monsters around the plateau, subway station, and prairies... well, that's easy!
column2: 这次玛雅想要猪的丝带、大幽灵泡泡、火野猪的牙和桌布各 20 个。据说可以通过狩猎高原、地铁站和草原一带的怪物获得……嗯，这很简单！你收集齐了玛雅要求的所有东西。拜托别告诉我她想免费拿走这些……

column1: Oh... You came back to see me again! Don't go too fast, though! Okay! Would you please get me 20 each of Pig's Ribbon , Bubbling's Huge Bubble , Fire Boar's Tooth , and Tablecloth ?
column2: 哦……你又回来看我了！不过，别走得太快！好的！猪的丝带、泡泡的大泡泡、火野猪的牙齿和桌布各给我 20 块好吗？

column1: Thanks! I think you'll have to travel all over the place to get these items. If you collect them all, please get back to me. I will wait right here.
column2: 谢谢！我想你必须走遍整个地方才能得到这些物品。如果你收集齐了，请回复我。我就在这里等。

column1: Oh, you must be really busy right now... but please get back to me if you have time later. I would like to get everything myself, but I'm not fully recovered.
column2: 哦，你现在一定很忙……但是如果你稍后有时间的话请回复我。我想自己得到一切，但我还没有完全康复......

column1: Wow! You got them all! This one was little bit harder than the last one, right? But nothing is too hard for you... Anyway, thank you for the items, but I'm still not done.
column2: 哇！你都得到了！这一篇比上一篇难一点，对吧？但对你来说没有什么是太难的......不管怎样，谢谢你的物品，但我还没完成......

column1: I got everything. Thank you so much.
column2: 我得到了一切。太感谢了。

column1: You haven't collected 20 each of Pig's Ribbon , Bubbling's Huge Bubble , Fire Boar's Tooth , and Tablecloth ... Keep at it! I'll give you something good if you do.
column2: 您还没有收集到猪丝带、泡泡大泡泡、火猪牙和桌布各 20 个……继续努力！如果你愿意的话我会给你一些好东西。

column1: Maya requested 30 each of Iron Hog's Metal Hoof, Lupin Doll, Cold Eye Tail, and Tortie Shell. Apparently, I can get those through monsters in the highland, beach, and prairie. This is getting harder now.
column2: 玛雅要求铁甲猪的金属蹄、猴子娃娃、冰独眼兽尾巴和龟壳各 30 个。据说可以从高地、海滩和草原的怪物身上获得。现在开始变难了……你收集齐了玛雅要求的所有东西。还是没有报酬？到底还要做多少次？

column1: Oh... Are you ready? Don't go too fast, though! Okay, would you please get 30 each of Iron Hog's Metal Hoof , Lupin Doll , Cold Eye Tail , and Tortie Shell ?
column2: 哦...你准备好了吗？不过，别走得太快！好的，铁猪的金属蹄、羽扇豆娃娃、冷眼尾巴和玳瑁壳各 30 个好吗？

column1: Thanks! I think you'll have to travel all over the place to get these items. If you collect them all, please get back to me. I will wait right here.
column2: 谢谢！我想你必须走遍整个地方才能得到这些物品。如果你收集齐了，请回复我。我就在这里等。

column2: 哇！你都得到了！这一篇比上一篇难一点，对吧？但对你来说没有什么是太难的......不管怎样，谢谢你的物品，但我还没完成......

column1: I got everything. Thank you so much. But I'm still not done, so please talk to me again when you're ready.
column2: 我得到了一切。太感谢了。但我还没说完，所以请等你准备好后再跟我说话。

column1: You haven't collected 30 each of Iron Hog's Metal Hoof , Lupin Doll , Cold Eye Tail , and Tortie Shell ... Keep at it! I'll give you something good if you do.
column2: 您尚未集齐铁猪的金属蹄、羽扇豆玩偶、冷眼尾和玳瑁壳各 30 个……继续努力！如果你愿意的话我会给你一些好东西。

column1: Maya asked me to gather some items: 1 Diamond, and 50 each of Stone Golem Rubble and Dark Stone Golem Rubble. Apparently, I can get them by defeating monsters at the Golem’s Temple on the way from Henesys to the Dungeon... but this is way too tough!
column2: 去射手村找玛雅。玛雅让我收集一些物品：1 个钻石，以及石头人碎片和黑石头人碎片各 50 个。据说可以在从射手村前往迷宫路上的石头人寺院击败怪物获得……但这也太难了！你终于收集齐玛雅最后一次要求的所有物品……真的是最后一次吗？作为谢礼，她给了你一件她奶奶为这个村子的长老赫丽娜做的披风。虽然年代久远，但看起来仍然像新的一样！

column1: Since you're here, could you do me a small favor? I've been collecting all sorts of items lately -- I think I might be able to create something new with them! So, could you gather some monster drops for me? It shouldn't be too hard!
column2: 既然你来了，能帮我一个小忙吗？我最近一直在收集各种各样的物品——我想我也许可以用它们创造一些新的东西！那么，你能为我收集一些怪物掉落物吗？应该不会太难！

column1: Could you bring me 50 Stone Golem Rubbles , 50 Dark Stone Golem Rubbles , and 1 Diamond , please?
column2: 请给我 50 个石傀儡碎石、50 个暗石傀儡碎石和 1 颗钻石好吗？

column1: Thank you so much! You can find what you need at the Golem's Temple, on the way from Henesys to the dungeon. Once you've gathered everything, please come back and find me. I'll be waiting for you right here.
column2: 非常感谢！你可以在从赫尼西斯到地牢的路上的魔像神庙找到你需要的东西。当你收集完所有东西后，请回来找我。我会在这里等你。

column1: Oh, you must be really busy right now... but please get back to me if you have time later. I would like to get everything myself, but I'm not fully recovered.
column2: 哦，你现在一定很忙……但是如果你稍后有时间的话请回复我。我想自己得到一切，但我还没有完全康复......

column1: Wow! You got them all! This one was little bit harder than the last one, right? But nothing is too hard for you... Anyway, thank you for collecting all of those items. Now, I have everything I need.
column2: 哇！你都得到了！这一篇比上一篇难一点，对吧？但对你来说没有什么是太难的......无论如何，感谢你收集所有这些物品。现在，我拥有了我需要的一切。

column1: I've received all the items you collected. Thank you so much. You must have gone to a lot of trouble, yet you never once complained. As a token of my gratitude, I'd like to give you a cape that was tucked away deep inside our family chest. It was something my grandmother made long ago for Athena Pierce , but the great war ended before she ever got to deliver it... Still, I'd like you to have it. Please treasure it!
column2: 我已经收到了你收集的所有物品。太感谢了。你一定经历了很多麻烦，但你却从未抱怨过。为了表达我的感激之情，我想送给你一件藏在我们家箱子深处的斗篷。这是我祖母很久以前为赫丽娜制作的东西，但在她交付它之前，伟大的战争就结束了……不过，我希望你能拥有它。请珍惜！

column1: It seems you haven't gathered all the items I mentioned yet: 50 Stone Golem Rubbles , 50 Dark Stone Golem Rubbles , and 1 Diamond . Don't give up! If you help me out, I'll give you something really nice in return.
column2: 看来你还没有集齐我提到的所有物品：50 个石傀儡碎石、50 个暗石傀儡碎石和 1 颗钻石。不要放弃！如果你帮助我，我会给你一些非常好的回报。

column1: I ran into that same teddy-bear-costume-wearing Pia at the Henesys Park. I did her a favor and took care of the Blue Mushrooms before. This time, she wants to make a claw as a present for a friend in Ellinia who wants to go out on a journey. The claw she wants to make requires 15 Silver Ingots, 30 Dragon Skins, and 30 Screws... If I get her all these... am I going to be richly rewarded?
column2: 去射手村找皮亚吧。我在射手村公园再次遇到了那个穿泰迪熊服装的皮亚。之前我帮她教训过蓝蘑菇。这次，她想为魔法密林一位准备踏上旅途的朋友制作拳套。制作她想要的拳套需要 15 个银锭、30 张龙皮和 30 个螺丝……如果我帮她收集这些……会不会有丰厚奖励？皮亚拜托我给她那位准备出发冒险的朋友准备礼物，我也帮她带回来了。但看来光这样还不够。

column1: Oh, you're the one who beat the Blue Mushrooms for me. You look much stronger than before. Did my scroll help you? Hehe... Anyway, good. Since you look strong, I would like to ask you a favor... Will you help me?
column2: 哦，你是为我击败蓝蘑菇的人。你看上去比以前坚强多了。我的卷轴对你有帮助吗？呵呵……总之，很好。看在你看起来很坚强的份上，我想拜托你一件事……你能帮我吗？

column1: One of my friends in Ellinia wants to be an adventurer. After some training, he'll start traveling soon... I would like to give him something special! So I asked JM From tha Streetz in Kerning City to make me a good claw, but he needed some weird stuff to make it.
column2: 我在魔法密林的一个朋友想成为一名冒险家。经过一些训练后，他很快就会开始旅行......我想给他一些特别的东西！所以我请来自废弃都市的 Streetz 的 JM 给我做一个好爪子，但他需要一些奇怪的东西来制作。

column1: So could you get the materials JM From tha Streetz wants for me? I'd like to get them myself, but I can't move because of this stupid costume! Of course, I'll pay you if you do this for me... If you're not busy, can you please help me?
column2: 那么你能为我提供 后街吉姆 想要的材料吗？我很想自己去拿，但我因为这件愚蠢的服装而动弹不得！当然，如果你帮我做这件事，我会付钱给你……如果你不忙的话，可以帮我一个忙吗？

column1: Thanks! I need 15 Silver Ingots , 30 Dragon Skins , and 30 Screws . Then, I'll leave it to you!
column2: 谢谢！我需要15块银锭，30块龙皮，30颗螺丝。那么，就交给你了！

column1: You must be very busy... If you have time later, please get back to me! My friend will set out soon.
column2: 你一定很忙吧...如果你稍后有时间的话请回复我！我的朋友很快就要出发了...

column1: It's the perfect time of year for an adventure!
column2: 这是一年中冒险的最佳时机！

column1: So you haven't gotten all the materials yet? Please get 15 Silver Ingots , 30 Dragon Skins , and 30 Screws.
column2: 那么你还没有拿到所有材料吗？请领取15块银锭、30块龙皮、30颗螺丝……

column1: Pia also asked me to retrieve the Red Cape that Rina in Henesys borrowed for her friend. I’ll probably get something nice if I bring it back to her.
column2: 去射手村找皮亚吧。皮亚还拜托我把丽娜借给她朋友的红披风取回来。如果我拿回来，她大概会给我不错的东西。我去找丽娜要皮亚的披风，但丽娜说，在皮亚归还从她那里借走的东西之前，她会一直保管这件披风。她说只要拿回皮亚借走的东西，就会把披风还给我。

column1: Thanks to you, I think I was able to finally prepare a gift for my friend. But... somehow, it still feels like something's missing.
column2: 多亏了你，我想我终于能够为我的朋友准备一份礼物了。但……不知怎的，总感觉少了点什么。

column1: Right! I also need a cape for my friend! A few days ago, I lent a Red Cape to Rina in Henesys , and I'd like you to get it back for me. I'm sure my friend will need it. How about it, will you help me?
column2: 对了！我还需要一件斗篷给我的朋友！几天前，我把一件红色斗篷借给了赫尼西斯的莉娜，我希望你能帮我把它拿回来。我确信我的朋友会需要它。怎么样，你能帮我吗？

column1: Please! If you can gather everything for me, I'll be able to make something to help my friend on their journey!
column2: 拜托！如果你能为我收集所有东西，我就能够做一些东西来帮助我的朋友完成他们的旅程！

column1: You must be very busy... If you have time later, please get back to me! My friend will set out soon.
column2: 你一定很忙吧...如果你稍后有时间的话请回复我！我的朋友很快就要出发了...

column1: Hi. Nice weather, isn't it? What? You want the Red Cape that I borrowed from Pia ?
column2: 嗨。天气真好，不是吗？什么？你想要我从皮娅那里借来的红斗篷吗？

column1: Hmm... I should say... "No"... because I didn't borrow it from Pia . Pia took some things that were precious to me and never gave them back. So I took this cape from her in return. Therefore, no. I can't give this cape to you.
column2: 嗯……我应该说……“不”……因为我不是从皮亚那里借来的。皮娅拿走了一些对我来说很珍贵的东西，再也没有还给我。所以我从她那里拿走了这件斗篷作为回报。因此，不。我不能把这斗篷给你。

column1: You can get the Red Cape from Rina in Henesys.
column2: 你可以从 射手村 的 丽娜 那里得到红斗篷......

column1: I went to see Rina in Henesys, and instead, she tells me she took that red cape because Pia didn't return the items she borrowed from her. She said that she would return the cape if she gets her items back... the items are 1 Black Crystal, 1 Ancient Scroll, and 30 Medicine With Weird Vibes.
column2: 看来丽娜不归还皮亚借走的东西也有自己的理由。我去射手村找丽娜，她反而告诉我，是因为皮亚没有归还从她那里借走的物品，她才拿走了红披风。她说如果把那些物品还给她，就会归还披风……物品是 1 个黑水晶、1 张古代卷轴和 30 个奇怪感觉的药。我替皮亚偿还了欠丽娜的东西，并拿回了红披风。现在只要把它带回给皮亚就行了吧？

column1: Hmm... If you really need this, you should give back the things that Pia took. Then, I will give the Red Cape to you.
column2: 嗯……如果你真的需要这个，就应该把皮娅拿走的东西还给我。那么，我就把红斗篷送给你。

column1: How about it? Would you like to pay off her debt and take it with you? Of course, the things Pia borrowed were all... very precious, you know.
column2: 怎么样？你愿意帮她还清债务并带走吗？当然，皮娅借的东西都是……非常珍贵的，你知道的……

column1: Really? You must be really close to Pia . Anyway, okay. I need 1 Black Crystal , 1 Ancient Scroll , and 30 Medicine With Weird Vibes . I spent years collecting all these and Pia just took them!!!
column2: 真的吗？你一定和皮娅很亲近吧。无论如何，好吧。我需要1个黑晶，1个上古卷轴，还有30颗异味药剂。我花了好几年的时间收集所有这些，而皮亚就把它们拿走了！

column1: Well... If you get me all that, I'll definitely give you the Red Cape in return. Oh! The Dark Stone Golems probably have the Ancient Scroll.
column2: 好吧……如果你得到了我所有这些，我一定会给你红斗篷作为回报。哦！暗石傀儡很可能拥有上古卷轴。

column1: Okay. You don't have to pay the debt, when you weren't even the borrower. Anyway, please tell Pia that if she wants to get the cape back, she should return the things she took from me.
column2: 好的。当您甚至不是借款人时，您不必偿还债务。不管怎样，请告诉皮娅，如果她想拿回斗篷，就应该把从我这里拿走的东西还给她。

column1: M-my things! I thought I'd never see them again! Take the Red Cape back, as we promised!
column2: 我、我的东西！我以为我再也见不到他们了！正如我们所承诺的，夺回红斗篷！

column1: You haven't collected 1 Black Crystal , 1 Ancient Scroll , and 30 Medicine With Weird Vibes . I will give Pia's Red Cape back to you if you return these things to me!
column2: 你还没有收集到1个黑水晶、1个上古卷轴和30个异味药剂。如果你把这些东西还给我，我就把皮娅的红斗篷还给你！

column1: I got my hands on the Red Cape that Pia asked for. Now I just need to bring it back to her.
column2: 看来丽娜准备归还借走的红披风了。我拿到了皮亚要求的红披风。现在只要把它带回给她就可以了。我把制作拳套所需的材料交给射手村公园的皮亚，并收到了卷轴。不知道皮亚的朋友现在是否已经踏上旅途。谁知道呢——也许我在旅途中还会遇见对方！

column1: Wow! You collected everything...!! Great! Okay then, I will give the Red Cape back, as promised. Hmm... I liked this cape a lot... Well... a promise is a promise... Take it...!
column2: 哇！你收集了一切...!!伟大的！好吧，那我就按照约定把红斗篷还给你了。嗯……我很喜欢这个斗篷……嗯……承诺就是承诺……接受吧……！

column1: Wow! You got everything! Okay. Now I can just give these to JM From tha Streetz and get the claw. Oh yeah, I'll give you something good, something my mom gave me to only use when I really need it. It will be a lot of help for you.
column2: 哇！你得到了一切！好的。现在我可以把这些交给 Streetz 的 JM 并得到爪子。哦，是的，我会给你一些好东西，一些我妈妈给我的东西，只在我真正需要的时候使用。这会对你有很大的帮助。

column1: Got it? Thanks for helping me. I hope the scroll will be very helpful. I should hurry and get going to Kerning City !
column2: 明白了吗？谢谢你帮助我。我希望卷轴会很有帮助。我得赶紧去废弃都市了！

column1: Have you brought the item I asked for yet? I need you to get back the Red Cape I lent to Rina.
column2: 我要的东西你带来了吗？我需要你把我借给莉娜的红斗篷拿回来。

column1: Oh... You're the one who paid back what Pia took. How's Pia doing? When you're in Henesys , say hello to Pia for me.
column2: 噢...你是皮亚所拿走的东西的偿还者。皮娅怎么样了？当你在 射手村 时，请代我向 皮亚 打个招呼。

column1: Oh my, you lost the Red Cape ? You're lucky, you know. I actually found it while I was out for a walk. Here--make sure you don't lose it again!
column2: 天啊，你把红斗篷丢了？你很幸运，你知道。其实是我出去散步的时候发现的。在这里——确保你不会再失去它！
随机奖励 - 以下之一：

column1: I got to meet Bruce, who has been studying monsters and animals in Henesys. His bright smile and the easygoing demeanor belies the painful fact that his daughter has been missing for some time, and that he's been studying the mushroom monsters for the sake of finding clues of his daughter's whereabouts. He asks me if I can help him out, and I just can't say no to a worthy cause like this.
column2: 我应该去射手村找布鲁斯……我见到了在射手村研究怪物和动物的布鲁斯。他灿烂的笑容和随和的态度背后，隐藏着女儿失踪已久的痛苦事实。他研究蘑菇怪物，也是为了寻找女儿下落的线索。他问我能不能帮忙。面对这样值得帮助的事，我实在无法拒绝……你帮布鲁斯收集到了研究所需的材料。这些能帮助他找到女儿吗？

column1: Hey there, kid. Yes, you! I am a scientist that specializes in the field of monsters and animals in this world. If you have any time available, would you mind helping this old man out?
column2: 嘿，孩子。是的，就是你！我是一名专门研究这个世界的怪物和动物领域的科学家。如果你有时间的话，能帮帮这位老人吗？

column1: Thank you. I have been studying the mushroom monsters, and--speaking of mushroom monsters, this reminds me of something.
column2: 谢谢你。我一直在研究蘑菇怪，说到蘑菇怪，这让我想起一件事。

column1: Years ago, my daughter and I went out of town in search of research materials. While we were busy excavating, we were ambushed by an enormous mushroom monster.
column2: 几年前，我和女儿出城寻找研究材料。当我们忙着挖掘时，我们遭到了巨大蘑菇怪物的伏击。

column1: By the time I regained consciousness, I had been severely battered and bruised, and my daughter was nowhere to be found. Ever since the incident, I have been studying mushroom monsters in hopes of finding some clues of my daughter's whereabouts.
column2: 等我回过神来时，我已是遍体鳞伤，女儿也不知去向。自从事件发生后，我就一直在研究蘑菇怪物，希望能找到一些关于我女儿下落的线索。

column1: Oh, I'm rambling again. Anyway, I would appreciate it a great deal if you could hunt 20 Shrooms and Orange Mushrooms and get me 10 Mushroom Spores and 10 Orange Mushroom Caps . Thank you!
column2: 哦，我又跑题了。不管怎样，如果你能猎取 20 个蘑菇和橙色蘑菇并给我带来 10 个蘑菇孢子和 10 个橙色蘑菇帽，我将不胜感激。谢谢你！

column1: I would appreciate it a good deal if you could help me out, but alas, if you're busy.
column2: 如果你能帮助我，我将不胜感激，但是，如果你很忙的话......

column1: You brought everything! Thank you, thank you! I shall start studying these samples carefully. Oh, I almost forgot to reward you for your hard work.
column2: 你把一切都带来了！谢谢，谢谢！我将开始仔细研究这些样本。哦，我差点忘了奖励你的辛劳。

column1: Here's a small gift to you. This should help you on your journey. I'll see you around.
column2: 这是给你的一份小礼物。这应该会对您的旅程有所帮助。我会再见的。

column1: I don't think you've collected all the items I need. I need 10 Mushroom Spores and 10 Orange Mushroom Caps.
column2: 我认为你还没有收集到我需要的所有物品。我需要 10 个蘑菇孢子和 10 个橙色蘑菇帽。

column1: Don't forget to take down the monsters too.

I met up with Bruce in Henesys, and he had great news: He finally found his daughter!!! There was one problem, however... She seems to be suffering from amnesia. Bruce gave me a toy that his daughter played with while growing up, and asked me to give it to her.
column2: 不知道射手村的布鲁斯最近怎么样……我去见了布鲁斯，他带来了好消息：他终于找到女儿了！！！不过还有一个问题……她似乎患上了失忆症。布鲁斯给了我一个女儿小时候玩过的玩具，让我交给她。我找到了阿燕，并把阿燕的玩具剑交给了她。

column1: Oh, it's you! I have great news! Great news, indeed... If you have any spare time, then ask me what exactly that great news is. I'm going to need your help too.
column2: 哦，是你！我有个好消息！确实是个好消息……如果您有空闲时间，请问我这个好消息到底是什么。我也需要你的帮助。

column1: The great news is that I have found my daughter! My assistant went to some sites around Perion to pick up samples. After he finished his work, he stopped by Perion for a bit, and... Apparently, he met a lady that eerily resembled my daughter!
column2: 好消息是我找到了我的女儿！我的助手去了 勇士部落 周边的一些地点采集样本。完成工作后，他在佩里安那里停留了一会儿，然后……显然，他遇到了一位与我女儿长得很像的女士！

column1: So he started talking to her, and... she doesn't remember anything from her childhood. She's also not a tribesperson... That has to be my daughter. It seems like she went into shock when she was attacked by the mushroom monster.
column2: 于是他开始和她说话，然后……她不记得童年的任何事情了。她也不是部落成员……那一定是我的女儿。看来她在被蘑菇怪攻击的时候，陷入了休克状态。

column1: That's the most likely reason she doesn't remember her childhood. Here... I want you to give her this sword for me. My daughter liked to pose as a knight while growing up.
column2: 这很可能是她不记得自己童年的最可能的原因。在这里……我要你帮我把这把剑交给她。我女儿从小就喜欢扮成骑士。

column1: This toy sword was something she really enjoyed playing with. It may help bring back her memories of the past. Please help me help my daughter.
column2: 这把玩具剑是她非常喜欢玩的东西。这可能有助于唤起她对过去的记忆。请帮助我帮助我的女儿。

column1: It really is great news, though... and I would really appreciate it if you could help me.
column2: 不过，这确实是个好消息...如果您能帮助我，我将非常感激...

column1: Hi! What? My dad is looking for me? Is that true? But I have no idea who my dad is. I don't remember anything from my childhood.
column2: 嗨！什么？我爸在找我吗？这是真的吗？但我不知道我的爸爸是谁。我不记得小时候的任何事了。

column1: Hey, this sword... I remember this! That's right! I was attacked by a humongous mushroom, and I just ran away as fast as I could. I guess that's how I ended up here.
column2: 嘿，这把剑……我记住了！这是正确的！我被一只巨大的蘑菇攻击，我以最快的速度逃跑。我想这就是我来到这里的原因。

column1: I can't believe this! I remember everything! Where's my dad now? Well, here's a letter for my dad. Please get this to him ASAP.
column2: 我简直不敢相信！我记得一切！我爸爸现在在哪里？嗯，这是一封写给我爸爸的信。请尽快把这个交给他。

column1: Please don't lose it again. This is a very important item to me. Good thing my assistant picked it up off the ground... Again, please don't lose it.
column2: 请不要再失去它。这对我来说是一个非常重要的项目。还好我的助手把它从地上捡了起来……再说一遍，请不要丢失它。

column1: Amazingly, Ayan recovered from her amnesia with the help of Ayan's Toy Sword. That's just amazing! The only thing left now is for Ayan and Bruce to finally meet again. But first, I have to get this letter from Ayan to Bruce.
column2: 阿燕恢复了过去的记忆，似乎急着把这个消息告诉父亲。令人惊讶的是，阿燕借助阿燕的玩具剑恢复了记忆。真是太神奇了！现在只剩下让阿燕和布鲁斯重逢了。但首先，我得把阿燕的信交给布鲁斯。阿燕能恢复记忆，我真的很高兴；布鲁斯终于见到女儿，我更高兴！真是令人感动的一刻……

column1: Please give this letter to my dad! I can't believe it! I can't wait to see my dad again!
column2: 请把这封信转交给我爸爸！我简直不敢相信！我迫不及待地想再次见到我的爸爸！

column1: Oh... that's... my... daughter... indeed... I... can't believe it... I don't think I've ever been so happy in my life... Thank you so much.
column2: 哦...那是...我的...女儿...确实...我...简直不敢相信...我想我这辈子从来没有这么幸福过...非常感谢你。

column1: I am so glad my daughter is alive and well! I have to make my way there now. I cannot wait to see her. Here's some money for your traveling expenses. It may not be much, but please take it.
column2: 我很高兴我的女儿还活着并且安然无恙！我现在必须去那里。我迫不及待地想见到她。这是你的一些旅费。可能不多，但请收下。

column1: This is too good to be true!
I'll write it again here. Please take care of it! Don't lose it this time!
column2: 我这里再写一下。请多多关照！这次可别再输了！

column1: Arwen the Fairy from Ellinia says she lost Arwen's Glass Shoes a couple of days ago, on her way to Perion. A monster covered in flame stole it! Fairies obsess over glimmering, shiny objects so she obviously wants it back... Time to hunt some monsters near Perion.
column2: 魔法密林的妖精艾温丢了东西……妖精艾温说几天前她在前往勇士部落的路上弄丢了自己的玻璃鞋。一个浑身冒火的怪物偷走了它！妖精们很执着于闪亮发光的东西，所以她当然想拿回来……该去勇士部落附近狩猎怪物了。你把艾温的玻璃鞋还给了魔法密林的妖精艾温。你很幸运，从一只讨厌的火野猪身上找到了它。作为谢礼，她给了你一件妖精道具。它像星星一样美丽闪耀。哇，也许可以用它做出特别的东西。

column1: A few days ago, on my way to Perion , I was attacked by a flaming monster and lost Arwen's Glass Shoe.
column2: 几天前，在前往佩里安的途中，我遭到了火焰怪物的袭击，并丢失了阿尔文的玻璃鞋……

column1: Fairies like shiny stuff. Even though you think it's just some trifle, I really need my shoe! I don't enjoy being helped by humans, but please. Help me!
column2: 仙女们都喜欢闪闪发光的东西。尽管你认为这只是一件小事，但我真的需要我的鞋子！我不喜欢被人类帮助，但是拜托了。帮我！

column1: Oh...! That sparkle. That shine. It's my glass shoe! Would you... please give it back to me? It's not like you need it.
column2: 哦...！那个闪闪发光。那光芒。这是我的玻璃鞋！你能……请把它还给我吗？这不像你需要它...

column1: I will give you this special item, something only fairies can give out. This item is very rare and precious... Please use it well... Farewell.

column1: I ran into Rowen the Fairy again, who gave me Fresh Milk for Ronnie, Mr. Wetbottom's son. Back then, she seemed to be keeping her guard up against humans, but now, it looks like she accepts me as Ronnie's friend... Rowen the Fairy is assistant to the head magician of Ellinia, Grendel the Really Old, and she tells me that he is concerned about the Cursed Dolls that he made with his black magic a long, long time ago. The dolls had been sealed up for a while, until a bunch of Lupins took them and ran away. The Lupins have since become zombies and have been destroying the forest. To return the forest to how it was before, someone needs to take down the Zombie Lupins and take the Cursed Dolls away from them... So, I readily accepted the request to collect 50 cursed dolls, but I fear those crazy monkeys may be too much to handle.
column2: 我觉得魔法密林的妖精罗雯有事要拜托我……我再次遇到了妖精罗雯，她之前给我新鲜牛奶让我带给沃特巴顿先生的儿子罗尼。那时她似乎还对人类保持戒心，但现在看来，她已经把我当作罗尼的朋友了……罗雯是魔法密林大魔法师汉斯的助手。她告诉我，汉斯很担心很久以前用黑魔法制作的诅咒娃娃。那些娃娃曾被封印，但后来一群猴子把它们偷走并逃跑了。之后这些猴子变成了僵尸，在森林里到处破坏。为了让森林恢复原样，需要有人打倒僵尸猴，并从它们身上取回诅咒娃娃……于是我答应收集 50 个诅咒娃娃，但有点担心这些疯狂猴子不好对付。你在魔法密林附近的森林里消灭了许多僵尸猴，为罗雯收集齐了 50 个诅咒娃娃。作为回报，她给了你 7 个矿石。希望森林能恢复正常……

column1: You're Ronnie's friend. You came at just the right time. It's not easy for me to ask a human for help, but... I have a hunch that I can trust you on this.

column1: Grendel the Really Old used to be very much into black magic , which was considered off limits. Black magic is VERY powerful, but there's a chance it can backfire and the Magician casting the spell might lose the ability to use magic altogether. So it's very potent but requires utmost caution.
column2: 老格伦德尔曾经非常热衷于黑魔法，这被认为是禁区。黑魔法非常强大，但它有可能适得其反，施展该咒语的魔术师可能会完全失去使用魔法的能力。因此，它非常有效，但需要极其谨慎。

column1: Grendel the Really Old wasn't fully trained, but he thought he could handle it. He tried to bring a straw doll to life. Anyone with half a brain knows that magic that has to do with life itself is absolutely forbidden!
column2: 老格伦德尔并没有接受过充分的训练，但他认为自己可以应付。他试图让一个稻草娃娃复活。有点脑子的人都知道，与生命本身有关的魔法是绝对禁止的！

column1: Something went terribly wrong in the process, and the curse of black magic seeped into the doll, transforming it into a Cursed Doll that had to be sealed up forever. In the end, Grendel the Really Old was able to seal the Cursed Doll up and hid it away somewhere.

column1: But then, the Lupins that live around Ellinia Forest took the doll. When they returned to the forest, they became zombies. The Zombie Lupins are now wreaking havoc in the forest. Grendel the Really Old assigned me to handle the situation, but he could hardly expect me to resolve the whole thing on my own.

column1: You look much stronger than last time... Can you do me a favor? I got a request from the fairies in Ellinia ... There are many baby fairies, and we need to make houses for them... What do you think? Can you collect the materials to build those houses?
column2: 你看起来比上次坚强多了...你能帮我一个忙吗？我收到了魔法密林仙女们的请求……有很多小仙女，我们需要为他们建造房子……你觉得怎么样？你能收集建造这些房子的材料吗？

column1: Wow! Thanks! Then first, can you collect 30 Horny Mushroom Caps and 30 Curse Eye Tails by taking down Horny Mushrooms and Curse Eyes ? They come from weak monsters... so it might be a bit boring... hehe... This is only the beginning, though. I'm counting on you!
column2: 哇！谢谢！那么首先，你能通过打倒角质蘑菇和咒眼来收集30个角质蘑菇帽和30个咒眼尾吗？他们来自弱小的怪物……所以可能有点无聊……呵呵……但这只是开始。我指望你了！

column1: Yeah... You can't take a request from a kid... yeah... right... If you change your mind, please let me know... I can't do this on my own.
column2: 是的...你不能接受一个孩子的请求...是的...对...如果你改变主意，请告诉我...我一个人做不到...

column1: Wow... You collected them all! Cool. Isn't it fun to hunt weak monsters? No? Oh, come on! Anyway, I'll give these to the fairies... But I don't think this is enough.
column2: 哇...你把它们都收集了！凉爽的。狩猎弱小的怪物不是很有趣吗？不？哦，来吧！不管怎样，我会把这些送给仙女们……但我觉得这还不够。

column1: I got the materials... Yeah... It was a good idea to ask you for a favor... Thanks... but there are still more things to get. Whenever you're ready, please talk to me again!
column2: 我拿到了材料……是的……向你求助是个好主意……谢谢……但还有更多东西要拿到。当你准备好时，请再跟我说话！

column1: It looks like you still haven't gathered everything I asked for yet. But keep it up! It may be tough, but if you help me out a few more times, I'll give you something really nice!
column2: 看来你还没有收集到我要求的一切。但坚持下去！这可能很难，但如果你再帮我几次，我会给你一些非常好的东西！

column1: Don't forget to take down the monsters, too!

Ronnie has now asked me to collect 30 Bubbling's Huge Bubbles and Tablecloths by taking down Bubblings and Jr. Wraiths. I should be able to get them from the monsters living in the Kerning City subway. This should be no problem~
column2: 在 Unknown Map(105010000) 见罗尼。罗尼现在让我去打倒大幽灵和小幽灵，收集 30 个大幽灵泡泡和 30 块桌布。应该可以从废弃都市地铁里的怪物身上获得。这应该没问题～你为罗尼收集齐了所有东西。拜托别告诉我他想免费拿走这些……！

column1: Huh... you're already ready? You really are impatient... Don't be in such a rush! All right then! this time, can you take down Bubblings and Jr. Wraiths and bring me 30 Bubbling's Huge Bubbles and Tablecloths ? I'm counting on you!
column2: 嗯……你已经准备好了吗？你真是不耐烦了……别着急啊！那就好吧！这次，你能打倒巴布林和小幽灵，给我带来 30 个巴布林的巨大泡泡和桌布吗？我指望你了！

column1: Thanks! I think you should travel around the Kerning City Subway this time. When you get all those items, please bring them to me. I'll be waiting here!
column2: 谢谢！我觉得你这次应该去废弃都市地铁转转。当你拿到所有这些物品后，请把它们带给我。我会在这里等你！

column1: Yeah... You can't take a request from a kid... yeah... right... If you change your mind, please let me know... I can't do this on my own.
column2: 是的...你不能接受一个孩子的请求...是的...对...如果你改变主意，请告诉我...我一个人做不到...

column1: Wow, you collected it all! Great! This one was harder than last time, right? What? It was nothing? Haha... Anyway, I'll give these to the fairies, but we're not done yet.
column2: 哇，你全收集了！伟大的！这次比上次更难吧？什么？没什么？哈哈……不管怎样，我会把这些送给仙女们，但我们还没有完成……

column1: I got the materials... Yeah... It was a good idea to ask you for a favor... Thanks... but there are still more things to get. Whenever you're ready, please talk to me again!
column2: 我拿到了材料……是的……向你求助是个好主意……谢谢……但还有更多东西要拿到。当你准备好时，请再跟我说话！

column1: Don't forget to take down the monsters, too!

Ronnie has now asked me to hunt Fire Boars and Copper Drakes and collect 30 each of Fire Boar's Tooths and Drake Skulls. I should be able to get them from the monsters around Perion. Things are starting to get a bit tricky…
column2: 在 Unknown Map(105010000) 见罗尼。罗尼现在让我狩猎火野猪和青龙，收集火野猪牙和飞龙头骨各 30 个。应该可以从勇士部落周围的怪物身上获得。事情开始变得有点麻烦了……你为罗尼收集齐了所有东西。还是没有报酬？到底还要做多少次？

column1: Huh... You're already ready? You really are impatient... Don't rush so much! All right, then. This time, can you take down Fire Boars and Copper Drakes and bring me 30 Fire Boar's Tooth and Drake Skulls ? I'm counting on you!
column2: 嗯……你已经准备好了吗？你真是不耐烦了……别着急啊！好吧，那么。这次，你能打倒火野猪和铜龙，给我带来 30 个火野猪的牙齿和龙的头骨吗？我指望你了！

column1: Thanks! I think you should travel around the Perion area this time. When you get all those items, please bring them to me. I'll be waiting here!
column2: 谢谢！我觉得你这次应该去勇士部落地区逛逛。当你拿到所有这些物品后，请把它们带给我。我会在这里等你！

column2: 我拿到了材料……是的……向你求助是个好主意……谢谢……但还有更多东西要拿到。当你准备好时，请再跟我说话！

column1: It looks like you still haven't gathered everything I asked for yet. But keep it up! It may be tough, but if you help me out a few more times, I'll give you something really nice!
column2: 看来你还没有收集到我要求的一切。但坚持下去！这可能很难，但如果你再帮我几次，我会给你一些非常好的东西！

column1: Don't forget to take down the monsters too!

Ronnie asked for the last time. This time he wanted 30 Cold Eye Tails, 10 Dragon Skins, and 1 Diamond by taking down Cold Eyes and Drakes. I can sort of get this, but for me to hunt at the deep parts of the Ant Tunnel… this is way too hard!!
column2: 在 Unknown Map(105010000) 见罗尼。罗尼最后一次开口了。这次他想让我打倒冰独眼兽和飞龙，收集 30 条冰独眼兽尾巴、10 张龙皮和 1 个钻石。我大概能理解，但要去蚂蚁洞深处狩猎……这也太难了！！你终于收集齐罗尼最后一次需要的材料。就这样了吗？作为奖励，他给了你一张从妖精那里收到的鞋子卷轴，那是妖精们在森林附近捡到的。他不知道怎么使用卷轴，所以就给了你……希望它能成功……哈哈……

column1: Huh... you're already ready? You really are impatient... Don't rush so much! This is the last one! All right then. This time, can you take down Cold Eyes and Drakes and bring me 30 Cold Eye Tails , 10 Dragon Skins , and 1 Diamond ? I'm counting on you!
column2: 嗯……你已经准备好了吗？你真是不耐烦了……别着急啊！这是最后一张了！那就好吧。这次，你能打倒冷眼和龙龙，给我带来30条冷眼尾巴、10张龙皮和1颗钻石吗？我指望你了！

column1: Thanks so much! This time, you'll probably need to look around the deep parts of the Ant Tunnel. When you get all those items, please bring them to me. I'll be waiting right here!
column2: 非常感谢！这次，你可能需要看看蚂蚁隧道的深处。当你拿到所有这些物品后，请把它们带给我。我就在这里等你！

column1: Yeah... You can't take a request from a kid... yeah... right... If you change your mind, please let me know... I can't do this on my own.
column2: 是的...你不能接受一个孩子的请求...是的...对...如果你改变主意，请告诉我...我一个人做不到...

column1: Wow, you collected them all! Great! This one was harder than last time, right? What? It was nothing? Haha... Anyway, I will give these to the fairies. That should be about everything.
column2: 哇，你把它们都收集了！伟大的！这次比上次更难吧？什么？没什么？哈哈……不管怎样，我就把这些送给仙女们吧。这应该是关于一切的。

column1: I got all the things you brought! Thanks sooo much for everything. You must've been annoyed, but you didn't complain even once... You're amazing! As a reward... The fairies in the forest near Ellinia gave me this weird paper. But, um... I don't really know what it is.
column2: 你带来的东西我都收到了！非常感谢你所做的一切。你肯定很生气，但你一次也没有抱怨过……你太棒了！作为奖励……魔法密林附近森林里的仙女给了我这张奇怪的纸。但是，嗯...我真的不知道那是什么。

column1: It kinda looks like it has some sort of magic power... but it's too confusing. I don't really get it... Anyway, I think it could be helpful to you, so take it and use it well. I hope it helps! See you later!
column2: 看起来好像有某种魔力……但实在是太让人摸不着头脑了。我不太明白...无论如何，我认为它可能对你有帮助，所以拿走它并好好利用它。我希望它有帮助！稍后见！

column1: It looks like you still haven't gathered everything I asked for yet, huh? But keep it up! It may be tough, but if you help me out this last time, I'll give you something really nice!
column2: 看来你还没有收集到我要求的所有东西，是吗？但坚持下去！这可能很难，但如果你最后一次帮我，我会给你一些非常好的东西！

column1: Don't forget to take down the monsters, too!

column2: 随机奖励 - 以下之一：

column1: Wing the Fairy of Ellinia seems to have a general disdain for humans. Definitely not the kind of attitude I expect from someone in need of help. He asked me if I can get him 10 Leafs, 10 Squishy Liquids, and 3 Slime Bubbles. He needs them so he can make a potion for his homework.
column2: 每次路过魔法密林的妖精维英，他看起来都像是需要帮助。到底为什么呢……魔法密林的妖精维英似乎普遍瞧不起人类。这可不是我期待从求助者身上看到的态度。他问我能不能帮他拿 10 片叶子、10 个粘稠液体和 3 个绿水灵泡泡。他需要这些材料来做作业用的药水。你帮魔法密林的妖精维英完成了作业。不过我完全不知道那药水是怎么运作的。

column1: Hey there, human! Do you have any time on your hands? If not, then oh well... I have something to ask you... Well, not really ask, but I need a favor. Are you interested...?
column2: 嘿，人类！你有时间吗？如果没有，那么哦，好吧……我有件事想问你……好吧，不是真的问，但我需要一个帮忙。你有兴趣吗...?

column1: There's this teacher in Magic School that scares the daylights out of everyone. I mean, he's as scary as they come. Anyway, he gave us homework to make a potion, but I'm swamped with so much homework from other classes that I don't know if I can do it.
column2: 魔法学校里有一位老师，让所有人都害怕。我的意思是，他和他们一样可怕。不管怎样，他给我们布置了制作魔药的作业，但我被其他班级的作业淹没了，我不知道我是否能完成。

column1: I need 10 Leafs , 10 Squishy Liquids , and 3 Slime Bubbles . Please get me those immediately!
column2: 我需要 10 片叶子、10 份软液体和 3 个史莱姆泡泡。请立即给我那些！

column1: What's the potion going to be used for? That's none of your business. Know this, though. If you get me the ingredients, I will reward you well for your effort. I can't stand owing anything to a human.
column2: 药水要用来做什么？那不关你的事。但知道这一点。如果你能帮我找到原料，我会好好奖励你的努力。我无法忍受欠人类任何东西。

column1: Fine, I don't care! I can always find someone else!
column2: 好吧，我不在乎！我总能找到别人！

column1: Oh, you got them all! I need to make this potion fast and get on with my other homework. I think I can finish all of it thanks to you. Here are some potions and scrolls I made earlier. I don't need them, so you should take them.
column2: 哦，你全都得到了！我需要快速配制这剂药水并继续我的其他作业。我想多亏了你我才能完成这一切。这是我之前制作的一些药剂和卷轴。我不需要它们，所以你应该拿走它们。

column1: I don't need you now, so please leave!
column2: 我现在不需要你了，所以请你离开吧！

column1: I don't think you've gathered them all up. Hurry up, I don't have much time. I have to start memorizing spells once I'm done with my potions homework!
column2: 我认为你还没有把它们全部收集起来。快点吧，我时间不多了。完成魔药作业后我就得开始背咒语了！

column1: Shane in Ellinia mentioned wanting to eat a delicious mushroom dish and asked me to find some ingredients. He said Green Mushroom Caps taste especially good, so I should head out and hunt Green Mushrooms near the forest.
column2: 看起来魔法密林的谢恩正在找能帮忙的冒险家。魔法密林的谢恩说想吃一道美味的蘑菇料理，拜托我找些食材。他说绿蘑菇盖特别好吃，所以我应该去森林附近狩猎绿蘑菇。你把绿蘑菇盖交给了魔法密林的谢恩。他真的能用这个做出美味料理吗？

column1: Hey, you over there! You look like an adventurer... maybe one with a heavy wallet? Care to lend me a hand?
column2: 嘿，你在那边！你看起来像个冒险家……也许是一个钱包很重的人？愿意帮我一下吗？

column1: I knew you'd be willing to listen. See, I inherited this entire forest beyond here from my father. I'm standing guard to make sure no strangers wander in as they please.
column2: 我知道你会愿意听的。看，我从父亲那里继承了这里的整片森林。我站岗是为了确保没有陌生人随意闯入……

column1: But standing here all day is quite the chore, you know? And it's been far too long since I've had my favorite mushroom stew. My stomach is growling just thinking about it.
column2: 但整天站在这里是一件很苦差事，你知道吗？我已经很久没有吃过我最喜欢的炖蘑菇了。一想到这个我的肚子就咕咕叫。

column1: So, how about a little deal? Bring me some Green Mushroom Caps . My father used to make stew with them, and it was a real delicacy. You can get Green Mushroom Caps by hunting Green Mushrooms around the forest. I'll be waiting!
column2: 那么，做点小生意怎么样？给我一些绿色蘑菇帽。我父亲常常用它们炖菜，那是真正的美味。您可以通过在森林周围狩猎绿色蘑菇来获得绿色蘑菇帽。我会等待！

column1: You clearly don't know that talking to the locals is the first rule of adventuring. Or maybe you're just not interested in making friends?
column2: 您显然不知道与当地人交谈是冒险的首要规则。或者也许您只是对交朋友不感兴趣？

column1: I knew you'd bring them quickly. These Green Mushroom Caps look incredibly fresh, don't they? Much appreciated. Here, a little something for your trouble.
column2: 我就知道你会很快把它们带来。这些绿色蘑菇帽看起来非常新鲜，不是吗？非常感谢。在这里，为您解决一些麻烦。

column1: This is an ore commonly found in our forest. I hear you can craft some pretty useful things with it. Well then, see you around!
column2: 这是我们森林中常见的矿石。我听说你可以用它制作一些非常有用的东西。那么，再见！

column1: Still no Green Mushroom Caps ? Sigh... I really had my heart set on cooking up my father's mushroom stew today. Don't leave a hungry man waiting!
column2: 还没有绿色蘑菇帽吗？唉……今天我真的一心想给父亲炖蘑菇。不要让一个饥饿的人等待！

column1: Don't forget to hunt the monsters I mentioned. I'm not standing here for my health, you know.
column2: 别忘了狩猎我提到的怪物。你知道，我站在这里并不是为了我的健康。

column1: Shane in Ellinia says he learned an even better way to cook Green Mushroom Caps and asked me to bring some Green Mushroom Caps, as well as a Lemon.
column2: 看起来魔法密林的谢恩还有事相求。谢恩说他学会了更好地烹调绿蘑菇盖的方法，拜托我带来一些绿蘑菇盖和一个柠檬。你把绿蘑菇盖和柠檬交给了魔法密林的谢恩。感觉这道菜可能真的比上次更好吃，不是吗？

column1: Oh, look who it is! The one who helped me out before. I had some pretty good mushroom stew thanks to you. Much appreciated. But now, the fairies in this village are telling me that the stew tastes a whole lot better if you throw in some Lemon.
column2: 哦，看看这是谁！之前帮过我的人。谢谢你，我吃了一些很好吃的蘑菇炖菜。非常感谢。但现在，这个村子里的仙女告诉我，如果加点柠檬，炖菜的味道会好很多。

column1: So, how about it? Could you gather some Green Mushroom Caps for me, one more time? And if you could pick up a Lemon from the general store while you're at it, that'd be great. As you can see, I can't move a single inch from here because I have to guard the entrance to the forest I inherited from my father.
column2: 那么，怎么样？你能再帮我收集一些绿色蘑菇帽吗？如果你能在杂货店买一个柠檬，那就太好了。正如你所看到的，我不能离开这里一英寸，因为我必须守卫我从父亲那里继承的森林的入口。

column1: You're back! The Green Mushroom Caps you brought this time look even tastier than in the last batch. Perfect! Now, if I just add this Lemon , I'll be able to whip up something truly amazing.
column2: 你回来了！你这次带来的绿色蘑菇帽看起来比上一批还要好吃。完美的！现在，如果我添加这个柠檬，我就能做出一些真正令人惊奇的东西。

column1: Thanks for the help. I think I'm going to have a very special dinner tonight, all thanks to you. As a reward, I'll give you another ore that can be found in our forest. Take care of yourself out there!
column2: 感谢您的帮助。我想今晚我会吃一顿非常特别的晚餐，谢谢你。作为奖励，我会给你另一种可以在我们森林里找到的矿石。在外面照顾好自己！

column1: Still no Green Mushroom Caps and Lemon ? Man... I just know I could make a legendary dish if I only had those ingredients.
column2: 还没有绿蘑菇帽和柠檬吗？伙计……我只知道如果我有这些原料，我就能做出一道传奇菜肴。

column1: Don't forget to hunt the ones I mentioned. I'm waiting here, you know.
column2: 不要忘记狩猎我提到的那些。我在这里等你，你知道的。

column1: On a lonely building rooftop in Kerning City, I met a boy named Alex who ran away from home because of a disagreement with his father, Chief Stan in Henesys. But Alex has become exhausted from being on the run with no money. Now he wants to return home and try to work things out with his strict, but loving, father. But he wants me to persuade his father not to punish him when he returns home. He also says he wants me to bring the k his mother left him when she died as proof that I successfully persuaded his father.
