column2: 废弃都市有个离家出走的孩子叫阿勒斯……在废弃都市一栋孤零零的楼顶上，我遇到了一个叫阿勒斯的少年。他因为和父亲——射手村长老斯坦意见不合而离家出走。但身无分文的逃亡生活让他疲惫不堪。现在他想回家，试着和严厉但爱他的父亲和解。不过他希望我说服父亲，让他回家后不要惩罚他。他还让我带回母亲去世前留给他的旧金表，作为成功说服父亲的证明。按照阿勒斯的请求，我去射手村找他的父亲，想拿到阿勒斯母亲的旧金表。

column1: Hey, hear me out. A couple of days ago I ran away from home to get away from my very straight laced father. So, here I am, in Kerning City , just wandering around. I've spent all the money I secretly took from my dad's safe, and I'm sick of this, to be honest. I shouldn't have run away.
column2: 嘿，听我说。几天前，我离家出走，逃离我那严肃的父亲。所以，我在这里，在废弃都市，只是闲逛。我已经花光了从我爸爸保险箱里偷偷拿来的所有钱，说实话我已经厌倦了。我不应该逃跑。

column1: I don't think my dad will just let me walk back in the door... Not without beating the bejeebus out of me. Can you find a way to calm him down? I need your help, man.
column2: 我想我爸爸不会让我走进门的……除非我被狠狠地打了一顿。你能想个办法让他平静下来吗？我需要你的帮助，伙计。

column1: Thank you! My father is Chief Stan in Henesys . Because he's a man of power, he's strict. He and I just can't get through to each other. My father has a LOUD personality, so you can't be too submissive when you talk to him. I'm sure you'll figure something out.
column2: 谢谢！我父亲是 射手村 的斯坦酋长。因为他是一个有权有势的人，所以他很严厉。我和他就是无法沟通。我父亲的性格比较大声，所以你跟他说话的时候不能太顺从。我相信你会想出办法的。

column1: To prove you've calmed my father down, ask him for his Old Gold Watch . It was my mother's before she passed away. He always said he'd never give it to a guy like me, so if he does... It'll mean he's forgiven me. I'll be waiting!
column2: 为了证明你已经让我父亲平静下来，向他索要他的旧金表。这是我母亲去世前的。他总是说他永远不会把它给像我这样的人，所以如果他这样做......那就意味着他原谅了我。我会等待！

column1: You won't do me a favor because I'm an immature kid who ran away from home, right? I understand, but I'm trying to... Ah, never mind.
column2: 你不会因为我是一个离家出走的不成熟的孩子而帮我吧？我明白，但我正在努力……啊，没关系。

column1: Who are you? I don't think we've met.
column2: 你是谁？我想我们还没有见过面。

column1: My father is the chief of Henesys . Please convince him to let me come back home. As proof that he's forgiven me, please also convince him to give me his Old Gold Watch , which belonged to my mother.
column2: 我父亲是轩尼诗公司的总裁。请说服他让我回家。作为他原谅我的证据，请说服他把他的旧金表给我，那是我母亲的。

column1: At the entrance of Henesys, I meet Alex's father, Chief Stan, the chief of Henesys. Before I can even start a conversation, he asks for 15 Green Mushroom Caps and 15 Blue Mushroom Caps.
column2: 在射手村入口，我见到了阿勒斯的父亲——射手村长老斯坦。我还没来得及开口，他就让我先带来 15 个绿蘑菇盖和 15 个蓝蘑菇盖。等我带来了绿蘑菇盖和刺蘑菇盖后，斯坦长老才开始和我说话。

column1: You want to talk to me? I'm the elder of this town--I don't have time to waste chatting with someone like you. If you really want a word with me, bring something the town could use. Hunt 25 Green Mushrooms and 25 Blue Mushrooms , and collect 15 Green Mushroom Caps and 15 Blue Mushroom Caps . Maybe then I'll have a moment to spare.
column2: 你想跟我说话吗？我是这个镇上的长辈——我没有时间和你这样的人浪费时间聊天。如果你真想跟我说句话，就带些镇上可以用的东西来。狩猎 25 个绿色蘑菇和 25 个蓝色蘑菇，并收集 15 个绿色蘑菇帽和 15 个蓝色蘑菇帽。也许那时我会有空闲的时间。

column1: Thank you. Thanks to you, I think I can finally clear up the misunderstanding with Alex . Please tell him he's welcome to return to the town. Of course, I'll still be taking the materials I asked for earlier. Oh, and one more thing... This is my Old Gold Watch , a keepsake of his mother Anna. Please give it to him. He'll understand what it means. Here, take it.
column2: 谢谢你。多亏了你，我想我终于可以消除与亚历克斯的误会了。请告诉他欢迎他回到小镇。当然，我还是会拿走之前要的材料。哦，还有一件事......这是我的旧金表，他母亲安娜的纪念品。请交给他。他会明白这意味着什么。在这里，拿走吧。

column1: At the entrance of Henesys, I met Alex's father Chief Stan, the chief of Henesys. He was even more blunt and difficult to talk to than I'd anticipated, but I finally convinced him to accept Alex back with open arms. I also got Alex's late mother's k as proof. Now, all I need to do is get this watch to Alex in Kerning City.
column2: 在射手村入口，我见到了阿勒斯的父亲——射手村长老斯坦。他比我想象中还要直率，也更难沟通，但我终于说服他敞开心胸接纳阿勒斯回家。我也拿到了阿勒斯已故母亲的旧金表作为证明。现在只要把这块表交给废弃都市的阿勒斯就行了。你把他已故母亲的旧金表交给了阿勒斯。作为谢礼，他送给你一只旅途中朋友赠送的耳环。嗯，斯坦长老原谅了阿勒斯，但阿勒斯似乎并不打算马上回家。下次去射手村时，也许该留意一下。

column1: It's a special watch. Make sure you don't lose it. Alex is in Kerning City , right? Please... please take care of this and... and him. So long.
column2: 这是一块特别的手表。确保您不会丢失它。亚历克斯在废弃都市，对吗？请……请照顾好这个……还有他。这么久。

column1: What? You convinced my father to let me return? That's unbelievable... I'm amazed that you changed the mind of Mr. Holier-Than-Thou. Now I can say goodbye to the life of a wanderer. Thank you so much!
column2: 什么？你说服我父亲让我回来了？太难以置信了……我很惊讶你改变了霍利尔-坦-你先生的想法。现在我可以告别流浪的生活了。太感谢了！

column1: Whoa, this Old Gold Watch is... it's my mother's, for sure. I should have been better to her when she was alive... Anyway, you did me a huge favor, so here! It isn't much, but take it.
column2: 哇，这块旧金表是……肯定是我母亲的。她活着的时候我就应该对她好一点……不管怎样，你帮了我一个大忙，所以就在这里！虽然不多，但还是拿走吧。

column1: I got this earring from friends I met while traveling all around the island. Might as well look good traveling, right? Hehe... Hopefully it'll help you on your journey.
column2: 我从环岛旅行时认识的朋友那里得到了这枚耳环。旅行也许也不错，对吧？呵呵...希望对您的旅途有所帮助。

column1: You haven't met my father yet? He's the chief of Henesys . Please convince him to let me return home. And as a sign of proof, please get the Old Gold Watch my mother left behind.
column2: 你还没见过我父亲吗？他是轩尼诗公司的总裁。请说服他让我回家。作为证据，请拿走我母亲留下的旧金表......

column1: You haven't been to see Alex yet? Please give the Old Gold Watch to him. Don't lose it!
column2: 你还没去看亚历克斯吗？请把旧金表给他。不要丢失它！

column1: Oh my, did you lose the Old Gold Watch ? I told you to be careful! Luckily, a townsman found it on the street. Here, take it again, and PLEASE don't lose it this time.
column2: 天哪，你把旧金表弄丢了吗？我告诉过你要小心！幸运的是，一位镇民在街上发现了它。给你，再拿一次，这次请不要弄丢了。
随机奖励 - 以下之一：

column1: I gave Nella 1000 mesos as commission for telling me about various requests from the citizens of Kerning City. The first request is from Don Hwang, the owner of the armor shop, who needs materials to craft new armor. I need to defeat 20 Orange Mushrooms and 20 Ribbon Pigs and collect 10 Orange Mushroom Caps and 10 Pig's Ribbons. It shouldn't be too hard, since Orange Mushrooms and Ribbon Pigs are commonly found near Kerning City.
column2: 听说在废弃都市想找工作就该去找内拉……我给了内拉 1000 金币作为介绍各种委托的手续费。第一个委托来自防具店老板黄老板，他需要制作新防具的材料。我需要打倒 20 只绿蘑菇和 20 只漂漂猪，并收集 10 个绿蘑菇盖和 10 条猪的丝带。绿蘑菇和漂漂猪在废弃都市附近很常见，应该不难。你把黄老板要求的东西交给了他，并收到了许多柠檬作为回报。不知道黄老板会做出什么样的防具。内拉说还有很多委托可以做，我应该时不时去找她看看。

column1: Whoa, I haven't seen you before! I'm guessing you're not from here. My name's Nella , and I know everything that goes on around town. That's right, I'm always the first with any juicy pieces of news!
column2: 哇，我以前没见过你！我猜你不是这里人。我叫内拉，我知道镇上发生的一切。没错，我总是第一个知道有趣的消息！

column1: For 1,000 Mesos , I can gather some intel and hook you up with work. You game? Think of me as your agent! I get a cut, but you get a gig.
column2: 只要 1,000 金币，我就可以收集一些情报并为你安排工作。你玩游戏吗？把我当作你的代理人吧！我得到了削减，但你得到了演出。

column1: Awesome! Like I promised, you give me 1,000 Mesos, I give you the hook-ups. I'm so efficient, I have your first job right here. Don Hwang from the armor store has been collecting rare items for a new piece of armor he's trying to create.
column2: 太棒了！就像我承诺的那样，你给我 1,000 金币，我给你连接。我效率很高，你的第一份工作就在这里。盔甲店的 玛帕 一直在为他想要制作的新盔甲收集稀有物品。

column1: It shouldn't be too hard for you to defeat 20 Orange Mushrooms and 20 Ribbon Pigs , and get me 10 Orange Mushroom Caps and 10 Pig's Ribbons , right? Once you get me the goods, I'll slide you your reward. Now get to work!
column2: 打败20个橙色蘑菇和20个丝带猪，给我带来10个橙色蘑菇帽和10个猪丝带，对你来说应该不难吧？一旦你给我拿到了货物，我就会把你的奖励滑给你。现在开始工作吧！

column1: Hey, it's your call. You change your mind, you give me a call.
column2: 嘿，这是你的决定。你改变主意了，你给我打电话。

column1: Got the goods? Excellent! Here's your reward. Don Hwang has provided a bunch of Lemons as payment. Use them well!
column2: 收到货了吗？出色的！这是你的奖励。黄先生提供了一堆柠檬作为付款。好好利用它们！

column1: All right, if you need work sometime down the road, feel free to come back and see me.
column2: 好吧，如果你以后需要工作，请随时回来见我。

column1: I see you still haven't gathered the materials that Don Hwang requested. You need to defeat 20 Orange Mushrooms and 20 Ribbon Pigs and gather 10 Orange Mushroom Caps and 10 Pig's Ribbons to help with the new piece of armor. Just bring everything to me. Good luck!
column2: 我发现你还没有收集黄敦要求的材料。你需要击败 20 个橙色蘑菇和 20 个丝带猪，并收集 10 个橙色蘑菇帽和 10 个猪丝带来帮助制作新的盔甲。只要把所有的东西都带给我就可以了。祝你好运！

column1: I see you still haven't gathered the materials that Don Hwang requested. You need to defeat 20 Orange Mushrooms and 20 Ribbon Pigs and gather 10 Orange Mushroom Caps and 10 Pig's Ribbons to help with the new piece of armor. Just bring everything to me. Good luck!
column2: 我发现你还没有收集黄敦要求的材料。你需要击败 20 个橙色蘑菇和 20 个丝带猪，并收集 10 个橙色蘑菇帽和 10 个猪丝带来帮助制作新的盔甲。只要把所有的东西都带给我就可以了。祝你好运！

column1: I received the second request from Nella. Shumi, who sits in front of the Subway, wants to build a house for the puppy she received from her friend. I should defeat 25 Dark Stumps and bring 15 Leafs to Nella for the puppy house.
column2: 我从内拉那里接到了第二个委托。坐在地铁前的休咪想给朋友送她的小狗建一个房子。我应该打倒 25 个黑木妖，并把 15 片叶子交给内拉，用来制作小狗屋。你把休咪要求的东西交了上去，并收到了许多蛋糕作为回报。现在，休咪的小狗有了自己的房子。回去找内拉接下一个活吧。

column1: You're here. Great. I have another gig for you. Shumi , sitting in front of the subway station, needs help. A friend of hers gave her a puppy as a present a few days ago, and she's looking to make a cute, comfortable doghouse for him.
column2: 你在这里。伟大的。我还有另一场演出要给你。舒米坐在地铁站前，需要帮助。几天前，她的一个朋友送给她一只小狗作为礼物，她想为他做一个可爱、舒适的狗屋。

column1: I think I just need you to defeat 25 Dark Stumps and bring 15 Leafs . It'll be a breeze for someone like you, so please don't make that poor puppy wait out in the cold any longer than he has to! Come back to me as soon as you have them--I'll be waiting.
column2: 我想我只需要你打败25个黑暗树桩并带来15片叶子。对于像你这样的人来说这是一件轻而易举的事，所以请不要让那只可怜的小狗在寒冷中等待太久！一旦你拿到它们就回来找我——我会等的。

column1: I like you. You know how to take care of business. All right, here's your reward. Shumi is giving you a bunch of homemade Cakes.
column2: 我喜欢你。你知道如何打理生意。好吧，这是你的奖励。舒米送你一堆自制蛋糕。

column1: All right, if you need work sometime down the road, feel free to come back and see me.
column2: 好吧，如果你以后需要工作，请随时回来见我。

column1: I see that you still haven't gathered the materials that Shumi requested. She needs 11 Leafs to build a house for the puppy. When you've defeated 25 Dark Stumps and gathered the Leafs , bring them all to me. Good luck!
column2: 我发现你还没有收集到舒米要求的材料。她需要 11 片叶子来为小狗建造一座房子。当你打败了 25 个黑暗树桩并收集了树叶后，把它们全部交给我。祝你好运！

column1: I see that you still haven't gathered the materials that Shumi requested. She needs 15 Leafs to build a house for the puppy. When you've defeated 25 Dark Stumps and gathered the Leafs , bring them all to me. Good luck!
column2: 我发现你还没有收集到舒米要求的材料。她需要 15 片叶子来为小狗建造一座房子。当你打败了 25 个黑暗树桩并收集了树叶后，把它们全部交给我。祝你好运！

column1: I got a third request from Nella. Andre, an assistant at the Hair Salon, is apparently struggling with meals as a lifelong bachelor and wants to make some tasty Seafood Soup. I'll need to defeat 30 Octopuses and collect 20 Octopus Legs. I'll also need 1 Pure Water. Once I've gathered everything, I should bring it to Nella.
column2: 我从内拉那里接到了第三个委托。美发店助手安德里亚似乎因为一直单身而吃饭成了问题，他想做一份美味的海鲜汤。我需要打倒 30 只章鱼并收集 20 条章鱼脚，还需要 1 个纯净水。收集齐后，应该交给内拉。你把安德里亚要求的东西交了上去，并收到了一只手套作为回报。希望他能享用这碗丰盛的海鲜汤。回去找内拉接下一个活吧。

column1: Oh, thanks for coming! I just got a new request in store for you. This time, it's Andre , the assistant from the Hair Salon. Andre is actually a lonely guy living by himself. He's apparently sick and tired of eating the same old junk.
column2: 哦，谢谢你来！我刚刚收到一个新的请求给你。这次是美发沙龙的助理安德烈。安德烈实际上是一个孤独的人，一个人生活。他显然已经厌倦了吃同样的垃圾食品。

column1: Well, I can whip up some delicious Seafood Soup using 20 Octopus Legs and 1 Pure Water . That should be easy enough, right? Come see me after you've defeated 30 Octopus and collected everything. I'll be waiting!
column2: 好吧，我可以用 20 条章鱼腿和 1 个纯净水熬出一些美味的海鲜汤。这应该很容易，对吧？打败 30 只章鱼并收集完所有东西后来见我。我会等待！

column1: I knew I could count on you. Since you've done such a wonderful job following through with the request, here's your reward. Andre is giving you a glove that'll help you on your journey, so go ahead and take it!
column2: 我知道我可以依靠你。既然您完成了如此出色的工作，完成了请求，这是您的奖励。安德烈（安德里亚）为您提供了一只手套，它将在您的旅途中为您提供帮助，所以请带上它吧！

column1: All right, if you need work sometime down the road, feel free to come back and see me.
column2: 好吧，如果你以后需要工作，请随时回来见我。

column1: I see you still haven't gathered the materials that Andre requested. I need 20 Octopus Legs and 1 Pure Water in order to make some delicious Seafood Soup. Just bring everything to me. Good luck!
column2: 我发现你还没有收集到安德烈要求的材料。我需要 20 条章鱼腿和 1 份纯净水才能制作美味的海鲜汤。只要把所有的东西都带给我就可以了。祝你好运！

column1: I see you still haven't completed everything that Andre requested. Don't forget, you also need to defeat 30 Octopus !
column2: 我发现你还没有完成安德烈要求的一切。别忘了，你还需要打败 30 只章鱼！

column1: Nella says that I’ve grown a lot since my last visit. She’s starting to give me slightly tougher tasks than before. First, she mentions that Dr. Faymus, the owner of the potion shop, has run out of ingredients while working on a new potion. He needs me to hunt 40 Jr. Neckis and 40 Horny Mushrooms, and collect 20 Jr. Necki Skins and 20 Horny Mushroom Caps. Taking on Jr. Necki might be a bit tricky, but it shouldn’t be too much trouble for me!
column2: 内拉说我比上次成长了很多。她开始给我一些比以前更难的任务。首先，她提到药店老板费穆斯博士在研究新药水时用完了材料。他需要我狩猎 40 只小青蛇和 40 只刺蘑菇，并收集 20 张小青蛇皮和 20 个刺蘑菇盖。对付小青蛇可能有点麻烦，但应该不会太难！你把费穆斯博士要求的东西交了上去，并收到了许多白色药水作为回报。不知道费穆斯博士会用这些材料做出什么药水。回去找内拉接下一个活吧。

column1: You're the one that helped me take care of Andre's request, right? He should be enjoying his seafood soup right about now... But hey, you look much stronger than before! All right, if that's the case... You can probably take care on some tougher gigs now.
column2: 是你帮我满足了安德烈的要求的，对吧？他现在应该正在享受海鲜汤……但是，嘿，你看起来比以前坚强多了！好吧，如果是这样的话……你现在可能可以处理一些更艰难的工作了。

column1: I have a new job for you, actually. Dr. Faymus of Famous Pharmacy needs help. He'd been working on creating a new potion, when, one day, he realized he was out of ingredients. They are pretty hard to find, and he claims that it's slowing down his experiments.
column2: 事实上，我有一份新工作给你。著名药房的法伊姆斯博士需要帮助。他一直致力于创造一种新药剂，有一天，他意识到自己没有原料了。它们很难找到，他声称这减慢了他的实验速度……

column1: He wants to get the ingredients quickly, so he can continue his research. He needs you to hunt 40 Jr. Neckis and 40 Horny Mushrooms , and collect 20 Jr. Necki Skins and 20 Horny Mushroom Caps ... That shouldn't be too difficult for someone like you. Come see me once you've gathered everything. I'll be waiting!
column2: 他想要尽快拿到材料，这样他就可以继续研究。他需要你狩猎 40 个小内基和 40 个角质蘑菇，并收集 20 个小内基皮和 20 个角质蘑菇帽……这对于你这样的人来说应该不会太难。等你收集齐所有东西后就来见我吧。我会等待！

column1: I knew it... I knew you could get it done quickly! You did your job well last time, and here you are again, taking care of business! All right, since you have done so well, I should reward you well. Dr. Faymus is giving you 30 White Potions to help you in your adventure.
column2: 我就知道...我就知道你能很快完成它！上次你的工作做得很好，你又来了，处理公事！好吧，既然你做得这么好，我就应该好好奖励你。 Faymus 博士给了你 30 种白色药水来帮助你完成冒险。

column1: All right, if you need work sometime down the road, feel free to come back and see me.
column2: 好吧，如果你以后需要工作，请随时回来见我。

column1: I see you still haven't gathered the materials that Dr. Faymus requested. He needs you to hunt 40 Jr. Neckis and 40 Horny Mushrooms , and collect 20 Jr. Necki Skins and 20 Horny Mushroom Caps in order to conduct the research for a new potion. Just bring everything to me once you're done. You got this!
column2: 我发现你还没有收集到费姆斯博士要求的材料。他需要你狩猎 40 个小内基和 40 个角质蘑菇，并收集 20 个小内基皮和 20 个角质蘑菇帽，以便进行新药水的研究。完成后把所有东西都给我。你得到了这个！

column1: You didn't forget that part of his request was to hunt 40 Jr. Neckis and 40 Horny Mushrooms , right?
column2: 你该不会忘了，他的要求之一就是狩猎40个小内基斯和40个角质蘑菇吧？

column1: I got another request from Nella. Chris's pillow was stolen a few days ago and now he can't sleep. To make a new pillow, he needs 20 Stiff Feathers and 20 Leathers. I should get them as soon as possible, so Chris can get some sleep!
column2: 我从内拉那里接到了另一个委托。克利思的枕头几天前被偷了，现在睡不着。为了制作新的枕头，他需要 20 根坚硬羽毛和 20 张皮革。我应该尽快收集，让克利思能好好睡一觉！你把克利思要求的东西交了上去，并收到了一些精炼铁和青铜。克利思终于能用新枕头睡个好觉了。回去找内拉接下一个活吧。

column1: Oh, thanks for coming! I just got a new request for you. It seems like Chris from the hardware store is having trouble sleeping these days. Apparently, someone stole his pillow... Now who in their right mind would steal a pillow? Geez.
column2: 哦，谢谢你来！我刚刚收到一个新请求给你。五金店的克里斯这些天似乎睡不好觉。显然，有人偷了他的枕头……现在谁心智正常会偷枕头呢？天啊。

column1: In any case, we need to make a new pillow, but it's not that easy to get the required materials. Can you get 20 Stiff Feathers and 20 pieces of Leathers ? That shouldn't be too difficult. Come see me after you have collected everything.
column2: 无论如何，我们都需要制作一个新的枕头，但是想要获得所需的材料却不是那么容易的。你能得到 20 根硬羽毛和 20 块皮革吗？那应该不会太难。收集完所有东西后来见我。

column1: Great work. It is a pleasure working with you, you know that? All right, let's talk rewards. Chris is giving you 1 Bronze Ingot and 1 Iron Ingot.
column2: 很棒的工作。和你一起工作很愉快，你知道吗？好了，说说奖励吧。克里斯给了你 1 个铜锭和 1 个铁锭。

column1: All right, if you need work sometime down the road, feel free to come back and see me.
column2: 好吧，如果你以后需要工作，请随时回来见我。

column1: I see you still haven't gathered the materials that Chris requested. You need 20 Stiff Feathers and 20 Leathers in order to create a new pillow. Just bring everything to me. Good luck!
column2: 我发现你还没有收集克里斯要求的材料。您需要 20 块硬羽毛和 20 块皮革才能制作一个新枕头。只要把所有的东西都带给我就可以了。祝你好运！

column1: I got a third request from Nella. Cutthroat Manny, the owner of the weapon shop, is quite the unusual foodie—he wants to cook up a special dish of Evil Eye Stir-Fry. He needs me to hunt 50 Evil Eyes and bring back 30 Evil Eye Tails. Sounds like he’ll be eating well for a while! Once I've gotten everything, bring it back to Nella.
column2: 我从内拉那里接到了第三个委托。武器店老板曼斯塔是个相当特别的美食家——他想做一道独眼兽尾巴炒菜。他需要我狩猎 50 只独眼兽，并带回 30 条独眼兽尾巴。看来他一段时间内都不用担心吃什么了！收集齐后，把东西交回给内拉。你把曼斯塔要求的东西交了上去，并收到了一双鞋作为回报。现在……曼斯塔暂时不用担心晚餐菜单了。帮了这个镇上的人之后，我感觉自己真的和他们亲近了不少！

column1: Just in time. I got work for you. You know Cutthroat Manny from the weapon store? He's got an enormous appetite, and not just for any old food, but EXOTIC food.
column2: 恰逢其时。我有工作给你。你认识武器店里的杀手曼尼吗？他胃口很大，不仅喜欢任何古老的食物，而且还喜欢异国情调的食物。

column1: There's this one dish that you couldn't pay other people to eat, but somehow, it's his favorite dish. It's called Evil Eye Tail Stew. Just thinking about it makes me want to heave. Ugh. But he craves that stuff like there's no tomorrow.
column2: 有这么一道菜，你不能付钱给别人吃，但不知何故，这是他最喜欢的菜。它的名字叫邪眼尾炖菜。光是想想就让我想要举起。啊。但他渴望那些东西，就像没有明天一样。

column1: But he ran out of the main ingredient, Evil Eye Tails . He says 30 Evil Eye Tails , after hunting 50 Evil Eyes , should be enough to keep him fed for a long time... That shouldn't be too hard for someone like you. Come see me after you have collected everything.
column2: 但主材邪眼尾已经用完了。他说30个邪眼尾，猎杀50个邪眼后，应该足够他吃很长一段时间了……这对你这样的人来说应该不是什么难事。收集完所有东西后来见我。

column1: Great work deserves great rewards. Cutthroat Manny is giving you a pair of shoes. May they take you far.
column2: 伟大的工作值得伟大的回报。凶手曼尼正在给你一双鞋子。愿他们带你走得更远。

column1: Thank you so much for helping so many people with their requests. For now, it seems like no one else needs help. You're a friend to everyone here in Kerning City now!
column2: 非常感谢您帮助这么多人满足他们的要求。目前看来，没有其他人需要帮助。您现在是废弃都市每个人的朋友了！

column1: I see you still haven't gathered the materials that Cutthroat Manny requested. He needs 30 Evil Eye Tails in order to create his favorite soup. Just bring everything to me. Good luck!
column2: 我发现你还没有收集到杀手曼尼要求的材料。他需要 30 根邪眼尾才能制作他最喜欢的汤。只要把所有的东西都带给我就可以了。祝你好运！

column1: You didn't forget that part of his request was to hunt 50 Evil Eyes , right?
column2: 你该不会忘记了，他的要求之一就是猎杀五十只邪眼吧？

column1: I met Jane Doe in Niora Hospital in Kerning City. Jane Doe needed to take off the bandages to see the surgery result, but there was no mirror. Jane Doe asked me to defeat 40 Stirges and collect 20 Broken Mirror Glasss.
column2: 听说废弃都市的尼奥拉医院里有个人……我在废弃都市尼奥拉医院遇到了无名女子。她需要拆下绷带看看手术结果，却没有镜子。她拜托我打倒 40 只蝙蝠魔，并收集 20 块破碎镜片……为了在尼奥拉医院遇到的陌生人，我真的收集了破碎镜片并带给了她。

column1: Man, why is it so cold here??? Um, hey... Do you know where Dr. Niora is, by any chance? Today's the day I get these bandages off, but I can't see anything. I need to see if the surgery went well. If you've got time, can you help me out??
column2: 老兄，这里怎么这么冷？？？嗯，嘿...你知道 Niora 博士在哪里吗？今天是我拆掉绷带的日子，但我什么也看不见。我需要看看手术是否顺利。如果你有时间的话可以帮我一下吗？？

column1: Ah... Thank you so much for agreeing to help me. I really want to take these bandages off and look in the mirror, but it seems there's no mirror in the hospital. I heard that Stirges , who live in the subway, may give out pieces of Broken Mirror Glass . Please defeat 40 of them and bring me 20 pieces of Broken Mirror Glass ... By the way, why is it so cold around here? Sigh... it's freezing.
column2: 啊……非常感谢你同意帮助我。我很想把这些绷带解下来照照镜子，但医院里好像没有镜子。我听说住在地铁里的斯蒂吉斯可能会赠送碎镜玻璃碎片。请打败40个，给我带来20块碎镜玻璃……对了，这里为什么这么冷？叹息……天冷了。

column1: I guess that's a no. Why is it so darn cold around here?? And where is Dr. Niora??
column2: ……我想这个答案是否定的。这里怎么这么冷？？尼奥拉博士在哪里？

column1: You're back... and with the pieces of Broken Mirror Glass ... Thank you so much.
column2: 你回来了……还带着破碎的镜子玻璃碎片……非常感谢你。

column1: I don't think you've gathered up 20 pieces of Broken Mirror Glass yet. Please get them for me... It's waaay too cold around here.
column2: 我认为你还没有收集到 20 块破碎的玻璃镜。请帮我拿一下...这里太冷了。

column1: Don't forget, you also need to defeat 40 Stirges.
column2: 别忘了，你还需要击败 40 个斯特吉斯……

column1: The Stranger I met in Niora Hospital is, surprisingly, a ghost! She remained in the hospital, unaware that she had died, waiting for Naora to return... Now unwilling to accept her death, she told me that in order to live again, she needs me to defeat 50 Zombie Mushrooms and collect 25 Charm of the Undeads. She asked for my help one last time. I wonder if that’s really all it takes to bring her back.
column2: 在尼奥拉医院遇到的陌生人，竟然是幽灵！她一直留在医院里，不知道自己已经死去，只是在等娜奥拉回来……如今她不愿接受自己的死亡，告诉我如果想重新活过来，就需要我打倒 50 只僵尸蘑菇，并收集 25 个亡灵护符。她最后一次请求我帮忙。不知道这样真的能让她回来吗……我在尼奥拉医院遇到的无名女子是幽灵。她留在医院里，却不知道自己已经死去。亡灵护符并不能让她复活。看来她其实早就知道自己不可能成功……真希望她能得到安息。

column1: Ah... this may be a little cracked, but I can definitely see myself with it.
column2: 啊……这可能有点裂痕，但我绝对可以看到我自己。

column1: Thank you so much. I need to get out of here as soon as I get these bandages off. It's waaay too cold in here.
column2: 非常感谢。我一解开绷带就得离开这里。这里太冷了。

column1: What the...! No way! What... What happened here?? Why can't I see myself in the mirror? Did I... DIE?????? No way, that can't be true! I can't be dead yet! Hey there, please help me out once more!
column2: 什么啊……！决不！这……这里发生了什么？为什么我在镜子里看不到自己？我……死了吗？？？？不可能，这不可能是真的！我还不能死！嘿嘿，请再帮我一次！

column1: When you defeat Zombie Mushrooms , they drop something called a Charm of the Undead , and from what I've heard, it has the power to revive the dead. Please defeat 50 Zombie Mushrooms and bring me 25 Charm of the Undead ! If I can get them, I might be able to come back from the dead.
column2: 当你击败僵尸蘑菇时，它们会掉落一种叫做亡灵符咒的东西，据我所知，它具有复活死者的力量。请击败 50 个僵尸蘑菇并给我带来 25 个不死符咒！如果我能得到它们，我也许就能起死回生……

column1: How can you be so cold! I'll be cursing you for the rest of eternity!
column2: 你怎么可以这么冷啊！我会诅咒你一辈子！

column1: Ahh, thanks for getting me the charms. I can't believe you got me all that... Well, I have to be honest with you. Even with those charms, I don't think I'll be coming back to life.
column2: 啊，谢谢你给我带来了魅力。我不敢相信你竟然得到了我这一切……好吧，我必须对你说实话。即使有这些魅力，我也不认为我会复活。

column1: Even if I come back alive with these charms, I won't be fully alive, per se, kind of like a zombie. I can't believe it took me this long to come to terms with it... but I will never forget the fact that you took great lengths to help me out. Thank you so, so much.
column2: 即使我带着这些魅力活着回来，我本身也不会完全活着，有点像僵尸。我不敢相信我花了这么长时间才接受它……但我永远不会忘记你不遗余力地帮助我这一事实。非常非常感谢。

column1: Do you like the cape that I gave you? It's a cape made of the devastating powers of the Charm of the Undead . I'll see you... around... somewhere... somehow.
column2: 你喜欢我送你的斗篷吗？这是一件由不死符咒的毁灭性力量制成的斗篷。我会在...附近...某个地方...以某种方式见到你...

column1: You still didn't get 25 Charm of the Undead ? Please hurry... It's so cold here.
column2: 你还没有获得25点亡灵魅力吗？请快点...这里太冷了。

column1: Don't forget, you also need to defeat 50 Zombie Mushrooms.
column2: 别忘了，你还需要击败 50 个僵尸蘑菇......

column1: Lakelis in Kerning City asked me to challenge the party quest "First Time Together” and defeat the King Slime inside. The party quest must be attempted by a party of four adventurers, all level 21 or higher. Once the party is ready, the party leader should speak to Lakelis. Better start looking for some friends to join me.
column2: 废弃都市的拉克莉丝似乎在寻找能一起挑战组队任务的队伍，这个任务需要多名冒险家合作完成。拉克莉丝让我挑战组队任务“第一次同行”，并打倒里面的绿水灵王。这个组队任务必须由 4 名等级 21 以上的冒险家组成队伍才能挑战。队伍准备好后，队长应该和拉克莉丝对话。看来该开始找朋友一起加入了。按照拉克莉丝的请求，我和朋友们挑战了组队任务“第一次同行”，并打倒了绿水灵王。只要大家齐心协力，就没有做不到的事！

column1: Hello, I'm Lakelis . Together with my sisters, Cloto and Nella (KPQ 1st Stage) , I look into the destinies of the adventurers who journey across Victoria Island. Have you ever wondered... is human destiny predetermined, or is it something we carve out ourselves?
column2: 你好，我是莱克利斯。我和我的姐妹 克鲁特 和 内拉（KPQ 第一阶段）一起探索穿越维多利亚岛的冒险家的命运。你有没有想过……人类的命运是预先决定的，还是我们自己创造的？

column1: Perhaps your arrival here is destiny as well. Hm... How uncharacteristic of me to ramble on like this. Well then, let's get to the point. The three of us are seeking a party that can work together to overcome difficult challenges.
column2: 也许你的到来也是命运的安排。嗯……这样胡言乱语真是不符合我的性格。那么，我们就进入正题吧。我们三人正在寻找一个能够共同努力克服困难挑战的政党。

column1: Form a party with three other companions, then challenge the party quest First Time Together. Inside, you will face various obstacles and must defeat King Slime before returning to me. How does that sound?
column2: 与其他三名同伴组成队伍，然后挑战队伍任务“第一次在一起”。在里面，你将面临各种障碍，必须击败史莱姆王才能回到我身边。听起来怎么样？

column1: Very well. If you and three other adventurers, all at least level 21, form a party and have the leader speak to me, I'll send you into the party quest First Time Together.
column2: 很好。如果你和其他三名冒险家（都至少达到 21 级）组成一个队伍并让领袖与我交谈，我将派你参加队伍任务“第一次在一起”。

column1: There are many obstacles and powerful monsters inside, so it's best to be thoroughly prepared with potions and anything else you might need. Gather your allies, then return to me when you're ready.
column2: 里面有很多障碍和强大的怪物，所以最好充分准备好药剂和其他你可能需要的东西。召集你的盟友，准备好后再回来找我。

column1: I see. A life of facing everything alone isn't necessarily bad. But if you change your mind, you're always welcome to return to me.
column2: 我明白了。独自面对一切的生活并不一定是坏事。但如果你改变主意，我随时欢迎你回到我身边。

column1: You've returned safely. We three sisters knew it was your destiny to challenge and overcome this party quest.
column2: 你已经安全回来了。我们三姐妹知道挑战和克服这个派对任务是你们的命运。

column1: It seems you've learned that, with the cooperation of allies, no difficulty is insurmountable.
column2: 看来你已经明白了，有了盟友的合作，没有什么困难是克服不了的。

column1: As thanks, I've raised your Fame and given you a scroll that will aid in your adventures. If you ever want to attempt the party quest again, just come back to me anytime.
column2: 作为感谢，我提高了你的声望，并给了你一个卷轴，它将帮助你的冒险。如果你想再次尝试聚会任务，请随时回来找我。

column1: It looks like you haven't defeated King Slime yet. Form a party with three companions, then have your leader speak to me to challenge the party quest First Time Together. Return to me once you've overcome the obstacles inside and defeated King Slime.
column2: 看起来你还没有打败史莱姆王。与三名同伴组成一支队伍，然后让你的领袖与我交谈以挑战队伍任务“第一次在一起”。一旦你克服了里面的障碍并击败了史莱姆王，就回到我身边。
随机奖励 - 以下之一：

column1: I met this girl named Shumi in Kerning City. She was devastated about losing the lucky coin that she borrowed from a friend, and she asked me to find it for her. She also told me that a bunch of guys draped in white cloth took it from her in the subway, and that I might find them at the Construction Site B1, deep in the station... I should go there first.
column2: 去废弃都市找休咪吧。我在废弃都市遇到了一个叫休咪的女孩。她因为弄丢了从朋友那里借来的幸运硬币而非常沮丧，拜托我帮她找回来。她还说，有一群披着白布的家伙在地铁里抢走了硬币，也许能在地铁深处的工地 B1 找到它们……我应该先去那里看看。你找到了废弃都市休咪丢失的硬币，并还给了她。从朋友那里借来的珍贵硬币啊……作为奖励，她给了你一堆回城卷轴……还不错！！她还说工地 B1 里能找到其他道具……以后应该去看看……

column1: Hey, um... Have you seen a coin around here? Oh my gosh, I'm in deep trouble... I was going to pay my friend back with that coin, so I put it in my pocket... I guess the coin fell out of it and fell deep into the subway. It's a special coin, so my friend's going to be really mad about it. Well, can I ask you a favor? Can you find it for me?
column2: 嘿，嗯...你在这附近看到过一枚硬币吗？哦，天哪，我遇到了大麻烦...我打算用那枚硬币还给我的朋友，所以我把它放进了我的口袋里...我猜硬币从里面掉了出来，掉进了地铁深处。这是一枚特殊的硬币，所以我的朋友会对它非常生气。嗯，我可以请你帮个忙吗？你能帮我找到吗？

column1: Thanks! Good thing I asked. Phew... I saw a couple of guys draped in white cloths picking the coin up and running away with it after I dropped it in the subway... I tried to chase them down, but the entrance was blocked, so I couldn't go much further.
column2: 谢谢！还好我问了。呼……我看见几个披着白布的家伙捡起我掉进地铁里的硬币就跑了……我想追他们，但入口被堵住了，我没法再往前走……

column1: The entrance must be somewhere in the subway... probably Construction Site B1 . Anyway, good luck... Everyone else turned me down because it was too dangerous for them. But you look strong, so I'm pretty confident that you'll find it for me.
column2: 入口一定在地铁的某个地方……可能是建筑工地B1。不管怎样，祝你好运……其他人都拒绝了我，因为这对他们来说太危险了。但你看起来很坚强，所以我很有信心你会为我找到它。

column1: You must be busy, huh? But if you ever change your mind, then please help me. I'm being serious here.
column2: 你一定很忙吧？但如果你改变主意，请帮助我。我在这里是认真的...

column1: Yeah, this is it! There are lots of different coins, but this one's special, because it was made the same year my friend was born. In short, they were created the same year... what? You want to know where the year is written? You must have bad eyes, because if you look close enough, you'll be able to see it.
column2: 是的，就是这个！有很多不同的硬币，但这一枚很特别，因为它是我朋友出生的同一年铸造的。简而言之，它们是同一年创建的……什么？您想知道年份写在哪里吗？你的眼睛一定不好，因为只要你看得足够近，你就能看到它。

column1: Besides, I borrowed this coin from her for a sec because it brings good luck. Anyway, thanks a lot. I can return it to my friend now... And, here, as a small sign of appreciation, this is for you. I collected these from the different towns I've visited over time.
column2: 另外，我向她借了这枚硬币，因为它能带来好运。不管怎样，非常感谢。我现在可以把它还给我的朋友...而且，作为一个小小的感激之情，这是给你的。我从我多年来访问过的不同城镇收集了这些。

column1: As a sign of appreciation, I bumped up your Fame and EXP a little. And, although too precious to give away, here they are: a whole bunch of the return scrolls to help you get back to town. I'll talk to you later then. Take care.
column2: 作为感激之情，我稍微提高了你的声望和经验值。而且，虽然太珍贵了，不能送人，但它们就在这里：一大堆返回卷轴，可以帮助你回到城镇。那我稍后再和你谈谈。小心。

column1: Still haven't found the coin that I lost? I'm screwed without it... Go to Construction Site B1 of the Kerning City Subway and maybe you'll find it... There's a lot of weird equipment there, so be careful. I believe in you!
column2: 还没有找到我丢失的硬币吗？没有它我就完蛋了...去废弃都市市地铁B1工地也许你会找到它...那里有很多奇怪的设备，所以要小心。我相信你！

column1: I ran into Shumi again in Kerning City. She seemed really worried about how she lost her rent money because a Stirge flew over and snatched a bundle of money away from her. Man... do I have to walk back in there again... can I just pay the rent for her? Anyway like last time, I need to go back in there, this time to Construction Site B2 and find the bundle of money she lost. Aye, better go in there now.
column2: 去废弃都市找休咪吧。我又在废弃都市遇到了休咪。她看起来很担心，因为一只蝙蝠魔飞过来，把她的房租钱整捆抢走了。唉……我还得再走进去一次吗……能不能干脆替她付房租？总之像上次一样，我需要回到里面，这次去工地 B2 找回她丢失的一卷现金。唉，还是赶紧进去吧……你帮废弃都市的休咪找回了丢失的一卷现金。这样她应该能付房租了……作为奖励，她给了你 30 个蓝色药水。她还说工地 B2 能找到其他道具……有空应该去看看……

column1: You came! I was waiting for you... because, well... I have a big problem. This time, I didn't just lose a coin; I lost a whole roll of cash. It happened so fast. I looked away for a second, and those Stirge punks took it and ran away. What do you think? Will you help me?
column2: 你来了！我在等你...因为，嗯...我有一个大问题。这次，我不仅丢了一枚硬币，还丢了一枚硬币。我损失了一整卷现金。事情发生得太快了。我把目光移开一秒钟，那些斯蒂奇小混混们接过它并跑掉了。你怎么认为？你会帮我吗？

column1: I knew you'd say yes! I saw them go into Construction Site B2 with my roll of money, but I couldn't chase them down there because there was a weird device on the entrance. That money is very important to me... I really need it. I know you can do it, so please find it and bring it back to me!
column2: 我就知道你会说是的！我看到他们带着我的钱进入B2工地，但我无法追到那里，因为入口处有一个奇怪的装置。这笔钱对我来说非常重要……我真的很需要它。我知道你能做到，所以请找到它并把它带回来给我！

column1: You must be busy, huh? But if you ever change your mind, then please help me. I'm being serious here.
column2: 你一定很忙吧？但如果你改变主意，请帮助我。我在这里是认真的...

column1: Hey, it's the roll of cash I lost! Phew... I'll be able to pay rent with this... What? How do I know if this is the money that I lost? Look... I wrote my name on it, really small... Can't see it? Are you sure you don't need a pair of glasses?
column2: 嘿，这是我丢的一卷现金！唷……我可以用这个付房租了……什么？我怎么知道这是否是我损失的钱？你看……上面写着我的名字，好小……看不到？你确定你不需要一副眼镜吗？

column1: Anyway, thank you sooo much. And you helped me out last time too... I keep turning to you for help... Don't worry, I'll reward you handsomely for it... but anyway, you should really look into helping with others' problems as a job... You're pretty good at it.
column2: 不管怎样，非常感谢你。上次你也帮了我......我一直向你寻求帮助......别担心，我会为此奖励你......但无论如何，你真的应该把帮助别人的问题作为一份工作......你很擅长。

column1: As a sign of appreciation, I bumped up your Fame and EXP a little. And, although too precious to give away, here's a bunch of Blue Potion that I've been collecting for months while traveling... So use them wisely! Next time I find myself in trouble, I'll look to you for help again, so please come, all right?
column2: 作为感激之情，我稍微提高了你的声望和经验值。而且，尽管这些蓝色药水太珍贵了，无法赠送，但这是我几个月来在旅行时收集的一堆蓝色药水……所以请明智地使用它们！下次我遇到麻烦的时候，我会再次向你寻求帮助，所以你就来吧，好吗？

column1: Still haven't found the roll of cash that I lost? Without it, I'll be homeless... That's my rent money! You can find it at Construction Site B2 in the Kerning City Subway . Be careful, there's some weird equipment around there. I believe in you.
column2: 还没有找到我丢失的那卷现金吗？没有它，我就会无家可归……那是我的房租钱！您可以在 Kerning 城市地铁的 B2 建筑工地找到它。小心点，周围有一些奇怪的设备。我相信你。

column1: I ran into Shumi again at Kerning City. A while ago, she got a favor from JM From tha Streetz to get some Screws for him, only to have the sack of money fall down and lose everything in the process. I guess I can find the sack of money in the deep part of the subway station, the Construction Site B3, again.
column2: 去废弃都市找休咪吧。我又在废弃都市遇到了休咪。之前，街头的 JM 拜托她去买螺丝，结果她的钱袋掉了，钱全丢了。我想这次也能在地铁站深处的工地 B3 找到那个钱袋。你在废弃都市地铁里找到了休咪丢失的钱袋。休咪现在可以买街头的 JM 要的东西了。你收到金币和一些药水作为礼物。以后应该去地铁的工地 B3 找找更多东西。

column1: Whoa... I've been waiting for you to come back! What? Did I lose money again? Yep... Well, this time, it's a lot... Someone I know asked me for a favor. He wanted me to get him 100 Screws . He gave me a Sack of Cash to buy them, so I put it in my pocket and was carrying it on me. It was super heavy, though! I accidentally dropped it, and it fell through a hole in the ground. And that's how I lost the money... Can you find it for me?
column2: 哇……我​​一直在等你回来！什么？我又亏钱了吗？是的...好吧，这一次，很多...我认识的人向我求助。他要我给他拿 100 个螺丝。他给了我一袋现金让我买，所以我把它放在口袋里并随身携带。不过它超级重！我不小心把它掉了，它从地上的一个洞里掉了出来。我就是这样丢了钱的……你能帮我找到吗？

column1: Thank you so much! Well, the person that asked for the favor is sitting waaaaaay down there. His name is JM From tha Streetz , and he worked hard for that money with his backdoor dealings. If he ever finds out that I lost that money, he'll go crazy on me. Don't be fooled by his appearance; he's got quite a temper... Argh... Pleaaase help me! Please help me find the Sack of Cash! You're the only one I can count on right now!
column2: 非常感谢！嗯，请求帮助的人就坐在那儿。他的名字叫 后街吉姆，他通过后门交易努力赚钱。如果他发现我丢了那笔钱，他一定会对我发疯的。不要被他的外表所迷惑；他脾气很大...啊...请帮帮我！请帮我找到一袋现金！你是我现在唯一可以依靠的人！

column1: I think I dropped the Sack of Cash deep in the Subway, in Construction Site B3 . I tried to go there and retrieve it myself, but there are even more weird devices all over the place down there. So I only managed to take a look at it from a distance. This may be difficult, even for you, this time around. Anyway, please, please, please get that Sack of Cash for me. I believe in you.
column2: 我想我把一袋现金扔进了地铁 B3 工地深处。我试图亲自去那里取回它，但那里到处都是更奇怪的设备。所以我只能远远地看看。这一次，即使对你来说，这也可能很困难。不管怎样，拜托，拜托，请帮我拿那袋现金。我相信你...

column1: You must be busy, huh? But if you ever change your mind, then please help me. I'm being serious here.
column2: 你一定很忙吧？但如果你改变主意，请帮助我。我在这里是认真的...

column1: Hey, it's the Sack of Cash I lost! Phew... It's all good now. I knew you'd find it... Seriously, you should become a professional for this... But hey... You didn't take any for yourself, right? Let me see... I'm not doubting your honesty, but I still have to count it... one... two... three... four... Hm, seems okay.
column2: 嘿，这是我丢的一袋现金！唷……现在一切都好了。我知道你会找到它...说真的，你应该成为这方面的专业人士...但是嘿...你没有为自己拿走任何东西，对吧？让我想想……我不怀疑你的诚实，但我还是得数一下……一……二……三……四……嗯，好像还可以。

column1: Thanks! Here's a reward for taking up my request.
column2: 谢谢！这是接受我的请求的奖励。

column1: I raised your EXP and Fame for helping me. I also gave you some Mesos, so spend them well. Oh, and I threw in some good potions too. Thanks again, and I'll let you know if I have any more troubles.
column2: 由于你们对我的帮助，我提高了经验值和声望。我还给了你一些金币，好好花吧。哦，我还放了一些好药水。再次感谢，如果我还有任何问题，我会告诉你。

column1: Still haven't found the sack of money that I lost? Without it, I don't know what he's going to do with me... You may find it at the Construction Site B3 of Kerning City subway. Be careful, there is some weird equipment in there. I believe in you.
column2: 还没有找到我丢失的那袋钱吗？没有它，我不知道他要拿我做什么……你可以在废弃都市地铁B3工地找到它。小心点，里面有一些奇怪的装备。我相信你。

column1: I got to talk to Icarus in Kerning City. Just what exactly is he doing staring aimlessly at the sky anyway? He seemed to be really bored, and asked me if I can answer his questions.
column2: 我应该去见站在废弃都市楼顶的伊卡路斯。他看起来无聊透了。我在废弃都市和伊卡路斯聊了聊。他到底为什么一直茫然地盯着天空呢？他似乎真的无聊到不行，问我能不能回答他的问题。你回答了废弃都市伊卡路斯提出的所有问题。很简单。

column1: Man, sooo bored. Hey, you! Do you have any free time right now? Do you wanna hang out with me? I'm seriously bored out of my mind here.
column2: 伙计，太无聊了。嘿，你！你现在有空闲时间吗？你想和我一起出去玩吗？我在这里实在是太无聊了。

column1: All right! Thanks... Now, what should we do? How about... I know, why don't I quiz you on some things? The questions won't be hard at all, so don't worry about it. Are you ready?
column2: 好吧！谢谢...现在，我们应该做什么？怎么样……我知道，我为什么不考考你一些事情呢？题目不会太难，不用担心。你准备好了吗？

column1: Oh, you're busy... I'm really bored, though. Don't you wanna hang out with me?
column2: 哦，你很忙……不过我真的很无聊。你不想和我一起出去玩吗？

column1: Wow, you're pretty good! You should be starring on a quiz show, the way you're answering these questions!
column2: 哇，你真不错！你回答这些问题的方式应该是智力问答节目的主角！

column1: I answered all of Icarus's questions, but he still seemed bored out of his mind. He asked me if I could get him a toy that he could play around with.
column2: 你回答了废弃都市伊卡路斯提出的所有问题。很简单。你答完了伊卡路斯的所有问题，但他还是无聊透了。他问你能不能给他找个可以玩的玩具。你和伊卡路斯一起玩得很开心。

column1: Hey, you were good at answering those questions! That was fun, except... I'm still bored. Can you do me one more favor? I need something to play with. Can you bring me 12 Tree Branches and 12 Squishy Liquids ? Please?
column2: 嘿，你很擅长回答这些问题！那很有趣，只是……我还是很无聊。你能再帮我一件事吗？我需要一些东西可以玩。你能给我 12 个树枝和 12 个软液体吗？请？

column1: I'll be here waiting. You better be back fast!
column2: 我会在这里等待。你最好快点回来！

column1: Wow, you brought all of it! Thank you so much! Thanks to you, I won't be so bored anymore. How should I thank you for your hard work? Hmmm... Here, take this!
column2: 哇，你全都带来了！太感谢了！谢谢你，我不再那么无聊了。我该怎么感谢你的辛劳呢？嗯……给，拿着这个！

column1: You don't have everything? Please help me... I'm bored out of my mind here.
column2: 你没有一切吗？请帮助我...我在这里太无聊了。

column1: I got to meet Icarus on top of a building at Kerning City. He seems like a nice guy who has an unquenchable thirst for flying, and he wants to create a hang glider to fulfill his dream of flying. He asks me if I can gather up the materials for the hang glider, and even though the process of making the hang glider seems dubious at best, I can't say no to his sincere desire to fly. I'll need to get him 30 Stirge Wings, 10 Processed Woods, and 15 Stiff Feathers.
column2: 据说废弃都市有个叫伊卡路斯的人，整天站在楼顶盯着天空看。我在废弃都市的楼顶见到了伊卡路斯。他看起来是个不错的人，对飞行有着无法满足的渴望，并想制作一架滑翔翼来实现飞翔的梦想。他问我能不能帮他收集制作滑翔翼的材料。虽然制作过程看起来相当可疑，但面对他真诚想飞的愿望，我无法拒绝。我需要给他收集 30 个蝙蝠魔翅膀、10 个加工木材和 15 根坚硬羽毛。你收集到了伊卡路斯制作滑翔翼并实现飞行梦想所需的材料。我只是好奇，蝙蝠魔翅膀真的足够做滑翔翼吗？不知道这是否真的能成功，但也许他会成功，所以等滑翔翼差不多准备起飞时，我应该再去看看他。

column1: Oh yeah, I truly believe we're meant to fly, and I will try my hardest to make that wish come true! That got me thinking, in order to fulfill my dream, I should make a huge hang glider! I read about it in a book, and it said you can fly like a bird using a hang glider. All I need now are the materials to build it, and... do you want to help me out here? If you get me the materials, I'll definitely let you ride on it. What do you think?
column2: 哦，是的，我真的相信我们注定要飞翔，我会尽我最大的努力去实现这个愿望！这让我想到，为了实现我的梦想，我应该制作一架巨大的悬挂式滑翔机！我在一本书上读到过，它说你可以使用悬挂式滑翔机像鸟一样飞翔。我现在需要的只是建造它的材料，而且……你想帮我吗？如果你给我拿到材料，我一定会让你骑的。你怎么认为？

column1: I've been waiting for a looong time! While you were out, gathering up the materials, I drew up the perfect blueprint for the glider! All we need now is to follow through with the plan, and we'll be up in the skies in no time! Did you gather all the materials?
column2: 我已经等了好久了！当你出去收集材料时，我绘制了滑翔机的完美蓝图！现在我们只需要按照计划执行，我们很快就会飞上天空！材料都收集齐了吗？

column1: Wow, that's a lot of stuff!! Well, I'll have to get started on making the hang glider. Drop by sometime later, I should be done by then. We'll be flying in no time!
column2: 哇，这么多东西！！好吧，我得开始制作悬挂式滑翔机了。稍后过来吧，那时我应该就完成了。我们很快就会起飞！

column1: Did you get all the materials I asked for? I don't think you have all of them! Please gather 30 Stirge Wings , 10 pieces of Processed Woods , and 15 Stiff Feathers ! The faster you get them for me, the earlier we'll be flying up in the air!
column2: 我要的材料你都拿到了吗？我不认为你拥有所有这些！请收集 30 个斯特吉之翼、10 块加工木材和 15 根坚硬羽毛！你越快给我拿到它们，我们就能越早飞上天空！

column1: Icarus failed to create a working hang glider, and is now attempting to create a flying balloon on his never-ending quest for flight. This looks just as preposterous as his last attempt, but I don't think I can stop him. To make the flying balloon, he needs 50 Tablecloths and 10 Alligator Skin Pouchs. Hope this works.
column2: 不知道伊卡路斯的滑翔翼做得怎么样了……也许我该去废弃都市看看他。伊卡路斯没能做出可以飞的滑翔翼，现在又在永无止境的飞行追求中尝试制作飞天气球。这看起来和上一次一样离谱，但我想我阻止不了他。为了制作飞天气球，他需要 50 块桌布和 10 个鳄鱼皮袋。希望这次能成功……你收集到了伊卡路斯制作飞天气球并实现飞行梦想所需的材料。不知道他的“飞天气球”到底能不能飞，但也许有成功的可能。等飞天气球差不多准备起飞时，我会再去看看他这次是不是认真的。

column1: Oh, that... well... I faced MINOR, I mean, MIIINOR technical difficulties, and... Well, don't worry about it! Icarus does NOT let MINOR obstacles like this affect him! Anyway, I was thinking of a safer and more reliable way to fly, and I think I have a great plan. Are you willing to help me out again?
column2: 哦，那个……好吧……我面临着MINOR，我的意思是，MIIINOR 技术困难，而且……好吧，别担心！伊卡洛斯不会让这样的小障碍影响他！不管怎样，我正在考虑一种更安全、更可靠的飞行方式，我想我有一个很棒的计划。你愿意再次帮我吗？

column1: I've been working on the basket, to see if it's sturdy enough to hold both of us. Now, all we need is a big balloon. Did you gather up the materials I asked you for?
column2: 我一直在研究篮子，看看它是否足够坚固，足以容纳我们俩。现在，我们需要的只是一个大气球。我要求你提供的材料你都收集齐了吗？

column1: Wow, that's a lot of stuff!! Well, I'll have to get started on making the balloon. Please drop by sometime later; I should be done by then. We'll be floating our way to Ossyria in no time!
column2: 哇，这么多东西！！好吧，我得开始制作气球了。请稍后再来；到时候我应该就完成了。我们很快就会漂流前往奥西里亚！

column1: Did you get all the materials I asked for? I don't think you have all of them! Please gather 50 Tablecloths and 10 Alligator Skin Pouches for me. You can get Alligator Skin Pouches from Ligators . Please hurry. The faster you get them for me, the faster we'll be floating up in the air!
column2: 我要的材料你都拿到了吗？我不认为你拥有所有这些！请为我收集 50 块桌布和 10 个鳄鱼皮袋。您可以从 Ligators 获得鳄鱼皮袋。请快点。你越快给我拿到它们，我们就能越快地漂浮在空中！

column1: Icarus failed to make the flying balloon, but his never-ending quest for flight continues. This time he wants to deviate from a scientific approach to flight and opt for a magical approach, and asks me to see his best friend Wing the Fairy in Ellinia, the town of fairies. Apparently Wing the Fairy knows how to make Flying Medicine... I'll need to see that fairy in Ellinia for Icarus's sake.
column2: 不知道伊卡路斯的飞天气球做得怎么样了……也许我该去废弃都市看看他。伊卡路斯没能做出飞天气球，但他永无止境的飞行追求还在继续。这次他想放弃科学的飞行方式，改用魔法，并让我去妖精之镇魔法密林找他最好的朋友——妖精维英。听说妖精维英知道如何制作飞天药水……为了伊卡路斯，我得去魔法密林找那位妖精。魔法密林的妖精维英似乎非常讨厌人类，甚至不愿意听我说话。

column1: Oh, that... well... I faced MINOR, I mean, MIIINOR technical difficulties, and... Well, I don't know what's wrong!! Is it really an impossible dream to realize? All I wanted to do was to fly! I can't let this deter me from my ultimate goal! I can't be giving up this soon. Can you help me out one last time?
column2: 哦，那个... 好吧... 我遇到了MINOR，我的意思是，MIIINOR 技术困难，而且... 好吧，我不知道出了什么问题！这真的是一个不可能实现的梦想吗？我只想飞翔！我不能让这阻止我实现我的最终目标！我不能这么快就放弃。你能帮我最后一次吗？

column1: What business does a human have with me? Don't bother me. I don't want to waste my time.
column2: 人类跟我有什么关系？别打扰我。我不想浪费时间。

column1: I met Wing the Fairy in Ellinia, and he doesn't seem to like people in general. How is he best friends with Icarus in the first place? Anyway, he says in order to make the Flying Medicine, he's going to need 50 Medicine With Weird Vibes and 20 Witchgrass Leafs. So that's all it takes?
column2: 想和妖精维英说上话似乎并不容易。我在魔法密林见到了妖精维英，他似乎一点也不喜欢人类。这样的人到底怎么会和伊卡路斯成为好朋友？总之，他说要制作飞天药水，需要 50 个奇怪感觉的药和 20 片魔草叶。就这些？按照妖精维英的要求，你收集了奇怪感觉的药和魔草叶。这样他就能做出飞天药水吗？

column1: Icarus ? You're here for him? He's my only human friend... All right, since you're here at his request, I'll make you the medicine. You should know that the ingredients I need are really hard to find. I wonder if you're even qualified to gather them all up.
column2: 伊卡洛斯？你是来找他的？他是我唯一的人类朋友……好吧，既然你是应他的要求来到这里的，那我就给你做药。你应该知道，我需要的原料真的很难找到。我想知道你是否有资格将它们全部收集起来。

column1: What are you trying to say? You don't even know what you're talking about! I'll use these for now, but it's not my responsibility if it comes out less than perfect. The ingredients you got me STINK!
column2: 你想说什么？你根本不知道自己在说什么！我现在会使用这些，但如果结果不完美，那不是我的责任。你给我的配料太臭了！

column1: Wing the Fairy of Ellinia asked me to take the Flying Medicine to Icarus. So this little pill is all it takes to fly? I need to get this to Icarus ASAP.
column2: 看来能实现伊卡路斯梦想的飞天药水终于完成了。魔法密林的妖精维英让我把飞天药水带给伊卡路斯。只靠这么一小颗药丸就能飞？我得立刻把它交给伊卡路斯。你把魔法密林妖精维英制作的飞天药水交给了伊卡路斯。希望它对他有用。

column1: Okay, I mix this with that, and add that with this, and... okay, I'm done! Here, take it.
column2: 好吧，我将这个与那个混合，然后将那个与这个相加，然后......好吧，我完成了！在这里，拿走吧。

column1: It's a very rare medicine, so it should only be taken by Icarus and no one else. If you have any desire to take that it for yourself, don't even think about it. It will ONLY work on Icarus.
column2: 这是一种非常稀有的药物，所以只能由伊卡洛斯服用，其他人不能服用。如果你想占为己有，想都别想。它仅适用于伊卡洛斯。

column1: What, you don't need it anymore? That's fine with me. Humans are so self-centered and fickle.
column2: 什么，你不再需要它了？这对我来说没问题。人类是如此以自我为中心且善变的。

column1: Oh you're back!! Did you meet up with Wing the Fairy ? What about the medicine? The medicine! Did you bring it?
column2: 哦你回来了！！你见到了翼仙子了吗？药呢？药！你带来了吗？

column1: Wow, this is it. This medicine will enable me to fly anywhere I desire and finally realize my dream. Thank you so much for all your help. Here's a little thank you present from me. Hopefully it'll help you down the road. I'll see you around!
column2: 哇，就是这个。这种药将使我能够飞向任何我想去的地方，最终实现我的梦想。非常感谢您的帮助。这是我送给你的一点感谢礼物。希望它能对您有所帮助。我会再见的！

column1: You haven't given the medicine to Icarus yet? I thought I told you it won't work on anyone else but him, meaning YOU CAN'T FLY WITH IT. Now that you know, go see Icarus immediately and give him the medicine, all right?
column2: 你还没有把药给伊卡洛斯吗？我想我告诉过你这对除了他以外的任何人都不起作用，这意味着你不能用它飞行。既然你知道了，就立刻去见伊卡洛斯，给他下药，好吗？
随机奖励 - 以下之一：

column1: Right here, in this dusty town of Perion, I ran into an oddly-dressed man named "Blackbull." He told me he needs to fix his house and wondered if I could help him out by defeating 20 Stumps and 20 Dark Stumps and getting him 10 Tree Branches and 10 Leafs. If I do him a favor, I'll get a nice shield from him, but what if I say no? I wouldn't... be... EATEN BY HIM... no?? I really hope not.
column2: 听说勇士部落的“黑牛”正在修房子。就在这个尘土飞扬的勇士部落，我遇到了一个打扮奇怪、名叫“黑牛”的男人。他说自己需要修理房子，问我能不能帮他打倒 20 个木妖和 20 个黑木妖，并带来 10 根树枝和 10 片叶子。如果帮他，他会给我一个不错的盾牌，但如果我拒绝呢？我不会……被他……吃掉吧……不，希望不会……你帮勇士部落的“黑牛”打倒了 20 个木妖和 20 个黑木妖，并带回 10 根树枝和 10 片叶子。有了这些，他终于能修好房子了。你得到了这个盾牌作为奖励……不过……到处都是刮痕，看起来也很旧……这真的还能用吗？

column1: Can you defeat 20 Stumps and 20 Dark Stumps and get me 10 Tree Branches and 10 Leafs ? I want to renovate my house. If you can do this for me, I will give you a nice shield that I no longer need... You should be able to get those items from the tree-like creatures nearby.
column2: 你能打败 20 个树桩和 20 个黑暗树桩并给我 10 根树枝和 10 片叶子吗？我想装修我的房子。如果你能为我做到这一点，我会给你一个我不再需要的漂亮盾牌......你应该能够从附近的树状生物那里得到这些物品......

column1: Incredible! You must be someone special, to be able to get that many. Hmm... All right, the shield is yours. It's my favorite one. Please take good care of it.
column2: 难以置信！你一定是一个特别的人，才能得到这么多。嗯……好吧，盾牌是你的了。这是我最喜欢的一个。请好好照顾它。

column1: I guess you still haven't collected 10 Tree Branches and 10 Leafs.
column2: 我猜你还没收集到 10 根树枝和 10 片叶子......

column1: Don't forget, you also need to defeat 20 Stumps and 20 Dark Stumps.
column2: 别忘了，你还需要击败20个树桩和20个黑暗树桩。
随机奖励 - 以下之一：

column1: I ran into "Blackbull" again, the guy whose house I helped fix. He was surprised at how strong I looked and asked me for a much harder favor. His cousins from Henesys are all trying to move to Perion, so he needs to build a new house! To build a new house, he said he needed 100 Stone Golem Rubbles, 30 Screws, 30 Processed Wood, and "Blackbull's" deed to the land. His son had the deed to the land, but it was stolen by Curse Eyes near Sleepywood... hmmm... I should be looking for those wandering around the deep forest.
column2: 听说勇士部落的“黑牛”正在建新房子……我再次遇到了“黑牛”，也就是之前我帮忙修房子的那个人。他惊讶于我看起来变强了很多，于是拜托我一个更困难的忙。他在射手村的亲戚们都想搬到勇士部落，所以他需要建一栋新房子！他说要建新房子，需要 100 个石头人碎片、30 个螺丝、30 个加工木材和“黑牛”的地契。他儿子原本拿着地契，但被林中之城附近的风独眼兽偷走了……嗯……我应该去森林深处找那些游荡的怪物。为了让“黑牛”的亲戚们都能搬到勇士部落，你帮他收集了所需物品。真的很辛苦，希望他下次不要让我亲手给他盖房子……

column1: Hey, it's you! Got pretty famous since the last time I saw you, huh? Well, thanks to you, I got my house fixed just fine. But hmm... There's a problem... All my relatives from Henesys want to move to this town. I need to build a new house for them, but I don't even have the materials to build with.
column2: 嘿，是你！自从我上次见到你以来，你已经很有名了，是吗？嗯，多亏了你，我的房子才修好了。但是嗯...有一个问题...我所有来自 射手村 的亲戚都想搬到这个小镇。我需要为他们建造一座新房子，但我连建造的材料都没有……

column1: Well hey! Sorry to ask you for another favor, but can you get the stuff necessary to build a house for my cousins? So many relatives are coming in that things like a Tree Branch or Leafs from last time won't do. Do you think you could help? I'll tell you what to get instead.
column2: 好吧嘿！很抱歉再请你帮个忙，但是你能为我的表兄弟姐妹们提供建造房子所需的材料吗？这么多亲戚进来，上次的树枝或树叶之类的东西是不够的。你认为你能帮忙吗？我会告诉你该买什么。

column1: I'll need 100 Stone Golem Rubbles , 30 Screws , and 30 pieces of Processed Wood . But with only these... Well, a couple of days ago, a document titled Blackbull's Deed to the Land that I purchased disappeared... My son said he was attacked by monsters while carrying the deed.
column2: 我需要 100 个石傀儡碎石、30 个螺丝和 30 块加工过的木材。但只有这些……好吧，几天前，我购买的一份名为《黑牛土地契约》的文件消失了……我儿子说他在携带契约时遭到了怪物的袭击。

column1: Reptiles called Curse Eye that live in the forest took the deed to the land. Can you help me get the deed and the necessary materials to build the house? If so, then you'll be handsomely rewarded for your work... Good luck!
column2: 生活在森林里的被称为诅咒之眼的爬行动物将契约带到了陆地上。你能帮我拿到建造房子的契约和必要的材料吗？如果是这样，那么您的工作将会得到丰厚的回报...祝您好运！

column1: THIS is the deed to the land that my son lost! And you brought all the necessary materials to build the house! Thank you so much... my relatives can all move in and live in Perion ! As a sign of appreciation.
column2: 这是我儿子失去的土地的契约！你带来了建造房子所需的所有材料！非常感谢...我的亲戚都可以搬进来住在 勇士部落 了！作为赞赏的标志...

column1: Okay, now choose the scroll of your liking... Their success rates are all 10%.
column2: 好了，现在选择你喜欢的卷轴吧……他们的成功率都是10%。

column1: Hopefully the scroll I gave you helps. Here's a little bit of money too. I'll never forget the fact that you helped me. For that, I'll spread the news of your good deed all over the town. What do you think? Anyway, thank you so much for helping me out. We'll probably meet again.
column2: 希望我给你的卷轴能帮到你。这里还有一点钱。我永远不会忘记你帮助过我的事实。为此，我要把你的善行传遍全镇。你怎么认为？不管怎样，非常感谢你帮助我。我们或许还会再见面的……

column1: Looks like you haven't gotten all the necessary materials. Please get 100 Stone Golem Rubbles , 30 Screws , 30 pieces of Processed Wood , and the lost Blackbull's Deed to the Land . Please hurry, before they eat the deed.
column2: 看来您还没有获得所有必要的材料。请获得 100 个石傀儡碎石、30 个螺丝、30 块加工木材以及丢失的黑牛土地契约。请快点，在他们吃掉这件事之前……

column1: I came across Manji again, whom I had first met in Perion when making the medicine for Maya, the little girl in Henesys. Surprised at how much stronger I had become, Manji asked me for a favor. Long ago, when he was in danger of being struck down by Balrog, he was saved by the legendary hero Tristan, who died in his place. Ever since then, Manji had held onto Tristan’s sword. But the blade, corrupted by Balrog’s evil aura, has become so worn down that it can hardly even be called a sword anymore… Manji handed me the k he had been keeping and asked me to awaken it back to its true form. Once fully awakened, it is said to become the k. Just as Manji said, I should seek out Chrishrama in Sleepywood.
column2: 去勇士部落找麦吉。我再次遇到了麦吉，之前为了给射手村的小女孩玛雅制作药时，我曾在勇士部落见过他。他惊讶于我变强了这么多，于是拜托我一件事。很久以前，他差点被蝙蝠魔击倒时，被传说中的英雄特里斯坦所救，而特里斯坦也因此代他死去。从那之后，麦吉一直保存着特里斯坦的剑。但这把剑被蝙蝠魔的邪恶气息侵蚀，已经破损到几乎不能称为剑了……麦吉把一直保管的旧战剑交给我，请我将它唤醒成真正的形态。据说完全觉醒后，它会成为英雄战剑。按照麦吉所说，我应该去林中之城找克里斯拉玛。我在林中之城见到了克里斯拉玛，并询问了唤醒旧战剑的方法。

column1: Who's bothering me now... Hey!! You have a knack for annoying me, even at the best of times... Well, that's all right. If you have indeed gotten that much stronger, then I'd like to see it firsthand. Did you put the Arcon's Blood to good use? Well, it's all in the past, so.
column2: 现在谁在打扰我...嘿！！即使在最好的时候，你也有惹恼我的本领……好吧，没关系。如果你真的强大到了这种程度，那我倒是想亲眼看看。你充分利用了阿肯之血吗？好吧，一切都过去了，所以……

column1: I would like you to help me out. Of course, I could take care of it myself, but I can't leave this area. What do you think...? You seem to have gotten strong enough to handle it easily... Will you take a crack at it?
column2: 我希望你能帮助我。当然，我可以自己处理，但我不能离开这个区域。你怎么认为...？你似乎已经变得足够强大，可以轻松应对它......你会尝试一下吗？

column1: Good choice. A few decades ago, I went into a huge cave in the middle of this island. In there, I felt this force of evil only I could feel, and I was sucked into it, following it deeper into the cave... I felt a sense of danger inside, but that didn't stop me from walking further into the cave.
column2: 不错的选择。几十年前，我走进了这座岛中央的一个巨大洞穴。在那里，我感受到了这股只有我才能感受到的邪恶力量，我被它吸了进去，顺着它向山洞的深处……我感觉到了里面的危险感，但这并没有阻止我向山洞的深处走去。

column1: By the time I regained consciousness, everything around me was blue. And in the middle of darkness I saw a pair of piercing eyes staring at me. He was... yeah, the mythical, legendary Balrog. Possessing a huge set of wings and teeth so sharp they could cut through anything.
column2: 当我恢复意识时，周围的一切都是蓝色的。黑暗中，我看到一双锐利的眼睛正盯着我。他是……是的，神话般的传奇炎魔。拥有巨大的翅膀和锋利的牙齿，可以切开任何东西......

column1: I've spent all my life fighting, but his presence was undeniably overwhelming. My mind was telling me it was impossible to beat him, but he was already right in front of me. His weighty tail went up, high up... and starting moving towards me!
column2: 我一生都在战斗，但不可否认的是，他的存在是压倒性的。我的大脑告诉我不可能打败他，但他已经在我面前了。他沉重的尾巴扬起，高高地扬起……并开始向我移动！

column1: Right at that second, someone stood in its way. This man, with a mysterious aura around his sword, fought Balrog head on, allowing me to escape. After rescuing me, he was struck by Balrog and fell. He was... yes, the legendary hero Tristan.
column2: 就在这时，有人挡住了它的去路。这个男人，剑上带着神秘的气息，与炎魔正面交锋，让我逃脱了。救了我之后，他被炎魔击倒了。他是……是的，传奇英雄特里斯坦。

column1: I went to him... but he didn't look like he had much of a chance. Before it was too late, he handed me the Old Gladius , worn out by the sheer evil of Balrog, and then passed away. This is that same sword right here. I would love to restore this to its original state.
column2: 我去找他……但他看起来没有多少机会。在为时已晚之前，他把那把因炎魔的邪恶而磨损的旧短剑交给了我，然后就去世了。这是同一把剑。我很想将其恢复到原来的状态。

column1: The sword becomes Hero's Gladius once it is reawakened. However, as for the details of how to reawaken it, I have no idea. I think you have to eliminate the evil force of Balrog, though... You should go see Chrishrama from Sleepywood and ask about it.
column2: 一旦被重新唤醒，这把剑就会成为英雄的短剑。不过，至于具体如何重新唤醒，我就不知道了。我认为你必须消灭炎魔的邪恶力量，不过……你应该去见沉睡林的克里斯拉玛并询问此事。

column1: Hah... You must be still holding on to the fact that I thought nothing of you before... You can't catch up to me with that mindset! Now, I'm not so sure if I'll accept you, even if you do change your mind... hahah.
column2: 呵……你一定还抱着我以前没把你放在心上的事实吧……你这样的心态是追不上我的！现在，我不太确定我是否会接受你，即使你改变主意......哈哈。

column1: Old Gladius ... A few decades ago, when I found out that Tristan had passed away, I couldn't believe my ears. I was the one that made the Hero's Gladius for him. I thought anyone worthy of possessing that sword would have been indestructible. I heard that the sword has since gone bad... has it gone old and rusty?
column2: 老剑士……几十年前，当我得知特里斯坦去世时，我简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。我是为他制作英雄短剑的人。我认为任何值得拥有这把剑的人都将是坚不可摧的。听说这把剑已经坏了……是不是又旧又生锈了？

column1: I will be waiting for you here.
You want to know how to awaken a sword? But which sword are you talking about? Don't tell me you've lost it.
column2: 想知道如何觉醒剑吗？但你说的是哪把剑呢？别告诉我你已经失去了它...

column1: I want you to awaken the Old Gladius that I gave you into Hero's Gladius . Chrishrama of Sleepywood may know how to do it. If you return the reawakened sword to me... I'll definitely reward you for your hard work. Let's see if you can do this.
column2: 我想让你将我给你的旧短剑唤醒成英雄短剑。 林中之城 的 克利斯拉玛 可能知道该怎么做。如果你把复活的剑还给我的话……我一定会奖励你的努力。让我们看看你是否能做到这一点...

column1: You lost the Old Gladius I gave you? You fool! But even your mistake worked out in my favor--I happened to pick up what you dropped. I can't believe I trusted someone like you with such a precious sword... Don't lose it again.
column2: 你丢了我给你的旧剑？你这个傻瓜！但即使你的错误对我有利——我碰巧捡起了你掉下的东西。我不敢相信我竟然信任像你这样的人，并拥有如此珍贵的剑……不要再失去它了。

column1: I showed Chrishrama Manji's k, and he claimed to have made it himself. He said he needs 1 Star Rock, 1 Piece of Ice, 1 Ancient Scroll, and 1 Flaming Feather to awaken it. Unfortunately, I've never heard of any of those items... He recommended talking to Mike in Perion Dungeon Entrance to find them.
column2: 去林中之城找克里斯拉玛唤醒旧战剑。我把麦吉的旧战剑拿给克里斯拉玛看，他说这把剑是他亲手打造的。他说需要 1 个星石、1 个冰块、1 张古代卷轴和 1 根火焰羽毛才能将它唤醒。遗憾的是，这些东西我一个都没听说过……他建议我去勇士部落迷宫入口找麦克打听。我收集到了觉醒所需的材料，并带给了克里斯拉玛。克里斯拉玛用这些材料把旧战剑重新唤醒成英雄战剑。这是一把散发神秘光芒的好剑……可惜我得把它交给麦吉。

column1: So you want to reawaken this sword. It won't be an easy task, though. Not only will you need to gather up hard-to-find materials, but you'll also need to acquire a rare scroll. But if you still want to go along with it... Then I'll need you to gather up the materials I'm about to tell you. I don't know if you can do it, but.
column2: 所以你想重新唤醒这把剑。但这并不是一件容易的事。你不仅需要收集难以找到的材料，还需要获得稀有卷轴。但如果你还想同意的话……那么我需要你收集我要告诉你的材料。我不知道你是否能做到，但是...

column1: Bring me 1 Star Rock , 1 Piece of Ice , 1 Ancient Scroll , and 1 Flaming Feather ... I'm not sure how you can get these items... but Mike in Perion Dungeon Entrance might know something.
column2: 给我带来 1 个星石、1 个冰块、1 个远古卷轴和 1 个火焰羽毛...我不知道如何获得这些物品...但佩里昂地下城入口的迈克可能知道一些事情...

column1: My goodness! You actually collected 1 Star Rock , 1 Piece of Ice , 1 Ancient Scroll , and 1 Flaming Feather ! All right, then.
column2: 天啊！你竟然收集到了星石1块、冰块1块、上古卷轴1张、火羽1块！好吧，那么。

column1: Hold on, one second. I haven't done this in ages, but... with these materials, I may be able to pull off the magic and reawaken the Old Gladius.
column2: 等一下，等一下。我已经很久没有这样做了，但是……有了这些材料，我也许能够实现魔法并重新唤醒旧剑。

column1: Incredible... Tristan's sword... I didn't think I'd live to see this again.
column2: 难以置信……特里斯坦的剑……我没想到我还能活着看到这一幕。

column1: I may have gone old and gray, but my eyes cannot be deceived. Please gather up 1 Star Rock , 1 Piece of Ice , 1 Ancient Scroll , and 1 Flaming Feather , because I don't think you have them all yet.
column2: 我也许已经苍老、白发苍苍，但我的眼睛是不会被欺骗的。请收集 1 个星石、1 个冰块、1 个上古卷轴和 1 个火焰羽毛，因为我认为你还没有全部拥有。

column1: With Chrishrama’s help, I was able to awaken the entrusted by Manji into the . All that remains is to return the sword to Manji.
column2: 经历许多困难后，我终于收集齐了克里斯拉玛要求的所有材料。现在只能相信他的力量了。在克里斯拉玛的帮助下，我把麦吉托付给我的旧战剑唤醒成了英雄战剑。剩下的就是把剑还给麦吉。看来麦吉所说的这把英雄战剑确实是一把好剑。面对英雄战剑和麦吉给出的骷髅耳环，我不得不做出艰难选择，但我不会后悔自己的决定。

column1: I don't know who left you with this, but please tell that person that this sword is meant to be used for good. My work is done. So long.
column2: 我不知道是谁给你留下了这把剑，但请告诉那个人，这把剑是用来做善事的。我的工作完成了。这么久...

column1: Yes... it is this sword indeed, the sword that saved me then...!
column2: 是的……确实是这把剑，当年救了我的剑……！

column1: What do you think...? Are you going to keep the Hero's Gladius , or are you going to return it to me like you promised? If you return it, I'll reward you with the earrings that my friend left me with before he passed away.
column2: 你觉得怎么样...?你会保留英雄的短剑，还是会像你承诺的那样把它还给我？如果你归还的话，我会奖励你我朋友去世前留给我的耳环。

column1: What happened to Old Gladius ? Have you still not awakened it?
column2: 老格拉迪乌斯怎么了？你还没觉醒吗？

column1: What became of the sword I awakened for you? I only hope it has been put to good use.
column2: 我为你觉醒的剑怎么样了？我只希望它能得到很好的利用......

column1: Winston, the archeologist who I ran into in the rocky mountains on the east side of Perion, said he lost the fossils he collected near Perion. He asked me to bring back 12 Animal Fossils and 12 Plant Fossils that were taken by Green Mushrooms and Axe Stumps. How can he lose something so important like that? He's more careless than he looks.
column2: 听说考古学家温斯顿正在勇士部落东侧的岩石山脉寻找什么东西……我在勇士部落东边的岩石山脉遇到了考古学家温斯顿。他说自己把在勇士部落附近收集的化石弄丢了。他拜托我找回被绿蘑菇和斧木妖拿走的 12 个动物化石和 12 个植物化石。这么重要的东西怎么会弄丢？他比看起来还粗心……你找到了温斯顿丢失的化石。

column1: Hello, there, nice to meet you. I'm Winston the archeologist, and I'm looking for fossils of prehistoric life.
column2: 你好，很高兴认识你。我是考古学家温斯顿，我正在寻找史前生命的化石。

column1: Perion may be a land of dry, rocky mountains today, but it used to be a fertile land full of tall trees and lots of creatures, much like Ellinia . Can you believe that? I'm looking for evidence from that era. If you are not busy and all, can you help me out?
column2: 今天的佩里安可能是一片干燥的岩石山脉之地，但它曾经是一片肥沃的土地，长满了高大的树木和大量的生物，就像魔法密林一样。你能相信吗？我正在寻找那个时代的证据。如果你不忙的话，可以帮我一下吗？

column1: Thank you. I ran into something odd yesterday. I went to Perion for some food, and when I came back, I found my tent raided by monsters. They took my fossils and ran away.
column2: 谢谢你。昨天我遇到了一些奇怪的事情。我去勇士部落找了些食物，回来后发现我的帐篷被怪物袭击了。他们拿走了我的化石然后逃跑了。

column1: Looking at the footprints, it seems like the culprits are Green Mushrooms and Axe Stumps . Please go take care of them and gather up 12 Animal Fossils and 12 Plant Fossils for me. Thanks, and good luck!
column2: 从脚印来看，罪魁祸首就是青蘑菇和斧头桩。请你去照顾他们，给我收集十二块动物化石和十二块植物化石。谢谢，祝你好运！

column1: Kids these days are so selfish, saying no to an old man's favor. Fine, please leave.
column2: 现在的孩子太自私了，拒绝老人的恩惠。好吧，请离开。

column1: I don't think you've gathered them all up yet. These materials are important. Please try harder.
column2: 我认为你还没有把它们全部收集起来。这些材料很重要。请再努力一点。

column1: Don't forget to take down the monsters too.

Winston the Archeologist said that it is not safe to leave the valuable fossils in the tent. He asked me to take the fossils and deliver them to Dr. Betty in Ellinia. He also wrote a letter of introduction for me to show her.
column2: 看来勇士部落东侧岩石山脉的考古学家温斯顿还有另一个请求。考古学家温斯顿说，把珍贵化石放在帐篷里不安全。他让我把化石带去魔法密林交给贝蒂博士。他还写了一封介绍信让我给她看。勇士部落的考古学家温斯顿说，把珍贵化石留在帐篷里不安全，让我把它们送到魔法密林的贝蒂博士那里。贝蒂博士说接下来会很忙，让我之后再来帮她。化石啊……我要不要试试呢？

column1: Oh my, these are it! Thank you so much; I finally got them back thanks to you. Phew, that saved me from losing years of my work. Since you did such a fine job recovering those for me... Can you help me out one more time?
column2: 天哪，就是这些！太感谢了;多亏了你，我终于把它们找回来了。唷，这让我免于失去多年的工作成果。既然你帮我恢复了这么好的工作……你能再帮我一次吗？

column1: Thank you so much. You're unlike the other young people these days, who seem so selfish and self-absorbed. I think leaving the fossils that you worked hard to recover here in the tent is too dangerous. I don't know when the monsters will raid again, but I can't leave this place. I have more fossils to recover.
column2: 非常感谢。你不像现在的其他年轻人，他们看起来很自私、只顾自己。我觉得把辛苦打捞出来的化石留在帐篷里太危险了。不知道什么时候怪物会再次袭击，但我却无法离开这个地方。我还有更多化石需要挖掘。

column1: Please give this letter of introduction to Dr. Betty of Ellinia , who's a renowned biologist. And please give this Fossil Box to her. Thank you, and good luck.
column2: 请将这封介绍信交给魔法密林的贝蒂博士，她是一位著名的生物学家。请把这个化石盒子给她。谢谢你，祝你好运。

column1: I may have asked you for too big a favor. I'm sure you must be busy and all. I'll have to ask someone else for this. Take care then.
column2: 我可能要求你帮忙太大了。我相信你一定很忙。这个我得去问别人。那就保重吧。

column1: Dr. Winston sent you for me? He must be in Perion, recovering fossils.
column2: 温斯顿博士派你来找我吗？他一定是在勇士部落，正在寻找化石……

column1: Ohh, these are the fossils. Seeing this letter, it looks like Dr. Winston trusts you quite a bit. I may need some help once I start investigating these, so please drop by and see me if you have some time. This is your reward for a job well done. I'll see you around.
column2: 哦，这些是化石。看到这封信，看来温斯顿博士对你相当信任。一旦我开始调查这些问题，我可能需要一些帮助，所以如果您有时间，请顺便来见我。这是对您出色完成工作的奖励。我会再见的。

column1: And--Who are you?? I'm a very busy person, and if you don't have anything for me, please leave. When is the person Dr. Winston sent coming?
column2: 还有——你是谁？？我是一个很忙的人，如果你没有什么可以给我的，请离开。温斯顿博士派来的人什么时候来？

column1: I think you left this here... you have to be more careful than that.
column2: 我想你把这个留在这里了...你必须更加小心。

column1: Dr. Betty asked me to work as an assistant for a while. My first task from her is to collect 20 Plant Samples. I can see various plants covering the woods in Ellinia.
column2: 魔法密林附近的生物学家贝蒂博士正在寻找助手。贝蒂博士让我暂时做她的助手。她交给我的第一项任务是收集 20 个植物样本。魔法密林的树林里到处都是各种植物。作为贝蒂博士助手的第一份工作，我在魔法密林的树林里收集了一些植物并取样。感觉也不算太难。

column1: You're the one that got me Dr. Winston's Fossil Box , right? Good to see you. You didn't forget my plea for help down the road. I've been busily working on the fossils these days. Can you help me out by any chance?
column2: 你就是给我拿到温斯顿博士化石盒的人，对吧？很高兴见到你。你没有忘记我在路上请求帮助。这些天我一直在忙着研究化石。你能帮我一下吗？

column1: Thank you. I've been busily investigating the leaf fossils of a plant, but this is much tougher than I thought. The leaves that are shown on this fossil are very uniquely formed.
column2: 谢谢你。我一直在忙着调查植物的叶子化石，但这比我想象的要困难得多。这块化石上显示的叶子形状非常独特......

column1: I need samples to compare against. You'll find various plants all around Ellinia. I need you to gather up a few of those, 20 Plant Samples to be exact. I'll be waiting for you. Please hurry!
column2: 我需要样品来比较。您会在魔法密林周围发现各种植物。我需要你收集其中一些，确切地说是 20 个植物样本。我会等你。请快点！

column1: The plants that can be used for samples are usually bigger than other plants. They grow in the northern forest of Ellinia . You'll be able to find them in no time.
column2: 可用于样品的植物通常比其他植物更大。它们生长在魔法密林北部森林中。您很快就能找到它们。

column1: I thought you were going to help me out. If I have to do this by myself, I'll have to get going now. Please don't bother me. See you around.
column2: 我以为你会帮我。如果我必须自己做这件事，我现在就必须开始。请不要打扰我。再见。

column1: I thought I told you 20 Plant Samples . Did you completely forget about it?
column2: 我想我已经告诉过你 20 个植物样本了。你完全忘记了吗？

column1: Dr. Betty in Ellinia told me that she needs 1 Stuffed Drake Skull for her research. She asked me to find her daughter near Henesys, and bring it back to her. Where would Anne be?
column2: 看来魔法密林附近的生物学家贝蒂博士还有另一个请求。魔法密林的贝蒂博士告诉我，她的研究需要 1 个填充飞龙头骨。她让我去射手村附近找她的女儿，并把东西带回来。安妮会在哪里呢？我在射手村附近遇到了独自玩耍的贝蒂博士的女儿安妮。

column1: These are indeed 20 samples. They are in pretty good shape too. Thank you for your hard work. This will help me immensely on my studies with the plant fossils. Dr. Winston must've recommended you for a reason... Well, I have one more favor to ask. Will you help me out?
column2: 这确实是 20 个样本。他们的状态也很好。感谢您的辛勤工作。这将对我对植物化石的研究有很大帮助。温斯顿博士推荐你一定是有原因的……好吧，我还有一事要请。你会帮我吗？

column1: To start working on the animal fossils, I'll need samples I can compare with. Looking at these fossils, a Stuffed Drake Skull seems like the perfect sample for comparison. Can you bring it to me?
column2: 要开始研究动物化石，我需要可以比较的样本。看看这些化石，填充德雷克头骨似乎是进行比较的完美样本。你能把它带给我吗？

column1: Ah, don't be too shocked. I know Drakes are not to be messed with for most people. I have a Stuffed Drake Skull that I gathered a few years ago. The problem is, I didn't bring it with me to Ellinia because I came here for plant fossils. Since I can't leave this place, I'm hoping you can get it for me.
column2: 啊，别太震惊。我知道对于大多数人来说，德雷克是不值得被打扰的。我有一个几年前收集的填充德雷克头骨。问题是，我没有把它带到魔法密林，因为我来这里是为了植物化石。既然我不能离开这个地方，我希望你能为我找到它。

column1: Around Henesys , you'll find my daughter. Ask her for the Stuffed Drake Skull . Her name is Anne.
column2: 在 射手村 附近，你会找到我的女儿。向她要龙头骨标本。她的名字叫安妮。

column1: I thought you were going to help me out... oh well, I'll see you around.
column2: 我以为你会帮我……哦，好的，回头见。

column1: Oh my goodness, you got them all right! My mom DID send you here.
column2: 天哪，你都答对了！我妈妈确实派你来这里的。

column1: I received the Stuffed Drake Skull from Anne, Dr. Betty's daughter. Now I have to deliver this carefully to Dr. Betty.
column2: 看来安妮手里有贝蒂博士需要的东西。我从贝蒂博士的女儿安妮那里收到了填充飞龙头骨。现在必须小心地把它交给贝蒂博士……你收集了一些植物样本和填充飞龙头骨，帮助贝蒂博士研究化石。我真期待研究结果……我应该去见贝蒂博士，因为她说回去后会告诉我结果。

column1: Here's the Stuffed Drake Skull . Will you give this to my mom?
column2: 这是填充的德雷克头骨。你会把这个给我妈妈吗？

column1: She asked you for this for her work, right? I hope she finishes her studies soon.
column2: 她为了工作向你要这个，对吗？我希望她能尽快完成学业。

column1: You don't need it? I thought you were sent here to get the Stuffed Drake Skull from me. If you don't need it, then oh well.
column2: 你不需要它吗？我以为你被派来这里是为了从我这里拿走填充的龙头骨。如果你不需要它，那么哦...

column1: Hey, you're back. I forgot to tell you this, but Anne is very careful and difficult for strangers to deal with. She just thinks twice before being nice to strangers. I should have given you a letter of approval.
column2: 嘿，你回来了。我忘了告诉你这一点，但安妮非常小心，很难与陌生人打交道。她在对陌生人友善之前会三思而后行。我应该给你一封批准信。

column1: Wow, incredible! Anne must have trusted you, to give you this! She's my daughter and all, but she can be quite a handful at times... How did you do that? You truly are someone I can count on. Now, I can move forward with the animal fossil studies. Please drop by when I'm done. I'll tell you what I find.
column2: 哇，难以置信！安妮一定是信任你，才给你这个！她是我的女儿，但她有时可能很难对付……你是怎么做到的？你确实是我可以信赖的人。现在，我可以继续进行动物化石研究了。当我完成后请过来。我会告诉你我发现了什么。

column1: Are you here empty handed? Where's the Stuffed Drake Skull that I asked you to get? Please hurry.
column2: 你空手来这里吗？我让你去拿的填充德雷克头骨在哪里？请快点。

column1: Mom must be waiting. Shouldn't you return to her soon?
column2: 妈妈一定在等。难道你不应该尽快回到她身边吗？

column1: You lost it????? Sigh... Please don't lose it again.
column2: 你丢了？？？？唉……请不要再失去它了。

column1: I met Dr. Betty again. She told me the research was finished and explained it to me, then asked me to take the research report and deliver it to Dr. Winston in Perion. Dr. Betty also informed me that if I take 20 Leafs, 15 Firewoods, 1 Stump's Teardrop, and 1 pair of Weighted Earrings, Dr. Winston would be really happy.
column2: 听说贝蒂博士已经完成了化石研究。也许我该去看看结果。我再次见到了贝蒂博士。她告诉我研究已经完成，并向我说明了内容，然后让我把研究报告交给勇士部落的温斯顿博士。贝蒂博士还告诉我，如果带上 20 片叶子、15 个木柴、1 个木妖的眼泪和 1 对重力耳环，温斯顿博士会非常高兴。你把贝蒂博士的化石报告交给了勇士部落的温斯顿博士。连同报告一起，你还给了他叶子、木柴、木妖的眼泪和重力耳环。作为回报，温斯顿博士给了你树叶耳环。

column1: Been a while. Thanks to you, I have successfully completed my research.
column2: 已经有一段时间了。感谢您，我成功地完成了我的研究。

column1: The fossils you got for me were critical materials. Those fossils contain clues that may lead us to discover the secrets behind the special abilities of prehistoric life. If we can use them well, they will help us regular people out tremendously.
column2: 你给我的化石是重要的材料。这些化石包含的线索可能会引导我们发现史前生命特殊能力背后的秘密。如果我们能够很好地利用它们，它们将为我们普通人提供巨大的帮助。

column1: I need to send Dr. Winston of Perion the final report on the results of the studies. Can you help me out?
column2: 我需要将研究结果的最终报告发送给 勇士部落 的温斯顿博士。你能帮我一下吗？

column1: I knew you'd help me out. Please get the final report to Dr. Winston . Oh, before you go, gather 20 Leafs , 15 pieces of Firewood , 1 Stump's Teardrop , and 1 pair of Weighted Earrings . I guarantee Dr. Winston will be very pleased... He may even reward you with something nice.
column2: 我就知道你会帮我。请将最终报告交给温斯顿博士。噢，在你走之前，收集20片叶子，15块木柴，1个树桩的泪珠，和1对加重的耳环。我保证温斯顿博士会非常高兴...他甚至可能会奖励你一些好东西。

column1: Ahhh, you may have never heard of Stump's Teardrop . Stump's Teardrop is a rare crystal you can only get from the Dark Axe Stump.
column2: 啊哈，你可能从未听说过树桩的泪珠。树桩的泪珠是一种稀有水晶，只能从暗斧树桩中获得。

column1: You must be very busy. I'll have to ask someone else for this.
column2: 你一定很忙。这个我得去问别人。

column1: Welcome, welcome. You're the one that helped me get my fossils back the other day. I heard that you've also helped Dr. Betty with her studies. She said she gave you the final report for me to look at. Did you bring it?
column2: 欢迎，欢迎。前几天你是帮我拿回化石的人。我听说你也帮助贝蒂博士学习。她说她给了你最后的报告让我看。你带来了吗？

column1: Please also give me the materials that you've gathered up. Those materials will be used to conduct studies regarding the final report. Dr. Betty did tell you this in advance, right?
column2: 也请把你收集到的材料给我。这些材料将用于对最终报告进行研究。贝蒂博士确实提前告诉过你了，对吗？

column1: Wow... A huge secret written in the fossils! The more I dig up fossils, the more they amaze me. They never cease to surprise me, on many levels.
column2: 哇……化石里写着一个巨大的秘密！我挖掘的化石越多，它们就越令我惊讶。他们在很多层面上总是让我感到惊讶。

column1: Do you like the earrings? They're the result of the studies we have conducted here. They are laden with the abilities of the Stump , so use them wisely!
column2: 你喜欢耳环吗？它们是我们在这里进行的研究的结果。它们充满了树桩的能力，所以明智地使用它们！

column1: What's up? Aren't the fossil studies going well? I'm more than ready to take a look at the results.
column2: 怎么了？化石研究进展顺利吗？我已经准备好看看结果了......

column1: Hand the report that I gave to you to Dr. Winston . Oh yeah! Before going, remember to take him 20 Leafs , 15 pieces of Firewood , 1 Stump's Teardrop , and 1 pair of Weighted Earrings.
column2: 把我给你的报告交给温斯顿博士。噢耶！去之前记得给他带上20片叶子、15块木柴、1个树桩的泪珠和1对加重耳环。

column1: Did you lose the final report? My oh my, you better be really careful. Good thing I made a number of copies, in case something like this happened. Now, please get this to Dr. Winston SAFELY.
column2: 最终报告丢失了吗？天哪，天哪，你最好小心一点。还好我复印了很多份，以防万一发生类似的事情。现在，请安全地将其交给温斯顿博士。

column1: I met Ayan in Perion. Apparently, she cannot remember anything about her childhood, and she lives everyday in fear of Stumps. She's so scared that she can't even dare to look at them. Due to this paralyzing fear of Stumps, she cannot take one step out of Perion, and asks me to take them out for her sake. Are they really THAT scary?
column2: 勇士部落的阿燕说她一步都不敢离开镇子。为什么呢……我在勇士部落见到了阿燕。她似乎完全不记得自己的童年，而且每天都生活在对木妖的恐惧中。她怕到连看都不敢看它们一眼。因为这种对木妖的强烈恐惧，她一步都不敢离开勇士部落，所以拜托我替她清理木妖。它们真的有那么可怕吗？你为了勇士部落的阿燕打倒了木妖。她终于可以放心走出镇子，不用再害怕它们了！

column1: Excuse me. I know it's rude to ask a stranger, but can you please help me out? I'm terrified of the Stumps that are wandering around outside this town and can't leave because of them. I can't even make eye contact with them without being scared to death. Please, if you have some time on your hands, can you help me out?
column2: 打扰一下。我知道询问陌生人很不礼貌，但是你能帮我吗？我很害怕那些在镇外徘徊的树桩，因为它们而无法离开。我什至无法与他们进行目光接触而不被吓死。拜托，如果您有时间的话，可以帮我一下吗？

column1: Thank you so much. I knew you would say yes. As you can see, I am not from the tribes here. According to the elders, they found me lost in the streets years ago, all bruised up and messy.
column2: 非常感谢。我知道你会说是的。正如你所看到的，我不是这里部落的人。据长辈们说，他们几年前在街上发现了我，我浑身青肿，脏兮兮的。

column1: The elders saved me, and I have been living here ever since. Unfortunately, I don't remember anything from the past. Something might have happened back then.
column2: 长辈救了我，从此我就住在这里。不幸的是，我不记得过去的任何事情。那时可能发生了什么事情。

column1: I think I can't remember my past because I went through something so horrible that my head chose to block it all out. Maybe that's why I'm so scared of Stumps . Can you do me a favor and take out some Stumps please?
column2: 我想我不记得我的过去了，因为我经历了一些如此可怕的事情，以至于我的大脑选择将其全部屏蔽掉。也许这就是我如此害怕树桩的原因。你能帮我一个忙，取出一些树桩吗？

column1: You must be busy. If you find some spare time later on, please come by and talk to me.
column2: 你一定很忙。如果你以后有空的话，请过来和我谈谈。

column1: Wow, thank you so much! I don't see as many Stumps near Perion now! I feel like I can finally take a step outside. Thank you so much for your hard work!
column2: 哇，非常感谢你！我现在在佩里安附近看不到那么多树桩了！我感觉我终于可以走出去一步了。非常感谢您的辛勤工作！

column1: I don't think you've gotten all the Stumps yet. Please help me; I want to be able to go out of town as soon as I can.
column2: 我认为你还没有得到所有的树桩。请帮我;我希望能够尽快出城。

column1: I met up with Ayan in Perion. She told me that a few days ago, a group of tribespeople went hunting in the swamp and wound up being ambushed by a group of alligators. She was worried about the sudden surge of alligators taking over the swamp and asked me to reduce their numbers before they spawn out of control. I'll have to kill 100 Ligators and 40 Jr. Neckis and pick up 20 Jr. Necki Skins along the way.
column2: 听说勇士部落的族人出了事。我应该去问问阿燕。我在勇士部落见到了阿燕。她告诉我，几天前一群族人去沼泽打猎时，被一群鳄鱼伏击。她担心突然增多的鳄鱼会占领沼泽，拜托我在它们失控繁殖前减少数量。我需要打倒 100 只鳄鱼和 40 只小青蛇，并顺路收集 20 张小青蛇皮。勇士部落的族人在沼泽被鳄鱼群伏击，所以阿燕请求我帮忙清理鳄鱼。你打倒了 100 只鳄鱼和 40 只小青蛇。希望这样能让沼泽恢复一些平静。

column1: It's been a while since I last saw you. How have you been? Unfortunate events have happened recently here in Perion . A few days ago, a group of tribespeople went hunting in the swamp near Kerning City to acquire some alligator skins, only to be ambushed by them. They came back alive, but they were seriously injured.
column2: 自从我上次见到你已经有一段时间了。你最近怎么样？最近，勇士部落这里发生了不幸的事件。几天前，一群部落居民到废弃都市附近的沼泽地打猎，想要获取一些鳄鱼皮，却遭到了他们的伏击。他们虽然活着回来了，但是却受了重伤。

column1: People haven't gone to the swamp for quite a while. During that time, the number of alligators increased dramatically, to the point where they are starting to attack people. Even Dances with Balrog has taken notice, and he has been just as concerned about it as we are. Can you help us, please?
column2: 人们已经很久没有去沼泽地了。在那段时间里，鳄鱼的数量急剧增加，甚至开始攻击人类。就连武术教练也注意到了，他和我们一样关心这一点。你能帮助我们吗？

column1: Thank you. Because of these recent events, Dances with Balrog decided we should hire an outsider to take care of the alligators. Since he is a very busy man, however, I have assumed the task of picking out that someone to help us, and I choose you. So please head over to the swamp and take out 100 Ligators and 40 Jr. Neckis and bring back 20 Jr. Necki Skins as evidence.
column2: 谢谢你。由于最近发生的这些事件，武术教练决定我们应该聘请一名外来者来照顾鳄鱼。然而，由于他是一个非常忙碌的人，所以我承担了挑选那个人来帮助我们的任务，我选择了你。因此，请前往沼泽，取出 100 个结扎器和 40 个 小青蛇，并带回 20 个 小青蛇 皮肤作为证据。

column1: The swamp can be reached through the sewage pipe in Kerning City . I believe in you. Good luck.
column2: 通过废弃都市的污水管可以到达沼泽地。我相信你。祝你好运。

column1: You looked powerful enough to handle the task, at least in my eyes. Please reconsider your choice, because... if the alligators keep spawning in the swamp like this, it'll be really dangerous for everyone here, later down the road.
column2: 你看起来足够强大来完成这项任务，至少在我看来是这样。请重新考虑你的选择，因为……如果鳄鱼继续像这样在沼泽中产卵，那么对这里的每个人来说都会非常危险，以后会很危险……

column1: You're back earlier than expected! That's incredible! I knew I had asked the right person for the job. Thanks to you, there should be considerably fewer Ligators in the swamp now. Thank goodness.
column2: 你回来得比预计的还要早！那真是难以置信！我知道我已经找到了合适的人选来做这份工作。多亏了你，现在沼泽里的鳄鱼应该少了很多。谢天谢地...

column1: Did you bring the Jr. Necki Skins with you? I also have something for you as a sign of my appreciation for your hard work. Which of these do you need?
column2: 您带了 小青蛇 皮肤吗？我还为您准备了一些东西，以表达我对您辛勤工作的感谢。您需要其中哪一个？

column1: Jr. Necki Skins can also be used as medicine. I wanted you to bring them so that I could use them on people who have been attacked by the alligators. This scroll is our way of saying thanks, so please take it and put it to good use.
column2: 小青蛇 Skins 也可入药。我想让你把它们带来，这样我就可以用它们来治疗那些被鳄鱼袭击的人。这卷轴是我们表达谢意的方式，所以请收下并好好利用它。

column1: Please don't forget to bring back 20 Jr. Necki Skins.
column2: 请不要忘记带回 20 个 小青蛇 皮肤。

column1: Please take out 100 Ligators and 40 Jr. Neckis.
column2: 请拿出 100 条结扎器和 40 条小项链。

column1: I found Ayan, and she seemed to be panicking. She was walking around the swamp when she ran into a bigger, stronger, and more dangerous group of alligators than the previous one. She ran back to Perion and has been looking for me to ask me for help ever since. This time, I'll need to kill 120 Crocos and bring back 50 Croco Skins along the way.
