column2: 勇士部落的阿燕正在急切地找我。出了什么事吗？我找到了阿燕，她看起来非常慌张。她在沼泽附近走动时，遇到了一群比之前更大、更强也更危险的鳄鱼。她逃回勇士部落后就一直在找我求助。这次，我需要打倒 120 只青鳄鱼，并顺路带回 50 张青鳄鱼皮。按照阿燕的请求，你在沼泽里打倒了 120 只青鳄鱼。以后得时不时回到那个地方，在鳄鱼失控繁殖前清理它们。

column1: Good to see you again. Actually, I've been waiting for you. I never had a chance to formally thank you for taking out the Ligators at the swamp before. Thanks to your heroics, the people at the tribe had been feeling safe passing by the area.
column2: 很高兴再次见到你。其实我一直在等你。我以前从未有机会正式感谢你在沼泽地干掉了鳄鱼。感谢您的英雄事迹，部落的人们在经过该地区时感到很安全。

column1: Lately, however, we found out that a bunch of Crocos have been residing in the deeper parts of the swamp. Crocos are much more powerful and intimidating than Ligators , and they can cause havoc unlike any of the alligators in this world. So here I am, asking you for help one more time. Please help us take out the alligators. Can you do that for us?
column2: 然而最近，我们发现沼泽深处栖息着一群鳄鱼。鳄鱼比鳄鱼更强大、更令人生畏，而且与世界上任何鳄鱼不同，它们可以造成严重破坏。所以我在这里再次请求你的帮助。请帮助我们消灭鳄鱼。你能为我们做吗？

column1: Thank you so much. I honestly couldn't think of anyone else to ask for a task like this. Please head to the swamp, take out 120 Crocos , and bring 50 Croco Skins back with you. Don't worry, you'll be rewarded well for this.
column2: 非常感谢。老实说，我想不出还有其他人可以要求这样的任务。请前往沼泽，取出 120 个鳄鱼，并带回 50 个鳄鱼皮。别担心，你会因此得到丰厚的回报。

column1: Ah... Please reconsider. We need your help, but--oh, I'm sorry... You must be busy with something else. But please think about it, and if you have a change of heart, return to me.
column2: 啊……请再考虑一下。我们需要你的帮助，但是——哦，对不起……你一定在忙别的事情。但请想一想，如果你改变主意，就回到我身边。

column1: You are truly amazing. You singlehandedly took out all those Crocos ! Thanks to your incredible effort, we can all feel safe now walking across the swamp.
column2: 你真是太棒了。你一个人就把那些鳄鱼都干掉了！感谢你们的努力，我们现在可以安全地穿越沼泽了。

column1: Here's your reward. Please choose one to your liking.
column2: 这是你的奖励。请选择您喜欢的一项。

column1: Thank you so much. Your heroics will be recorded and passed down from generation to generation amongst our tribe, and we'll make good use of these Croco Skins . They are a high quality leather that can be used for multiple purposes. I hope you have a safe journey. Best of luck to you.
column2: 非常感谢。你们的英雄事迹将会被我们的部落记录下来并代代相传，我们会好好利用这些鳄鱼皮的。它们是一种高品质皮革，可用于多种用途。希望您旅途平安。祝你好运。

column1: Please don't forget to bring 50 Croco Skins.
column2: 请不要忘记带 50 张鳄鱼皮。

column1: Please defeat 120 Crocos in the swamp.
column2: 请击败沼泽中的 120 只鳄鱼。

column1: At the VIP sauna in Sleepywood, I met this bald man called Mr. Wetbottom. He has a son, and apparently he ran away from home one day with a book that he cares deeply for. He requested that I find his son and get the book back from him. For a reward, he's offering me a nice sauna robe. He also told me his son Ronnie hangs out at a tree tunnel around Ellinia, so maybe I can find him there. Anyway, is that book more important to him than his son?? What kind of a book is it anyway...????
column2: 听说林中之城的沃特巴顿先生最近很不顺……我应该去看看他。在林中之城高级桑拿房，我遇到了一位名叫沃特巴顿先生的秃头男子。他有个儿子，据说某天带着他非常重视的一本书离家出走了。他请求我找到儿子，并把那本书拿回来。作为报酬，他愿意给我一件不错的桑拿服。他还说儿子罗尼常在魔法密林附近的树洞一带活动，也许能在那里找到他。话说，那本书比他儿子还重要吗？到底是什么书啊……按照在高级桑拿房遇到的沃特巴顿先生的请求，我在魔法密林的树洞里找到了罗尼。

column1: Good job getting here. Actually, I have a favor to ask you. If you accept it, I'll give you a piece of clothing that you'll need in return. I think you are more than capable of doing it. Even if you don't care, please just listen to my story first.
column2: 干得好，来到这里。事实上，我有件事想拜托你。如果你接受的话，我会给你一件你需要的衣服作为回报。我认为你完全有能力做到这一点。即使你不在乎，也请先听听我的故事。

column1: I have a son that can do no wrong. But one day he took a book of mine that is very dear to me and left. That book... hmmm... I can't tell you the details, but it is a very, very important book to me.
column2: 我有一个不会做错事的儿子。但有一天，他拿走了我非常珍视的一本书，然后离开了。那本书……嗯……我不能告诉你细节，但这对我来说是一本非常非常重要的书……

column1: If you get me that book back safely, I'll give you a comfortable article of clothing, perfect for saunas like this. What do you think? Will you find my son and take back that book?
column2: 如果你安全地把那本书给我拿回来，我会给你一件舒适的衣服，非常适合这样的桑拿。你怎么认为？你能找到我儿子并拿回那本书吗？

column1: Ohhh... Thank you so much. It won't be easy locating my son on this humongous Victoria Island. I'm guessing that he may be in a passage made of trees near the forest at Ellinia , because that's his favorite spot... Best of luck to you!
column2: 哦……非常感谢。在这个巨大的维多利亚岛上找到我的儿子并不容易。我猜他可能在魔法密林森林附近的一条树木通道里，因为那是他最喜欢的地方……祝你好运！

column1: I see... I guess you're busy with things here and there... but I'd definitely reward you handsomely for your work. So if you ever change your mind, please let me know.
column2: 原来如此……我猜你正忙着各种事情……不过我肯定会为你的工作给予丰厚的奖励。因此，如果您改变主意，请告诉我。

column1: Hey, who are you? You know my dad well?
column2: 嘿，你是谁？你很了解我爸爸吗？

column1: You haven't found my son yet, huh? He took a very important book with him. I'll definitely reward you handsomely for your work. He may be in a passage made of trees, in the forest near Ellinia.
column2: 你还没找到我儿子吧？他随身带着一本非常重要的书。我一定会给你丰厚的报酬。他可能在魔法密林附近森林里的一条树木通道里。

column1: Inside a tree tunnel around Ellinia, I found Ronnie, the son of Mr. Wetbottom. He said he could never hand over the red book, but he looked pretty hungry. Ronnie asked me to defeat Lupins in the western area of Ellinia and bring back 30 Lupin's Bananas.
column2: 在魔法密林附近的树洞里，我找到了沃特巴顿先生的儿子罗尼。他说绝不会把红色的书交出来，但看起来相当饿。罗尼让我去魔法密林西部打倒猴子，带回 30 个猴子香蕉。你给饥饿的罗尼带来了许多猴子香蕉。但看起来他还想吃更多……

column1: Ah... You want this red book, huh?? I see... My daddy likes this book more than he likes me! This book... NO, I can't give you this book!! (stomach growling...) Ahhh!
column2: 啊……你想要这本小红书吧？？我明白了……我爸爸喜欢这本书胜过喜欢我！这本书...不，我不能给你这本书！ （肚子咕咕叫……）啊啊啊！

column1: No... no... I'm NOT hungry...! Dang... a-all right. I'll give you back the book. BUT! Not for free! I'm starving, and I need some food, so... if you get me something to eat, the book is yours. I promise!
column2: 不...不...我不饿...！该死……好吧。我会把书还给你。但！不是免费的！我饿了，我需要一些食物，所以...如果你给我一些吃的，这本书就是你的了。我保证！

column1: I want to eat 30 Lupin's Bananas . How can I eat that many, you ask? Don't worry about that.
column2: 我想吃 30 根羽扇豆香蕉。你问我怎么能吃那么多？不用担心这个。

column1: If you ever get hungry on the way back and eat some of them... my dad's book is going to the Curse Eyes ! So you better take care of that food!!!
column2: 如果你在回来的路上饿了，就吃一些……我爸爸的书是去诅咒之眼的！所以你最好照顾好食物！

column1: Wow! That's 30 Lupin's Bananas , just like I asked for! Let's see... Maybe I'll try one right now!
column2: 哇！这是 30 根羽扇豆香蕉，就像我要的一样！让我们看看...也许我现在就尝试一下！

column1: You haven't gotten the 30 Lupin's Bananas yet? Bring them to me, and I'll give my dad's book back to you. I promise!
column2: 您还没有拿到 30 根羽扇豆香蕉吗？把它们带给我，我会把我爸爸的书还给你。我保证！

column1: Don't forget to teach those Lupins a lesson too!
column2: 别忘了也给那些羽扇豆一个教训！

column1: Ronnie said the Lupin's Bananas weren’t enough and asked me to go see Rina at Henesys to get.
column2: 罗尼说猴子香蕉还不够，让我去射手村找丽娜，拿丽娜的鳗鱼特餐。为了喂饱饥饿的罗尼，我先去找了射手村的丽娜。

column1: The Lupin's Bananas you brought were pretty good, but... somehow, they weren't enough. Eating them reminded me of the yummy food I used to have with my dad back in Henesys.
column2: 你带来的羽扇豆香蕉很不错，但是……不知怎的，还不够。吃它们让我想起了我在赫尼西斯时和爸爸一起吃的美味食物。

column1: The cooking of Big Sis Rina in Henesys is the best in the world! Ahhh... If I could have Rina's Unagi Special again, maybe I'd even give you that book back!
column2: 射手村里娜姐姐的厨艺是世界第一的！啊……如果我能再吃一次里娜的鳗鱼特辑，也许我什至会把那本书还给你！

column1: So, you know what to do, right? Go find big sis Rina in Henesys and ask her about Rina's Unagi Special !
column2: 所以，你知道该怎么做，对吗？去射手村找姐姐丽娜，问问她丽娜的烤鳗鱼 Special吧！

column1: So, you came here as a favor for Ronnie ? Hahaha... Hopefully Ronnie isn't causing any mischief. Anyway, he wants Rina's Unagi Special , huh? It's pretty easy to make, so why don't you just sit around and wait for a little bit while I cook this dish.
column2: 那么，你来这里是为了帮罗尼一个忙？哈哈哈……希望罗尼没有造成任何恶作剧。无论如何，他想要丽娜的鳗鱼特制，是吧？做起来很容易，所以你为什么不坐下来等我做这道菜呢……

column1: Rina of Henesys requested 50 Curse Eye Tails and 10 Pig's Heads for the.
column2: 射手村的丽娜要求 50 条风独眼兽尾巴和 10 个猪头，用来制作丽娜的鳗鱼特餐。你把制作丽娜的鳗鱼特餐所需的东西全都带给了她。

column1: Oh shoot. I don't have Curse Eye Tails or Pig's Heads , the most important ingredients in unagi. Do they really go in the dish? Oh, of course! Just please keep that a secret from Ronnie , ok?
column2: 哦，射击。我没有诅咒眼尾或猪头，这是鳗鱼中最重要的成分。它们真的会放进盘子里吗？哦，当然！请对罗尼保密，好吗？

column1: Anyway, I don't have enough ingredients to make unagi. Sorry, but can you gather up the ingredients for me? If you bring me 50 Curse Eye Tails and 10 Pig's Heads , I can make Rina's Unagi Special.
column2: 无论如何，我没有足够的材料来做鳗鱼。抱歉，你能帮我收集一下原料吗？如果你给我50个诅咒眼尾和10个猪头，我可以让莉娜的鳗鱼变得特别。

column1: You got all the ingredients! I knew you could do it... All right, now just wait ooone second. I, Rina, proudly present Rina's Unagi Special !
column2: 你已经准备好了所有的原料！我知道你能做到...好吧，现在等一下。我，莉娜，自豪地呈现莉娜的鳗鱼特辑！

column1: Please get me 50 Curse Eye Tails and 10 Pig's Heads . Then I'll make you Ronnie's favorite, Rina's Unagi Special.
column2: 请给我50个诅咒眼尾和10个猪头。然后我会给你做罗尼最喜欢的，丽娜的鳗鱼特制。

column1: I brought everything Rina asked for and received . I just hope Ronnie will be satisfied with this.
column2: 你带齐了丽娜要求的东西，并收到了丽娜的鳗鱼特餐。希望罗尼这次会满意……你把丽娜的鳗鱼特餐带给了罗尼。那孩子看起来吃得很开心！

column1: Ok, here it is, Rina's Unagi Special ! You should take this to Ronnie before it gets cold. It's his favorite.
column2: 好啦，这就是莉娜的鳗鱼特餐！你应该在天气变冷之前把这个带给罗尼。这是他的最爱。

column1: As expected, Rina's Unagi Special is the best! Now I get why Dad loves it so much!
column2: 果然，丽娜的鳗鱼特制是最好吃的！现在我明白为什么爸爸这么喜欢它了！

column1: Oh my, you lost the Rina's Unagi Special that I cooked with such care? Are you sure you didn't eat it yourself? Well, never mind. I made plenty, so I'll give you another bowl. But this time, make sure you deliver it to Ronnie , okay?
column2: 哎呀，我精心烹制的莉娜特制鳗鱼你丢了？你确定不是你自己吃的？好吧，没关系。我做了很多，所以我再给你一碗。但这一次，一定要把它交给罗尼，好吗？

column1: While eating , Ronnie said he needed something to drink and asked me to go see Rowen the Fairy of Ellinia to get Fresh Milk.
column2: 罗尼一边吃丽娜的鳗鱼特餐，一边说自己需要喝点东西，让我去魔法密林找妖精罗雯拿新鲜牛奶。为了给罗尼解渴，我去见了魔法密林的妖精罗雯。

column1: But now that I'm eating Rina's Unagi Special , I'm starting to feel a little thirsty... Come to think of it, I heard the fairies of Ellinia have some really cool and tasty milk.
column2: 但是现在吃着丽娜的鳗鱼特制，我开始感觉有点口渴了……想起来，我听说魔法密林的仙女们有一些非常凉爽可口的牛奶。

column1: So, you know what to do, right? Why don't you go see Rowen the Fairy in Ellinia and ask about Fresh Milk ?
column2: 所以，你知道该怎么做，对吗？你为什么不去魔法密林见罗文仙子，询问一下鲜牛奶的事呢？

column1: Hmmm... I'm sure you're aware of the fact that we fairies aren't exactly friends with humans... but if you're bothering us, there must be a valid reason for it... so how can I help you?
column2: 嗯……我相信你知道我们妖精与人类并不完全是朋友……但如果你打扰我们，一定是有正当理由的……所以我能帮你什么忙呢？

column1: Rowen the Fairy of Ellinia asked for a refined piece of glittering Diamond for a Fresh Milk. A Diamond, huh... how am I supposed to get that rare, expensive item?
column2: 魔法密林的妖精罗雯要求用一颗精炼后的闪亮钻石来交换新鲜牛奶。钻石啊……我要怎么弄到这种稀有又昂贵的东西？你把钻石带给了妖精罗雯。

column1: So you're here at Ronnie's request, to bring him some Fresh Milk ? Ronnie is the one boy that we have accepted... Hmm, please hold on a second, I'll get you a glass of Fresh Milk.
column2: 所以你是应罗尼的要求来给他送些鲜牛奶的？罗尼是我们接受的唯一一个男孩……嗯，请稍等，我去给你一杯鲜牛奶。

column1: But then again, I can't give you this just like that. You're also aware that we fairies love fancy, spectacular items, right? If you get me a refined Diamond , the Fresh Milk is yours.
column2: 但话又说回来，我不能就这样给你这个。你也知道我们仙女喜欢奇特、壮观的物品，对吧？如果你给我一颗精致的钻石，鲜牛奶就是你的了。

column1: Wow...! This is one very well-refined Diamond ! If you give it to me, I'll give you a glass of the Fresh Milk Ronnie likes. Will you give the Diamond to me?
column2: 哇...！这是一颗经过精炼的钻石！如果你给我，我就给你一杯罗尼喜欢的鲜牛奶。你愿意把钻石给我吗？

column1: Haven't gotten the refined Diamond yet? Come to me once you have gotten it. I'll give you a glass of our fairies' pride and joy, Fresh Milk.
column2: 还没拿到精炼钻石吗？拿到后就来找我吧。我给你一杯我们仙女的骄傲和喜悦，鲜牛奶。

column1: I brought a Diamond to Rowen the Fairy and received Fresh Milk in return. I just hope Ronnie will be satisfied with this.
column2: 你把钻石带给妖精罗雯，并换来了新鲜牛奶。希望罗尼这次会满意……你把新鲜牛奶带给了罗尼。呼，看来他终于吃饱喝足，不会再吃了！

column1: Thank you very much. Please give Ronnie this Fresh Milk . I'll take good care of the Diamond that you got me.
column2: 非常感谢。请给罗尼这杯鲜牛奶。我会好好保管你给我的钻石。

column1: Wow, my favorite, Fresh Milk ! The fairies always share such delicious snackies--I don't understand why people say they're cold-hearted.
column2: 哇，我的最爱，鲜牛奶！仙女们总是分享这么美味的零食——我不明白为什么人们说她们冷酷无情。

column1: Did you lose the glass of Fresh Milk I gave you? Hm... It's hard to take a human's word for it, but I suppose there's no choice. I'll give you one more... Just make sure to deliver it properly to Ronnie this time.
column2: 我给你的那杯鲜牛奶你丢了吗？嗯……很难相信人类的话，但我想别无选择。我再给你一份……这次一定要好好地交给罗尼。

column1: I got Ronnie some yummy food in exchange for the Secret Book. I want to peek inside.
column2: 你用美味的食物从罗尼那里换来了秘密之书。真想偷偷看一眼……你把沃特巴顿先生苦苦寻找的珍贵秘密之书交给了他。你问他是否担心罗尼，却听他说罗尼和妖精们在一起会被照顾得很好……嗯，罗尼和妖精们在一起也许最好吧。总之，你用这本书换来了桑拿服……穿着笨重的铠甲泡桑拿确实很荒唐。既然来了，不如趁现在在桑拿房里好好放松一下……

column1: Thank you so much for helping me with all my requests so far. Oh yeah, a promise is a promise... here's my dad's book. I have no idea what this book is about, but... why is he so gaga over this anyway??
column2: 非常感谢您到目前为止帮助我满足我的所有请求。哦，是的，承诺就是承诺……这是我爸爸的书。我不知道这本书是关于什么的，但是……为什么他对这个如此着迷？

column1: Ohhh... this is the book! The book I was looking for... phew, thank you so much. I knew you'd bring it to me... Here, a piece of clothing like I promised... and this isn't much, but... here you go.
column2: 哦……这就是书！我正在寻找的书...唷，非常感谢。我就知道你会把它带给我……给，一件我答应过的衣服……这并不多，但是……给你。

column1: You haven't found my son yet, huh. He took a very important book out with him. I'll definitely reward you handsomely for your work. He may be in a passage made of trees near the forest at Ellinia.
column2: 你还没找到我儿子吧。他随身带着一本非常重要的书。我一定会给你丰厚的报酬。他可能在魔法密林森林附近的一条树木通道中。

column1: Hehehe... I took off with my dad's precious book... but... this book... what's it for??? Why does my dad take such good care of it?? I have nooo idea.
column2: 呵呵呵...我带着爸爸的宝贝书走了...但是...这本书...是用来做什么的？？？为什么我爸爸这么照顾它？我没有任何想法...

column1: In front of the Sleepywood Hotel, I met Sabitrama, a medicinal herb trader who seems to be the younger brother of Chrishrama. He said he found a place where he can finally find the herb that he needed for this medicine he's working on... and he asked if I could go in that forest and grab an herb called Pink Anthurium. It consists of green grass and a small pink flower... I should remember this well and get him the exact same one. I heard the place is near Ellinia... I should go there and talk to this guy Shane.
column2: 去林中之城找萨比特拉玛吧。在林中之城旅馆前，我遇到了药草商人萨比特拉玛，他似乎是克里斯拉玛的弟弟。他说自己终于找到了能取得制作药物所需药草的地方……并问我能不能进那片森林，帮他采来一种叫粉色火鹤花的药草。它由绿色草叶和一朵小粉花组成……我应该牢牢记住样子，采到一模一样的。听说那个地方在魔法密林附近……我应该去那里找谢恩。幸好你从忍耐之林拿到了萨比特拉玛想要的花。作为谢礼，他给了你一张套服卷轴。哦，他还说从今以后你进入忍耐之林不用再付钱给魔法密林的谢恩。听说萨比特拉玛正在制作的减肥药是给谢恩未婚妻的……有空我应该再去忍耐之林看看……

column1: Wait, hold on one second. I am an herb collector, traveling around the world looking for herbs. I'm looking for useful medicinal herbs around this area. It's been hard finding those these days... So, hey, have you found a place where the herbs run aplenty?
column2: 等一下，等一下。我是一名草药收藏家，周游世界寻找草药。我正在这附近寻找有用的药材。这些天很难找到那些……那么，嘿，你找到一个盛产草药的地方了吗？

column1: Actually, I did find a place where you can find good medicinal herbs. It's in a forest not too far from here... Lots of obstacles around the area, but I can tell that, in the end, there will be goods available for us to use... So what do you think? Would you go there in my place?
column2: 事实上，我确实找到了一个可以找到好药草的地方。距离这里不远的森林里……周围有很多障碍物，但我可以告诉你，最终会有物品可供我们使用……那你觉得呢？你愿意代替我去那里吗？

column1: Thank you. The place where you can find the mysterious herb is actually somewhere you've been before, Ellinia . I heard you have to pay an entrance fee... You have the Mesos to go in, right? Sorry, but I've spent all my money traveling, so I'm afraid I can't help you with that.
column2: 谢谢你。能找到神秘药草的地方其实就是你以前去过的地方，艾莉妮娅。听说要交入场费……你有金币进去吧？抱歉，我已经花光了所有的钱去旅行，所以我恐怕无法帮助你......

column1: Yes! Let me explain more about the herb you'll be getting for me. There are similar herbs around, so make sure you remember this. The herb you'll need to get is a Pink Anthurium , and the flower looks like this: Pink Anthurium . Look carefully and please get the exact one I described for you.
column2: 是的！让我详细解释一下你要给我买的草药。周围有类似的草药，所以一定要记住这一点。您需要获得的药草是粉红红掌，花看起来像这样：粉红红掌。仔细看一下，请找到我为您描述的那个。

column1: Really. You look like you'd just breeze through there... Please come back here when you have time. I'll be waiting for you.
column2: 真的。你看起来就像是轻而易举地从那里走过……有时间的话请回来这里。我会等你。

column1: Ohhh... This is IT! With this Pink Anthurium , I can finally make the diet medicine!! Hahaha, if you ever feel like you have gained weight, feel free to find me; by then, I may have a special medicine for just that!
column2: 哦……这就是它！有了这个粉红掌，我终于可以做减肥药了！！哈哈哈，如果你觉得自己胖了，就来找我吧；到时候我可能就有特效药了！

column1: Oh, I almost forgot. Since you helped me out, I should thank you for your hard work. Here, take this scroll. My brother made this for me a while back, and it adds to the defensive abilities of overall armor. Hopefully you'll use it well. And from here on out, Shane will let you in for free. Thanks for your help.
column2: 哦，我差点忘了。既然你帮了我，我就应该感谢你的辛劳。来，拿着这个卷轴。我哥哥不久前为我做了这个，它增加了整体装甲的防御能力。希望你能好好利用它。从现在开始，谢恩将免费让你进去。谢谢你的帮助...

column1: You haven't gotten the herb yet. The herb you need to get is Pink Anthurium . The roots look like this: Pink Anthurium . Remember it and get it from Shane in Ellinia.
column2: 你还没有拿到草药。你需要获得的药草是粉红掌。根看起来像这样：粉红色的红掌。记住它并从魔法密林的谢恩那里得到它。
随机奖励 - 以下之一：

column1: I ran into Sabitrama again in front of the Sleepywood Hotel, the same one I helped get herbs before. This time, he said he found a place where I can get an important herb that he needed for his new medicine. He asked me if I could go into that forest and grab Double-Rooted Red Ginseng for him. It was a reddish root split in two... I should remember it well and find the same one once I get to the top. The herb is in the forest owned by Shane of Ellinia, whom I visited last time.
column2: 听说林中之城的萨比特拉玛正在制作新药……我再次在林中之城旅馆前遇到了萨比特拉玛，也就是之前我帮忙采药的那个人。这次他说自己找到了一个地方，可以取得新药所需的重要药草。他问我能不能进入那片森林，帮他采来双根红参。那是一根分成两叉的红色根茎……我应该好好记住样子，到达顶部后找到同样的药草。药草在上次去过的魔法密林谢恩拥有的森林里……幸好你拿到了萨比特拉玛要的药草，并因此得到了一块神秘的石头作为奖励。从今以后，你每次进入忍耐之林都不用再付谢恩费用。听说萨比特拉玛正在制作的不老药也许正是谢恩需要的东西……有空的话，应该再进去看看……

column1: Ohhh, you're the traveler that helped me out the other day! I made the diet medicine with the herbs you got me and made some money... This time, I'd like to make a different kind of a medicine. What do you think? Do you want to help me out one more time?
column2: 哦哦，你就是前几天帮助我的旅行者！我用你给我的草药制作了减肥药，赚了一些钱……这一次，我想制作一种不同的药物。你怎么认为？你想再帮我一次吗？

column1: Thank you. The place where you can find the mysterious herb is actually somewhere you've been before, Ellinia . I heard someone's accepting an entrance fee at the entrance... You have the mesos to go in, right? This time you'll be going in much deeper than before, so be prepared.
column2: 谢谢你。能找到神秘药草的地方其实就是你以前去过的地方，艾莉妮娅。听说入口处有人收门票……你有金币进去吧？这次你会比以前更深入，所以要做好准备......

column1: Yes! Let me explain more about the herb you'll be getting for me. There are similar ones around, so make sure you memorize this. The herb you'll need to get is a Double-Rooted Red Ginseng , and the root looks like this: Double-Rooted Red Ginseng . Search carefully and please get the exact one I described for you.
column2: 是的！让我详细解释一下你要给我买的草药。周围有类似的，所以一定要记住这一点。您需要获得的草药是双根红参，根看起来像这样：双根红参。仔细搜索，请找到我为您描述的那个。

column1: Really. You look like you'd just breeze through there... Please come back here when you have time. I'll be waiting for you.
column2: 真的。你看起来就像是轻而易举地从那里走过……有时间的话请回来这里。我会等你。

column1: Ohhh... This is IT! With Double-Rooted Red Ginseng , I can finally make the anti-aging medicine!!! Hahaha, if you ever become old and weak, find me. By then, I may have a special medicine for just that!
column2: 哦……这就是它！有了双根红参，我终于可以做抗衰老的药了！！！哈哈哈，如果你老了，身体衰弱了，就来找我吧。到时候我可能就有特效药了！

column1: Oh, I almost forgot. Since you helped me out, I should thank you for your hard work... This Star Rock is something I found at the very bottom of a valley a long time ago, in the middle of a journey. It'll probably help you down the road. I also increased your Fame, and, from here on out, Shane will let you in for free. Well, so long.
column2: 哦，我差点忘了。既然你帮了我，我就应该感谢你的辛苦……这块星石是我很久以前，在一次旅途中，在山谷的最底下发现的。它可能会对您有所帮助。我还增加了你的名气，从现在开始，谢恩将免费让你进入。嗯，这么久了...

column1: You haven't gotten the herb yet. The herb you need to get is a Double-Rooted Red Ginseng . The roots should look like this: Double-Rooted Red Ginseng . Memorize this, and go to Shane in Ellinia to get there.
column2: 你还没有拿到草药。您需要获得的草药是双根红参。根应该是这样的：双根红参。记住这一点，然后去魔法密林的谢恩那里就可以到达那里。

column1: The cave fairy Zelya in the Forgotten Hollow explained that she once lived much deeper inside the cave. She longs to return to her old home, but while out on a walk she was attacked by Glowshrooms and dropped the map she had drawn to find her way back. The monsters may have already torn it to pieces, but if I defeat the Glowshrooms east of Forgotten Hollow and gather the fragments, she might be able to figure something out.
column2: 遗忘山谷的洞穴妖精泽莉娅似乎有请求。但要找到遗忘山谷的位置本身可能就是个挑战……遗忘山谷的洞穴妖精泽莉娅解释说，她曾经住在洞穴更深处。她很想回到从前的家，但有次外出散步时遭到发光蘑菇袭击，弄丢了自己画好的回家地图。地图也许已经被怪物撕碎了，但如果我打倒遗忘山谷东边的发光蘑菇并收集碎片，她也许还能想出办法。按照洞穴妖精泽莉娅的请求，你打倒怪物并把通往她原本家园的地图碎片带了回来。希望里面还能找到一些线索……

column1: Oh my... It's been such a long time since I last saw a human in the Forgotten Hollow . How did you manage to find this place? An ordinary human could never stumble across it--you must have remarkable courage.
column2: 天啊……自从我上次在遗忘山谷见到人类以来已经过去了很长时间了。你是怎么找到这个地方的？一个普通人绝对不可能偶然发现它——你必须有非凡的勇气。

column1: Yes... Somehow, I feel I can trust you. We cave fairies once lived much deeper within the Forgotten Hollow , but after that sorrowful incident long ago, we had no choice but to leave our home.
column2: 是的……不知怎的，我觉得我可以信任你。我们洞穴仙子曾经生活在遗忘山谷的深处，但在很久以前那场悲伤的事件之后，我们别无选择，只能离开我们的家。

column1: Still, I believe I can return one day. That's why I drew a map when I left, so I would never forget the way home. But a few days ago, while walking around to refresh my memory, I was attacked by Glowshrooms and dropped my precious map.
column2: 不过，我相信有一天我可以回来。所以我离开的时候画了一张地图，这样我就永远不会忘记回家的路。但几天前，当我四处走动恢复记忆时，我遭到了萤火虫的攻击，并掉落了我珍贵的地图。

column1: I can't share everything with someone I've just met... but please, I beg you. Could you recover my map? The monsters may have already torn it apart, but even the fragments might hold clues.
column2: 我无法与刚认识的人分享一切……但是求你了，我求你了。你能恢复我的地图吗？怪物可能已经把它撕碎了，但即使是碎片也可能蕴藏着线索。

column1: Thank you so much! The monsters that attacked me were Glowshrooms . They dwell in the eastern parts of the Forgotten Hollow . Please defeat them and bring back the map fragments.
column2: 非常感谢！攻击我的怪物是萤火虫。他们居住在遗忘山谷的东部。请打败他们并带回地图碎片。

column1: So, Luma was right after all... humans really are selfish.
column2: 所以说，卢玛说的没错……人类真的很自私……

column1: I knew I could count on you to help. Now I can show Luma that not all humans are selfish--that some really are righteous. Thank you, from the bottom of my heart!
column2: 我知道我可以依靠你的帮助。现在我可以向卢玛表明，并非所有人类都是自私的——有些人确实是正义的。谢谢您，从心底里感谢您！

column1: Now I have to piece these fragments together, one by one. It'll take some time, but if it leads me back home, I will endure anything.
column2: 现在我必须把这些碎片一点一点地拼凑起来。这需要一些时间，但如果它能让我回家，我会忍受一切。

column1: Please defeat Glowshrooms dwelling east of the village and bring back the map fragments. I'm counting on you.
column2: 请击败住在村庄东边的萤火虫并带回地图碎片。我指望你了。

column1: The cave fairy Zelya in the Forgotten Hollow was struggling to piece together the fragments of her map. To restore it, she asked me to bring her Raffle Petals, which can be obtained by defeating Raffles east of the village. Looks like that’s where I'll need to go.
column2: 遗忘山谷的洞穴妖精泽莉娅似乎有新的请求。洞穴妖精泽莉娅正在努力拼回地图碎片。为了修复地图，她让我带来莱佛花瓣，这些可以从村子东边的莱佛身上获得。看来我得去那里了。按照泽莉娅的请求，你打倒了莱佛，并收集了足够的莱佛花瓣带回给她。

column1: Ah, it's you. Thank you again for collecting the fragments of my precious map last time. But what should I do now...? I'm having such a hard time trying to piece the map back together. Is there no good way to fix this...?
column2: 啊，是你。再次感谢您上次收集我珍贵地图的碎片。但我现在该怎么办……？我很难把地图拼凑起来。难道就没有什么好的办法解决这个问题吗？...

column1: Oh! Now that I think about it, the petals of young Raffles that dwell east of the village could serve as an excellent adhesive. They lure prey with their flowers, then trap them with the sticky substance coating their petals.
column2: 哦！现在我想起来，住在村东的年轻莱佛士的花瓣可以作为很好的粘合剂。它们用花朵引诱猎物，然后用花瓣上的粘性物质捕获猎物。

column1: I think someone as strong as you could easily defeat them. Would you be willing to help me once more?
column2: 我认为像你这样强大的人可以轻松击败他们。你愿意再帮我一次吗？

column1: Thank you! Raffles are often seen to the east of the village. Look for the ones whose red flowers have not fully bloomed--they should be easy to spot. Please defeat them and bring me 25 Raffle Petals.
column2: 谢谢！莱佛士经常出现在村庄的东边。寻找那些红色花朵尚未完全绽放的植物——它们应该很容易被发现。请打败他们并给我带来 25 个抽奖花瓣。

column1: I see... I suppose you have your own reasons as well.
column2: 我明白了……我想你也有你自己的理由。

column1: You're back already, and with the Raffle Petals I asked for!
column2: 你已经回来了，还带着我要的莱佛花瓣！

column1: Thank you! Now I can finally restore my precious map.
column2: 谢谢！现在我终于可以恢复我珍贵的地图了。

column1: Please defeat the Raffles dwelling east of the village and bring back Raffle Petals . I'm counting on you.
column2: 请击败村庄东边的莱佛士住宅并带回莱佛士花瓣。我指望你了。

column1: Don't forget to take down the Raffles as well!
column2: 别忘了把莱佛士也拿下来！

column1: Zelya restored her precious map and tried to follow it back to her old home, but she could not make it past the fierce monsters blocking the way. She asked me to defeat the monsters west of the Forgotten Hollow to help her get home safely.
column2: 遗忘山谷的洞穴妖精泽莉娅似乎又有请求。泽莉娅修复了珍贵的地图，并试着按照地图回到从前的家，但路上被凶猛的怪物挡住，无法通过。她拜托我打倒遗忘山谷西边的怪物，帮她安全回家。按照泽莉娅的请求，你打倒了水蜥和回声章鱼。可感觉怪物仍不断从洞穴深处涌出。里面到底发生了什么？

column1: Ah, welcome back! I imagine you're wondering whether I was able to restore my map? Thanks to you, I did, but... there's a bigger problem now.
column2: 啊，欢迎回来！我想您想知道我是否能够恢复我的地图？多亏了你，我做到了，但是……现在有一个更大的问题。

column1: When I tried to follow the map back to my old home, the monsters became more savage the further I went. I had to retreat pretty quickly. Maybe it was too much for a small fairy like me from the start.
column2: 当我试图按照地图回到我的老家时，越往前走，怪物就越凶残。我不得不迅速撤退。也许对于我这样的小仙女来说，从一开始就太过分了……

column1: Still, I don't want to give up yet. If you could defeat the monsters west of the Forgotten Hollow and thin their numbers, perhaps the path home would become safe enough. Could you help me once more?
column2: 尽管如此，我还不想放弃。如果你能打败遗忘山谷西边的怪物并减少它们的数量，也许回家的路就会变得足够安全。你能再帮我一次吗？

column1: Thank you so much! The Aqumanders and Echopuses west of Forgotten Hollow seemed especially dangerous. If you can defeat them, I promise I will find a way to repay you.
column2: 非常感谢！遗忘山谷以西的艾奎曼德人和埃科普斯人似乎特别危险。如果你能打败他们，我保证我会想办法报答你。

column1: The Aqumanders and Echopuses looked incredibly dangerous. I suppose even you might think it's too risky.
column2: 阿奎曼德人和埃科普斯看起来非常危险。我想连你也可能认为这太冒险了......

column1: I was worried the whole time whether you would return safely. But it seems you've managed to defeat them all.
column2: 我一直担心你能否平安回来。但看来你已经成功击败了他们所有人。

column1: I was right to trust you. I'm going to gather a few things and set out soon. I'm sure Luma and Myen will try to stop me, but if I leave quietly while they sleep, I should be able to go. Thank you, truly!
column2: 我相信你是对的。我要收拾一些东西，很快就出发。我确信卢玛和迈恩会试图阻止我，但如果我在他们睡觉时悄悄离开，我应该可以走。谢谢你，真的！

column1: Please defeat the Aqumanders and Echopuses west of the village to make the path to my old home safer. I'm counting on you.
column2: 请击败村子西边的阿奎曼德人和埃科普斯人，让通往我老家的道路更加安全。我指望你了。
随机奖励 - 以下之一：

column1: Myra in Perilous Descent I wants her changed companions to rest in peace. At her request, I must put down the nearby Myewood, as well as the Sporewood deeper in the cave.
column2: 危险下降地 I 的米拉似乎沉浸在悲伤之中。米拉希望那些已经改变的同伴能够安息。按照她的请求，我必须解决附近的树喵木，以及洞穴更深处的孢木。听从米拉的恳求，我别无选择，只能砍倒那些曾经是她同伴的生物。它们到底为什么会变成这样……

column1: Human... You should not come here... This place is dangerous... What did you come for...?
column2: 人类……你不应该来这里……这里很危险……你来这里是为了……？

column1: Still... I have a request for you, human... They were my friends and my allies... but they have changed.
column2: 不过……我对你有一个请求，人类……他们是我的朋友和盟友……但他们已经改变了……

column1: It pains me... I cannot leave them as they are... since they were so precious to me... Will you grant this request?
column2: 这让我很痛苦...我不能让他们保持原样...因为他们对我来说是如此珍贵...你会同意这个请求吗？

column1: Myewoods ... and Sporewoods , deeper in the cave... Please grant them a peaceful rest... I beg you.
column2: Myewoods ...和Sporewoods，在洞穴深处...请让他们安静地休息...我求你...

column1: I can feel my companions' souls... They have returned to the World Tree.
column2: 我能感觉到同伴们的灵魂……他们已经回到了世界树……

column1: You have helped us... We will not forget you.
column2: 你帮助了我们...我们不会忘记你...

column1: Myewoods ... and Sporewoods , deeper in the cave... Please grant them a peaceful rest... I beg you.
column2: Myewoods ...和Sporewoods，在洞穴深处...请让他们安静地休息...我求你...

column1: Myra in Perilous Descent I asked me to deliver news of this place to another of her old friends, Grendel the Really Old. I should be able to find Grendel the Really Old atop Ellinia, at the Magic Library.
column2: 危险下降地 I 的米拉似乎还有另一个请求。米拉让我把这个地方的消息带给她的另一位老朋友——汉斯。应该可以在魔法密林顶部的魔法图书馆找到汉斯。当我在魔法密林见到汉斯时，他听说遗忘洞穴重新被发现后非常震惊，也对那里发生的事深感不安。

column1: Human... I must ask this of you... The World Tree is in danger... It must be tied to why my friends have changed.
column2: 人类……我必须问你这个问题……世界树处于危险之中……这一定与我的朋友们改变的原因有关……

column1: Long ago... there was a dear friend who lived here with me... His name is Grendel the Really Old ... He left this place with many of the other fairies.
column2: 很久以前……有一位亲爱的朋友和我一起住在这里……他的名字叫格伦德尔·真老……他和许多其他仙女一起离开了这个地方……

column1: There is something I must entrust to him... Will you grant me this request?
column2: 我有件事必须托付给他……你能答应我这个请求吗？

column1: Please take this Ominous Rotten Branch to him... Long ago, the fairies who left here settled in Ellinia ... Go there, and find him.
column2: 请把这根不祥的腐树枝交给他……很久以前，离开这里的仙女们定居在艾莉尼亚……去那里，找到他……

column1: Hm? What is it? You're interrupting my studies. ...Wait. Did you just say Myra ?! Don't speak nonsense, how could you possibly know that name? And what is that... that Ominous Rotten Branch you carry? Good heavens, the vile energy radiating from it is giving me a headache. Explain yourself, right now!
column2: 嗯？它是什么？你打扰我学习了...等待。你刚才是说迈拉吗？！别废话了，你怎么可能知道这个名字？你携带的那根不祥的腐烂树枝是什么？天哪，它散发出的邪恶能量让我头疼。解释一下你自己，现在！

column1: I see... So you wandered into the Forgotten Hollow and actually spoke with Myra . To think she is still down there after all this time... Hmph. I had assumed the worst.
column2: 我明白了...所以你漫步进入了遗忘山谷并实际上与迈拉交谈了。想不到这么久了她还在那儿……哼。我已经做了最坏的打算。

column1: But this rot you describe... It is exactly what the Sages feared. That foul energy creeping through the roots of the World Tree. It's the whole reason that stubborn swordsman, Manji, refuses to leave the wasteland. He's been watching for it.
column2: 但你所描述的这种腐烂……这正是圣贤们所担心的。那股邪恶的能量从世界树的根部蔓延开来。这就是顽固的剑客万吉拒绝离开荒原的全部原因。他一直在观察它。

column1: When the corruption first began, the air itself turned toxic. Many of us had no choice but to flee the Forgotten Hollow and settle up here in Ellinia.
column2: 当腐败刚开始时，空气本身就变得有毒。我们中的许多人别无选择，只能逃离遗忘山谷并在魔法密林定居。

column1: If the cursed energy within this Ominous Rotten Branch is any indication, the rot is accelerating. This is a very serious matter.
column2: 如果这根不祥腐烂树枝中的诅咒能量有任何迹象的话，那就是腐烂正在加速。这是一个非常严重的问题...

column1: Ahem. Never mind an old man's rambling. I need time to examine this object properly. Go on, shoo! Come back later when I've gathered my thoughts.
column2: 咳咳。别介意一个老人的胡言乱语。我需要时间好好检查一下这个物体。继续，嘘！等我整理好思绪后再回来。

column1: What brings you here? You say you have something to show me? And yet... where is this thing you claim to carry?
column2: 是什么风把你吹到这里来的？你说你有东西要给我看？然而……你声称携带的这个东西在哪里？

column1: You still haven't met Grendel the Really Old ...? He is my old friend... Take the Ominous Rotten Branch to him.
column2: 你还没见过老格伦德尔……？他是我的老朋友……把不祥腐树枝交给他。

column1: Have you lost the Ominous Rotten Branch ...? This time, keep it safe.
column2: 你失去了不祥的腐烂树枝吗……？这次，一定要注意安全……

column1: Riel introduced me to a part time job, where I have to collect 10 Coconuts. Why don't I start collecting those delicious looking Coconuts over there on the right?
column2: 黄金海滩有位名叫丽尔的美丽女孩似乎需要帮助……丽尔给我介绍了一份兼职，需要收集 10 个椰子。不如先去右边收集那些看起来很好吃的椰子吧。你按照丽尔的要求带回了新鲜椰子。丽尔说我随时都可以回来工作。看来在黄金海滩不会饿肚子了。

column1: Welcome to the Florina Beach , where the beautiful sunshine and the mind numbingly spectacular ocean awaits you, and-- What? What?? Ah, you're looking for a job? That's awesome! I've been looking for some help, anyway! Florina Beach is renowned for its delicious coconut juice, along with tropical fruits and seafood. Your job will be to collect those for me. What do you think?
column2: 欢迎来到弗洛里纳海滩，美丽的阳光和令人心旷神怡的壮观海洋等待着您，然后——什么？什么？？啊，你在找工作吗？太棒了！无论如何，我一直在寻求帮助！弗洛里纳海滩以其美味的椰子汁、热带水果和海鲜而闻名。你的工作就是帮我收集这些。你怎么认为？

column1: All right!! I have to see how good you are first. Don't worry, I'll pay you accordingly. It'll be a good experience for you. Head over to the beach on the right side, and you'll see a number of coconut trees. Please gather up 10 fresh Coconuts . I need fresh ones, nothing else, all right?
column2: 好吧！我得先看看你有多优秀。不用担心，我会付给你相应的费用。这对你来说将是一次很好的经历。前往右侧的海滩，您会看到许多椰子树。请收集 10 个新鲜椰子。我需要新鲜的，不需要别的，好吗？

column1: You don't need to start right away, huh? We at the Florina Beach can always use a hand or two, since there are so many tourists that come and go everyday. It's not that difficult of a job, so if you're looking for something that isn't terribly taxing, feel free to come back and talk to me, okay?
column2: 你不需要立即开始，对吧？我们在弗洛里纳海滩总是需要一两只手，因为每天都有很多游客来来往往。这并不是一份困难的工作，所以如果你正在寻找一些不太费力的工作，请随时回来和我谈谈，好吗？

column1: Did you collect 10 Coconuts ? If you get me the fresh ones, you'll be working for me, no problem. Well, can I see what you have there?
column2: 你收集了 10 个椰子吗？如果你给我买了新​​鲜的，你就可以为我工作，没问题。好吧，我可以看看你那里有什么吗？

column1: Wow, these really are fresh! That's just awesome! I can't believe I ran into a worker as good as you. This was just a test, so I'll give you around 1,000 Mesos. Don't worry, the future jobs will earn you much more money. If you want to work while enjoying life at the beach, then please come see me. YOU will always be welcome here.
column2: 哇，这些真的很新鲜！太棒了！我不敢相信我竟然遇到了一个像你一样优秀的工人。这只是一个测试，所以我会给你大约 1,000 金币。别担心，未来的工作会给你赚更多的钱。如果您想一边工作一边享受海滩生活，那么请来找我。这里永远欢迎您。

column1: I don't think you have enough Coconuts . Can't find the fresh ones? Head over to the right side of the beach. The trees there have some of the freshest Coconuts you can find.
column2: 我认为你的椰子还不够。找不到新鲜的？前往海滩的右侧。那里的树上有一些你能找到的最新鲜的椰子。

column1: I have to prepare enough ingredients for 15 people, and bring them to Riel in Florina Beach.
column2: 黄金海滩的丽尔问了我一个关于黄金海滩的问题。小菜一碟～开始工作前我就能回答。我需要准备 15 人份的食材，并交给黄金海滩的丽尔。你回答了丽尔提出的所有问题并通过测试，然后去收集了 15 人份的食材。

column1: I'm glad you know the basic stuff around here. I'm just worried you might start wandering around and hunting stuff without even knowing what you'll be facing. Well then, shall we get started?
column2: 我很高兴你了解这里的基本知识。我只是担心你可能会开始四处游荡并寻找东西，甚至不知道你将面临什么。那么，我们开始吧？

column1: Did you collect them all? If the ingredients aren't fresh, I may not pay you for your service. Of course, you also need to have enough ingredients. Now, let's see.
column2: 你把它们都收集起来了吗？如果食材不新鲜，我可能不会付钱给你。当然，你还需要有足够的原料。现在，让我们看看...

column1: Wow, you got them all!!! The sweet smelling Coconuts ... the tasty looking Lorang Claws ... and the fresh batch of Lupin's Bananas ... Good job!! We've been booking more tourists lately, and I could sure use someone like you again. If you're looking for more work, then come talk to me. I feel like I can trust you to take on some of the harder tasks. I'll even raise your pay!!!
column2: 哇，你全都得到了！闻起来香甜的椰子……看起来很美味的洛朗爪……还有新鲜的羽扇豆香蕉……干得好！！我们最近预订了更多的游客，我肯定可以再次使用像您这样的人。如果你正在寻找更多的工作，那就来找我吧。我觉得我可以相信你能够承担一些更艰巨的任务。我什至会提高你的工资！

column1: I think you're lacking some ingredients. Please check and see if you have 15 Coconuts , 30 Lorang Claws , and 15 Lupin's Bananas.
column2: 我认为你缺少一些成分。请检查您是否有 15 个椰子、30 个洛朗爪和 15 个羽扇豆香蕉。

column1: I have to bring ingredients for 30 people to Riel in Florina Beach.
column2: 看来黄金海滩的丽尔还有别的请求。我需要把 30 人份的食材带给黄金海滩的丽尔。我通过兼职，为来到黄金海滩的游客收集了制作料理的食材。

column1: Remember what I told you last time? I'll need a lot more ingredients since more tourists are booking here now. It may take you some time, although the amount of time will depend on your ability to get the job done. What do you think? Do you want to take a crack at it? You'll be paid quite well for this.
column2: 还记得我上次跟你说过的话吗？我需要更多的食材，因为现在有更多的游客在这里预订。这可能需要您一些时间，尽管时间长短取决于您完成工作的能力。你怎么认为？你想尝试一下吗？你会为此得到很好的报酬。

column1: All right, the visitors that are coming this time are quite something. They only want the specials, and Lorang Claws alone will not do. Because of that, I'll need 30 Coconuts for the coconut juice, 60 Lorang Claws and 60 Clang Claws for the main course, and 30 Lupin's Bananas for the dessert.
column2: 好吧，这次来的客人可是相当了不起。他们只想要特价商品，仅靠洛朗之爪是不行的。因此，我需要 30 个椰子作为椰子汁，60 个 红螃蟹 Claws 和 60 个 青螃蟹 Claws 作为主菜，30 个羽扇豆香蕉作为甜点。

column1: Is it because I'm asking you for too much? Just remember, you'll be paid accordingly... if you feel like doing it, please come talk to me.
column2: 是因为我对你的要求太多了吗？请记住，您将获得相应的报酬...如果您愿意这样做，请来与我交谈。

column1: Did you gather up all the ingredients I asked you for? Well, let's see.
column2: 我要的材料你都收集齐了吗？好吧，让我们看看...

column1: I knew it!!! All the materials you've gathered up are fresh and ready to be served!! The customers will be more than satisfied with these. I don't think we'll ever have a huge group of visitors like this again. If I find something that needs doing, I'll definitely ask you for help. Thanks, and take care!
column2: 我就知道！！！您收集的所有材料都是新鲜的，可以上桌了！客户会对这些感到非常满意。我想我们不会再有这样一大群游客了。如果我发现有什么需要做的，我一定会向你寻求帮助。谢谢，并保重！

column1: Please check and see if you have 30 Coconuts , 60 Lorang Claws , 60 Clang Claws , and 30 Lupin's Bananas . I don't think you have all of them.
column2: 请检查您是否有 30 个椰子、60 个罗兰爪、60 个叮当爪和 30 个羽扇豆香蕉。我不认为你拥有所有这些...

column1: I need to collect some ingredients to develop the Special Taste of Florina Beach. I heard that 10 Coconuts, 10 Lorang Claws, 10 Clang Claws, and 10 Lupin's Bananas are necessary. Will Valen's new recipe succeed~?
column2: 丽尔正在黄金海滩开发一道特色料理。我需要收集一些食材，用来研发黄金海滩的特别风味。听说需要 10 个椰子、10 个洛朗爪、10 个螃蟹爪和 10 个猴子香蕉。瓦伦的新食谱会成功吗～我已经很熟悉黄金海滩的工作了。我又去找了丽尔一次，并帮了她的忙。她为什么这么拼命地想帮瓦伦呢？

column1: I have a job for you now. All you need to do is gather up a few ingredients. What do you think? Do you want to do it?
column2: 我现在有一份工作给你。您所需要做的就是收集一些原料。你怎么认为？你想做吗？

column1: Drop by every once in a while, and I'll have some work for you. What do you think? Isn't that cool? Valen's been trying to come up with new dishes lately, and it seems he needs more fresh ingredients... Bring me 10 each of Coconuts , Lupin's Bananas , Lorang Claws , and Clang Claws . What do you think?
column2: 偶尔过来一下，我会给你一些工作。你怎么认为？这不是很酷吗？瓦伦最近一直在尝试推出新菜品，看来他需要更多新鲜的食材……给我带来椰子、羽扇豆香蕉、洛朗爪和铿锵爪各10个。你怎么认为？

column1: Oh, really? Well, it's not something I need right this minute, so take your time, see if you want to do it. If you do, then come talk to me, all right? Well, I gotta get going.
column2: 哦，真的吗？好吧，这不是我现在需要的，所以慢慢来，看看你是否想做。如果你愿意的话，就来跟我谈谈，好吗？好吧，我得走了……

column1: Did you gather them all up? Let's see.
column2: 你把它们都收集起来了吗？让我们看看...

column1: As usual!! You're as accurate as ever! You really handle tasks better than anyone I've seen so far. If something comes up again someday, I think I'll be able to count on you. And as a reward, I'll let Uncle Pason at Lith Harbor know that you can come to Florina Beach for free anytime from now on. See you around.

column1: The master blacksmith of Perion, Silas Irons, has given me a test to see if I’m fit to become his apprentice. He says a blacksmith needs proper strength and knowledge, and told me to defeat monsters around Perion and bring back raw ore. It looks like raw ore can be obtained from monsters.
column2: 勇士部落的铁匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯似乎正在寻找值得收为学徒的人。勇士部落的铁匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯给了我一项测试，看看我是否适合成为他的学徒。他说铁匠需要足够的力量和知识，并让我打倒勇士部落周围的怪物，带回原矿。看来原矿可以从怪物身上获得。你通过了勇士部落铁匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯给出的测试。这是否意味着我能在冒险岛世界成为真正的铁匠？

column1: There have been more monsters around town lately, so I've been busier than ever. It sure would be nice to have an apprentice to help me out... Oh! You there! Ever thought about becoming a Blacksmith ?
column2: 最近镇上的怪物越来越多，所以我比以前更忙了。如果能有一个徒弟来帮助我就好了……哦！你在那里！有没有想过成为一名铁匠？

column1: Huh? What's a blacksmith? Hahaha! You're honest, I'll give you that. A blacksmith is someone who works with metal ore to craft various metal armor pieces . You still look like a rookie, but something tells me you might make a decent apprentice. What do you say?
column2: 啊？什么是铁匠？哈哈哈！你是诚实的，我就给你。铁匠是用金属矿石制作各种金属盔甲的人。你看上去还是个新人，但我知道你可能会成为一名不错的学徒。你怎么说？

column1: Good choice! But even I can't take just anyone as my apprentice. Let's see... Right! I'll need to give you a simple test to see if you've got potential.
column2: 不错的选择！但就算是我，也不能随便收任何人为徒。让我们看看... 对吧！我需要给你一个简单的测试，看看你是否有潜力。

column1: To become a blacksmith, you'll need not only technique, but also strength and knowledge: an understanding of materials, knowledge of how to obtain them, and the ability to gather them. Go defeat Stumps and Dark Stumps near Perion and bring me 5 Bronze Ores . Then we can talk further.
column2: 要成为一名铁匠，你不仅需要技术，还需要力量和知识：对材料的理解、如何获得它们的知识以及收集它们的能力。去击败佩里安附近的树桩和黑暗树桩，给我带来 5 个青铜矿石。然后我们可以进一步讨论。

column1: Looks like you're busy right now. That's fine. In Maple World, getting stronger isn't only about defeating monsters. Learning how to work with metal is another path to reaching new heights. Come back anytime if you change your mind.
column2: 看来你现在很忙。没关系。在冒险岛世界中，变得更强不仅仅是打败怪物。学习如何使用金属是达到新高度的另一条途径。如果您改变主意，请随时回来。

column1: It seems you defeated the monsters I mentioned and collected the ore properly! With this, I suppose I can teach you my craft.
column2: 看来你打败了我提到的怪物并妥善收集了矿石！有了这个，我想我可以教你我的手艺了。

column1: From this moment on, I recognize you as a blacksmith. I've added several blacksmithing skills to your Crafting Journal . Go take a look.
column2: 从这一刻起，我就认定你是铁匠了。我已经在你的手工艺日志中添加了一些锻造技能。去看看吧。

column1: Actually, I had you gather those ores for your own sake. You should try crafting a few items with them. Just remember: if you want to craft items, you'll need to use the Anvil next to me.
column2: 事实上，我让你收集这些矿石是为了你自己。你应该尝试用它们制作一些物品。请记住：如果你想制作物品，你需要使用我旁边的铁砧。

column1: As you craft more items, you'll gain experience and level up, allowing you to make even more kinds of equipment. But keep in mind--raising your maximum blacksmithing skill level also requires raising your character level, so don't neglect either side of your growth.
column2: 当您制作更多物品时，您将获得经验并升级，从而可以制作更多种类的设备。但请记住——提高你的最高锻造技能水平也需要提高你的角色等级，所以不要忽视你成长的任何一方面。

column1: That's all I can teach you for now. You're still a beginner, but don't worry. With steady effort, you'll be able to reach the level of a true master someday, just like me. Come find me anytime if you have questions!
column2: 目前我能教你的就是这些。您仍然是初学者，但不用担心。只要坚持不懈的努力，有一天你也能像我一样达到真正大师的境界。有问题随时来找我！

column1: It looks like you haven't collected all the materials I asked for. If you can't even do that, you're nowhere near ready to become a blacksmith.

column1: Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion, was impressed by how much I’ve grown and suggested I show off my abilities. I need to defeat Dark Axe Stumps and Zombie Mushrooms, then create an Orihalcon Ingot and a Gold Ingot, and bring them back to him.
column2: 看来勇士部落的铁匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯终于准备认可我的技术了。勇士部落的铁匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯对我的成长印象深刻，建议我展示自己的能力。我需要打倒黑斧木妖和僵尸蘑菇，然后制作一个锂矿锭和一个黄金锭，并把它们交给他。勇士部落的工匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯惊叹于我的成果，并交给我一个装备制作促进剂。它似乎是一种特殊道具，可以在制作装备时改变装备属性。也许我该试试看。

column1: Word has it that you've become a fine blacksmith. I want to see for myself if the rumors are true. Judging by your tools and your stance, it seems you've built up quite a bit of skill and experience. Care to show me what you can do?
column2: 据说你已成为一名出色的铁匠。我想亲自看看传闻是否属实。从你的工具和立场来看，你似乎已经积累了相当多的技能和经验。愿意告诉我你能做什么吗？

column1: Confident, aren't you? Good! Then go defeat Dark Axe Stumps and Zombie Mushrooms , and bring 1 Orihalcon Ingot and 1 Gold Ingot . You can find Dark Axe Stump around Perion , and Zombie Mushroom appears to be found in the Ant Tunnel in Sleepywood . Shouldn't be too difficult. I'll be waiting!
column2: 有信心，不是吗？好的！然后去击败暗斧树桩和僵尸蘑菇，并带上1个奥瑞哈康锭和1个金锭。你可以在 勇士部落 周围找到暗斧树桩，而僵尸蘑菇似乎可以在 林中之城 的蚂蚁隧道中找到。应该不会太难。我会等待！

column1: Looks like you haven't quite reached the needed level of skill, have you?
column2: 看起来你还没有达到所需的技能水平，是吗？

column1: Let's see... These are exceptionally well made. I'm genuinely impressed that you've reached this level of craftsmanship. Yes, this is the quality one would expect from a true blacksmith. Your dedication to honing your skills is admirable. I suppose this calls for a special reward.
column2: 让我们看看...这些制作非常精良。您达到这种工艺水平给我留下了深刻的印象。是的，这就是一个真正的铁匠所期望的品质。你对磨练技能的奉献精神令人钦佩。我想这需要特殊的奖励。

column1: This Armor Crafting Catalyst is a unique item that can be used during crafting to alter the abilities of equipment. Because it's so delicate, you may sometimes get disappointing results, but, if handled properly, it might produce something far beyond your expectations.
column2: 这种盔甲制作催化剂是一种独特的物品，可以在制作过程中使用来改变装备的能力。因为它是如此微妙，有时你可能会得到令人失望的结果，但是，如果处理得当，它可能会产生远远超出你预期的东西。

column1: If you want to test the limits of your blacksmithing skills, I highly recommend giving it a try. Keep striving forward!
column2: 如果你想测试一下自己的锻造技能极限，我强烈建议你尝试一下。继续努力前进！

column2: 看起来你还没有收集到我要求的所有材料。告诉我你能做什么！

column1: Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion, received an important request but is struggling because he’s short on materials. To help him, I need to defeat Bubblings and bring back Mithril Ingot.
column2: 看来勇士部落的铁匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯需要帮助。也许我该去看看他。勇士部落的铁匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯接到了一项重要委托，但因为材料不足而陷入困境。为了帮他，我需要打倒大幽灵，并带回秘银锭。你顺利交付了西拉斯·艾恩斯要求的道具。照这样下去，我也许真的能被称为优秀的学徒。

column1: Good timing! Dances with Balrog of Perion requested a special piece of armor for the town's warriors, but I'm short on the material needed to craft it. Could you help me out?

column1: Thanks! I need 1 Mithril Ingot for the armor. Please go defeat Bubblings in the Kerning City region and bring one back for me. I'll be waiting!
column2: 谢谢！我需要 1 个秘银锭来制作盔甲。请去废弃都市地区打败泡泡，给我带回来一只。我会等待！

column1: An apprentice refusing a master's request... Back in my day, that would've been unthinkable.
column2: 徒弟拒绝师傅的要求……在我那个时代，这是不可想象的……

column1: Perfect! This is exactly what I needed. You really are a reliable apprentice!
column2: 完美！这正是我所需要的。你真是个可靠的徒弟啊！

column1: Here, take this Smithing Kit as a reward. It'll make it a bit easier for you to train your blacksmithing skills.
column2: 在这里，把这个锻造工具包作为奖励。这会让你更容易训练你的铁匠技能。

column1: But this could be a problem... I have a feeling Dances with Balrog will keep sending requests like this. I might need your help again. I'll ask you next time!
column2: 但这可能是一个问题...我有一种感觉，武术教练会继续发送这样的请求。我可能再次需要你的帮助。下次我再问你！

column1: It looks like you haven't collected the material I asked for. Please hurry!
column2: 看来你还没有收集到我要的材料。请快点！

column1: It looks like you haven't defeated all the monsters I mentioned. Please hurry!
column2: 看起来你还没有打败我提到的所有怪物。请快点！

column1: Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, gave me a test when I asked to become his apprentice. He said that weaponcrafting requires proper strength and knowledge, and told me to use my Smithing skill to craft one Bronze Ingot and one Iron Ingot. As long as I have the materials, it shouldn’t be too difficult.
column2: 勇士部落的武器制作大师雷先生似乎正在寻找值得收为学徒的人。当我请求成为他的学徒时，勇士部落的武器制作大师雷先生给了我一项测试。他说武器制作需要足够的力量和知识，并让我使用锻造技能制作一个青铜锭和一个钢铁锭。只要有材料，应该不会太难。你通过了勇士部落武器制作大师雷先生给出的测试。这是否意味着我现在能成为冒险岛世界真正的武器制作专家？

column1: When Silas Irons was my apprentice, he helped me a great deal... and now he's grown enough to become a master in his own field. I'm proud of him, but I'm short on hands again... Ah! You there! Would you be interested in becoming a Weaponcrafting Specialist ?
column2: 当塞拉斯·艾恩斯（西拉斯·艾恩斯）还是我的学徒时，他给了我很大帮助……现在他已经成长到足以成为自己领域的大师。我为他感到骄傲，但我又缺人手了……啊！你在那里！您有兴趣成为一名武器制造专家吗？

column1: What? You're asking what a weaponcrafting specialist is? Hahaha! Silas Irons asked me the same thing back then. Very well! A weapon crafting specialist is someone who can forge powerful metal weapons using refined metals . You still look like a rookie, but something tells me you might make a fine apprentice. What do you say?
column2: 什么？你问什么是武器制造专家？哈哈哈！塞拉斯·艾恩斯当时也问过我同样的问题。很好！武器制造专家是能够使用精炼金属锻造强大金属武器的人。你看起来还是个新人，但我知道你可能会成为一名优秀的学徒。你怎么说？

column1: Good choice! But even I can't just take anyone as my apprentice. Let's see... Right! I'll need to give you a simple test to see if you've got potential.
column2: 不错的选择！但就算是我，也不能随便收任何人为徒。让我们看看... 对吧！我需要给你一个简单的测试，看看你是否有潜力。

column1: To become a weaponcrafting specialist, you need to learn the basics: working with metal. And it looks like you already know Smithing, right? Try using that skill to craft 1 Bronze Ingot and 1 Iron Ingot.
column2: 要成为武器制造专家，您需要学习基础知识：使用金属。看来你已经认识史密斯了，对吧？尝试使用该技能制作 1 个铜锭和 1 个铁锭。

column1: Seems you're busy at the moment? That's fine. But remember, if you want to grow stronger in Maple World, a good weapon is essential. Come back anytime if you change your mind.
column2: 看来你现在很忙？没关系。但请记住，如果你想在冒险世界中变得更强，一把好的武器是必不可少的。如果您改变主意，请随时回来。

column1: It looks like you've trained your weaponcrafting skills well! At this level, I'd say you're ready for me to teach you my craft.
column2: 看来你的武器制造技术训练得很好啊！在这个级别上，我想说你已经准备好让我教你我的手艺了。

column1: From now on, I recognize you as a weaponcrafting specialist. I've added several weaponcrafting skills to your Crafting Journal --take a look when you get the chance.
column2: 从现在开始，我承认你是一名武器制造专家。我已经在你的制作日志中添加了一些武器制作技能——有机会的话请看一下。

column1: And actually, I asked you to gather those materials for your own sake, so try using them to make a few items. Just remember: you'll need the Weaponcrafting Station next to me if you want to craft weapons.
column2: 事实上，我让你收集这些材料是为了你自己，所以尝试用它们来制作一些物品。请记住：如果你想制造武器，你需要我旁边的武器制造站。

column1: As you craft more items using your weaponcrafting skill, you'll gain experience and level up, allowing you to create an even wider variety of weapons. But keep in mind, raising your maximum weaponcrafting level also requires raising your character level, so don't neglect either side of your growth.
column2: 当您使用武器制造技能制造更多物品时，您将获得经验并升级，从而可以制造更多种类的武器。但请记住，提高你的最大武器制造水平也需要提高你的角色等级，所以不要忽视你成长的任何一方面。

column1: That's all I can teach you for now. You're still a beginner, but don't worry. With steady effort, you'll reach the level of a true master someday, just like me. Although... if that happens, will you go off on your own path like Silas Irons did? Hahaha! Anyway, come find me anytime if you have questions!
column2: 目前我能教你的就是这些。您仍然是初学者，但不用担心。只要坚持不懈的努力，总有一天你会达到真正大师的水平，就像我一样。不过……如果发生这种情况，你会像塞拉斯·艾恩斯那样走自己的路吗？哈哈哈！总之，有问题可以随时来找我！

column1: It seems you haven't gathered all the materials I asked for. If you can't even manage that, you shouldn't be dreaming of becoming a weaponcrafter.
column2: 看来我要的材料你还没有收集齐。如果你连这一点都做不到，你就不应该梦想成为一名武器工匠。

column1: Mr. Thunder, the master weaponcrafter of Perion, was amazed by my growth and suggested that I show off my skills. I need to defeat Iron Hogs and craft one Monkey Wrench to bring back to him.
column2: 看来勇士部落的武器制作大师雷先生终于准备认可我的武器制作技术了。勇士部落的武器制作大师雷先生对我的成长感到惊讶，并建议我展示自己的技术。我需要打倒铁甲猪，并制作一个猴子扳手带回给他。勇士部落的武器制作大师雷先生对我的手艺印象深刻，并交给我一个装备制作促进剂。它看起来是一种特殊道具，可以在制作装备时改变装备属性。也许我该试试看。

column1: I've heard that you've become quite the weaponcrafter, and I want to see for myself if the rumors are true. Judging by your tools and your confidence, it seems you've built up a fair bit of skill. Care to show me?
column2: 我听说你已经成为一名武器工匠，我想亲眼看看传闻是否属实。从您的工具和信心来看，您似乎已经积累了相当多的技能。介意给我看看吗？

column1: Perfect timing! I actually needed a tool for some repairs in my bathroom--lucky me, haha! Go defeat Iron Hogs and craft 1 Monkey Wrench , then bring it back. Iron Hogs can be found around Henesys , so it shouldn't be too difficult. I'll be waiting!
column2: 完美的时机！我实际上需要一个工具来修理我的浴室——我很幸运，哈哈！击败铁猪并制作 1 个活动扳手，然后将其带回来。铁猪可以在 射手村 附近找到，所以应该不会太困难。我会等待！

column1: Looks like you haven't quite reached that level of skill, have you?
column2: 看来你还没有达到那个水平，是吗？

column1: Let's see... This is remarkably well made. I'm genuinely impressed you've reached this level of craftsmanship. Yes, this is the quality expected of a true weaponcrafter. Your dedication to honing your skills is admirable. Looks like I owe you a special reward.
column2: 让我们看看...这制作得非常好。我对你达到这种工艺水平感到由衷的钦佩。是的，这就是一个真正的武器工匠所应有的品质。你对磨练技能的奉献精神令人钦佩。看来我欠你一份特别的奖励。

column1: This One-Handed Weapon Crafting Catalyst is a unique item that can be used during crafting to alter an equipment's stats. It's very unstable, so sometimes the results may be disappointing--but, if handled well, it might create something far beyond your expectations.
column2: 这种单手武器制作催化剂是一种独特的物品，可以在制作过程中使用它来改变装备的统计数据。它非常不稳定，所以有时结果可能会令人失望——但是，如果处理得当，它可能会创造出远远超出你预期的东西。

column1: If you want to test the limits of your weaponcrafting skill, I highly recommend giving it a try. Just... don't blame me if the results aren't what you hoped for, hahaha!
column2: 如果你想测试你的武器制造技能的极限，我强烈建议你尝试一下。只是……如果结果没有如你所愿，别怪我，哈哈哈！

column1: It seems you haven't gathered the material I asked for. No slacking off!
column2: 看来你还没有收集到我要的材料。丝毫不松懈！

column1: It seems you haven't defeated all the monsters I mentioned. No slacking off!
column2: 看来你还没有打败我提到的所有怪物。丝毫不松懈！

column1: Mr. Thunder, the master weaponcrafter of Perion, received an important request but is having trouble because he’s short on materials. To help him, I’ll need to defeat some Axe Stumps and craft 10 Screws.
column2: 看来勇士部落的武器制作大师雷先生需要帮助。也许我该去看看他。勇士部落的武器制作大师雷先生接到了一项重要委托，但因为材料不足而遇到麻烦。为了帮他，我需要打倒一些斧木妖，并制作 10 个螺丝。你顺利交付了雷先生要求的道具。照这样下去，我也许真的能被称为优秀的学徒。

column1: Ah, just the person I wanted to see! Dances with Balrog of Perion requested a special weapon for the warriors of the town. But there's no way I can finish the order in time by myself. Would you lend this old craftsman a hand?
column2: 啊，正是我想见的人！与佩里安的炎魔共舞为镇上的战士们请求了一把特殊的武器。但我一个人不可能及时完成订单。你能帮帮这位老工匠吗？

column1: Much obliged! What I need are Screws . Hunt down Axe Stumps around Perion , gather the materials, and craft 10 for me. Why something so simple, you ask? Hah! You're not giving them nearly enough credit!
column2: 非常感谢！我需要的是螺丝。寻找 勇士部落 周围的斧头树桩，收集材料，为我制作 10 个。你问为什么这么简单？哈！你没有给予他们足够的信任！

column1: Hmph... An apprentice turning down his master... Back in my day, we wouldn't even dream of such a thing.
column2: 哼……徒弟拒绝师父……在我那个时代，是做梦也想不到的。

column1: Wonderful! Just what I needed. You really are a reliable apprentice--strong arms and a good heart, too!
column2: 太棒了！正是我所需要的。你真是一个可靠的徒弟——手臂有力，心地善良！

column1: Here, take this Weaponcrafting Kit . Think of it as a little boost to help sharpen your weaponcrafting skills.
column2: 在这里，拿走这个武器制作工具包。将其视为有助于提高您的武器制造技能的一点提升。

column1: Though... this might be a problem. I feel like Dances with Balrog will keep sending requests like this my way. Looks like I'll be relying on you more often, eh? Don't wander too far!
column2: 虽然……这可能是个问题。我觉得《武术教练》会继续以我的方式发送这样的请求。看来以后我要更加依赖你了，嗯？别跑太远了！

column1: Didn't gather all the materials, hmm? Chop-chop! A crafter's work waits for no one!
column2: 材料还没收集齐吧？砍砍！工匠的作品不等人！

column1: Didn't take down all the monsters I mentioned, did you? Come on now, move those legs!
column2: 你没有消灭掉我提到的所有怪物吧？来吧，迈开那双腿！

column1: When I told Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, that I wanted to become his apprentice, he gave me a test. He said tailoring requires the right balance of skill and knowledge, and asked me to defeat monsters near Henesys and collect Leafs.
column2: 魔法密林的裁缝弗朗索瓦似乎正在寻找值得收为学徒的人。当我告诉魔法密林的裁缝弗朗索瓦想成为他的学徒时，他给了我一项测试。他说裁缝需要技巧和知识的平衡，并让我打倒射手村附近的怪物，收集叶子。你通过了魔法密林裁缝弗朗索瓦给出的测试。这是否意味着我现在能成为冒险岛世界真正的裁缝？

column1: You humans really have no idea how demanding fairy fashion can be. Light, elegant, and easy to move in--all at once. Hmph. Of course, I'm the only one who can pull it off... but I suppose having an apprentice to help wouldn't hurt. You there. Have you ever considered becoming a Tailor ?
column2: 你们人类真的不知道仙女时尚的要求有多高。轻盈、优雅且易于移动——这一切都在这一刻完成。哼。当然，我是唯一能做到这一点的人……但我想有一个学徒来帮忙也没什么坏处。你在那里。您是否考虑过成为一名裁缝？

column1: Hmm? You don't even know what a tailor is? Heh... typical human. All right, I'll explain. A tailor is someone who works with fibers and crafts various types of cloth armor . I'm not convinced humans are suited for this kind of work, but you... You might be an exception. What do you say?
column2: 嗯？你连裁缝是什么都不知道吗？呵呵……典型的人类。好吧，我会解释一下。裁缝是使用纤维制作各种布甲的人。我不相信人类适合这种工作，但你……你可能是个例外。你怎么说？

column1: Very well. But don't misunderstand, I won't take just anyone as an apprentice. Especially not a human. Let's see... yes. I'll give you a simple test to see if you're worth my time.
column2: 很好。不过你别误会，我不会随便收任何人为徒。尤其不是人类。让我们看看...是的。我会给你一个简单的测试，看看你是否值得我花时间。

column1: To become a tailor, you need more than just skill. You also need strength and knowledge--an understanding of materials, how to obtain them, and the ability to gather them yourself. Go defeat Dark Stumps near Ellinia and bring me 10 Leafs . Then we'll talk.
column2: 要成为裁缝，您需要的不仅仅是技能。你还需要力量和知识——了解材料、如何获取它们以及自己收集它们的能力。去击败魔法密林附近的黑暗树桩，给我带来 10 片叶子。然后我们再谈谈。

column1: Busy, are you? Hmph. Just remember, growing stronger in Maple World isn't only about swinging weapons. Mastering fabric and thread can lead you down an entirely different path. Come back if you change your mind.
column2: 很忙吧？哼。请记住，在冒险世界中变得更强不仅仅是挥舞武器。掌握布料和线可以带你走上一条完全不同的道路。如果你改变主意就回来吧。

column1: So you actually managed to defeat the monsters and gather everything. I'll admit, that's better than I expected. Perhaps teaching you won't be a complete waste. My first human apprentice... How troublesome.
column2: ……所以你实际上成功地击败了怪物并收集了一切。我承认，这比我预期的要好。也许教你不会完全是浪费。我的第一个人类学徒……真是麻烦啊。

column1: From this point on, I acknowledge you as a tailor. I've added a few tailoring skills to your Crafting Journal . Go take a look, carefully.
column2: 从现在开始，我承认你是裁缝。我在你的手工艺日志中添加了一些裁缝技能。去仔细看看吧。

column1: And those materials? I had you gather them for your own benefit. Try crafting a few items with them. Just don't forget, you'll need the Sewing Machine beside me if you want to do any tailoring.
column2: 还有那些材料？我让你收集它们是为了你自己的利益。尝试用它们制作一些物品。只是别忘了，如果你想做任何裁缝，你需要我身边的缝纫机。

column1: As you continue crafting with your tailoring skills, you'll gain experience and level up, allowing you to make more advanced items. But if you want to push your tailoring to its limits, you'll need to increase your character level as well. Don't neglect either of them.
column2: 当您继续利用裁缝技能进行制作时，您将获得经验并升级，从而可以制作更高级的物品。但如果你想将你的剪裁发挥到极致，你还需要提高你的角色等级。不要忽视他们中的任何一个。

column1: That's all I have to teach you for now. You're still inexperienced, but with enough discipline, you might one day reach my level. If you have questions... come back. I'll decide then if you're worth answering.
column2: 这就是我现在要教你的全部内容。你还缺乏经验，但只要有足够的自律，有一天你可能会达到我的水平。如果您有疑问...请回来。然后我会决定你是否值得回答。

column1: You haven't gathered all the materials either. Just as I feared... It was too much for a human after all.
column2: 你也没有收集到所有的材料。正如我担心的那样……对于人类来说，这毕竟太过分了。

column1: You haven't defeated all the monsters I mentioned. Hmph. I knew it'd be too much for a human.
column2: 你还没有打败我提到的所有怪物。哼。我知道这对人类来说太过分了。

column1: Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, was impressed by how much I’ve grown and suggested I show off my abilities. I need to defeat Wild Boars and craft a Red Starry Bandana to bring back.
column2: 看来魔法密林的裁缝弗朗索瓦终于准备认可我的裁缝技术了。魔法密林的裁缝弗朗索瓦对我的成长印象深刻，建议我展示自己的能力。我需要打倒野猪，并制作一条红色星星头巾带回去。魔法密林的裁缝弗朗索瓦赞赏了我的手艺，并交给我一个装备制作促进剂。它似乎是一种特殊道具，可以在制作装备时改变装备属性。也许我该试试看。

column1: I've heard rumors that you've become a proper tailor now... Naturally, I have to see for myself if they were true. You seem to have built up some skill and experience--care to prove it?
column2: 我听说你已经成为一名合格的裁缝了……当然，我得亲眼看看这是否属实。你似乎已经积累了一些技能和经验——愿意证明这一点吗？

column1: Confident, are you? Hmph. Very well. Go defeat Wild Boars near Perion and craft a Red Starry Bandana , then bring it back. I'll be watching.
column2: 有信心吗？哼。很好。去击败佩里安附近的野猪并制作一条红星头巾，然后把它带回来。我会看着的。

column1: So, you haven't reached that level yet, have you? Hmph... perhaps this is the limit of a human after all.
column2: 那么，你还没有达到那个水平，是吗？哼……或许这就是人类的极限吧。

column1: Let's see... this is exceptionally well made. I didn't expect a human to reach this level of craftsmanship. Yes, this is more than sufficient to be called a true tailor. Your dedication to honing your skills is... admirable. Very well, this deserves a special reward.
column2: 让我们看看...这制作得非常好。没想到一个人的手艺能达到这种程度。是的，这足以称为真正的裁缝了。你对磨练技能的奉献精神……令人钦佩。很好，这值得特别奖励。

column1: This Armor Crafting Catalyst is a special item that can alter an equipment's abilities when used during crafting. It's extremely delicate, so the results may disappoint you at times--but if handled properly, it could produce something beyond your expectations.
column2: 这种盔甲制作催化剂是一种特殊物品，在制作过程中使用时可以改变装备的能力。它非常微妙，所以结果有时可能会让你失望——但如果处理得当，它可能会产生超出你预期的东西。

column1: If you wish to test the limits of your tailoring skills, I recommend using it. Continue your training, and don't grow complacent.
column2: 如果您想测试您的剪裁技巧的极限，我建议使用它。继续你的训练，不要自满。

column1: It seems you haven't gathered all the materials I asked for. Go on, try to surpass the limits of your kind.
column2: 看来我要的材料你还没有收集齐。继续吧，尝试超越你们同类的极限。

column1: It seems you haven't defeated all the monsters I mentioned. Go on, try to surpass the limits of your kind.
column2: 看来你还没有打败我提到的所有怪物。继续吧，尝试超越你们同类的极限。

column1: Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, received an important request but is struggling due to a lack of materials. To help him out, I need to defeat Green Mushrooms and craft 10 Spool of Thread to bring back.
column2: 看来魔法密林的裁缝弗朗索瓦需要帮助。也许过一阵子我该去看看。魔法密林的裁缝弗朗索瓦接到了一项重要委托，但因缺少材料而困扰。为了帮他，我需要打倒绿蘑菇，并制作 10 个线轴带回去。你安全交付了弗朗索瓦要求的道具。到这个程度，我应该算是相当可靠的学徒了。

column1: Perfect timing. Grendel the Really Old of Ellinia has requested a special item for village maintenance. I don't think I can finish it on my own in time. ...Would you help me?
column2: 完美的时机。魔法密林的老格伦德尔要求提供一个特殊的物品来维护村庄。我想我一个人无法及时完成它。 ……你能帮我吗？

column1: Much appreciated. I need to craft Work Gloves , but I'm short on Spool of Thread . Could you craft some for me? You probably thought Work Gloves don't suit fairies very well, didn't you? Hmph. Still, fairy hands are far more delicate than you think. And while you're at it, deal with some of the Green Mushrooms around the village. They keep getting in the way whenever I go out to gather materials. I'll be waiting.
column2: 非常感谢。我需要制作工作手套，但我缺少线轴。你能为我做一些吗？您可能认为工作手套不太适合仙女，不是吗？哼。不过，仙女的手远比你想象的要娇嫩。当你这样做的时候，处理一下村庄周围的一些绿色蘑菇。每当我出去收集材料时，他们总是妨碍我。我会等待。

column1: An apprentice refusing a master's request... Is that how things work in the human world?
column2: 徒弟拒绝师父的请求……人间就是这样的吗？

column1: Good. This is exactly what I needed. As expected, you really are my first human apprentice. Heh.
column2: 很好。这正是我所需要的。果然，你果然是我的第一个人类学徒啊。呵呵...

column1: Here. Take this Tailoring Kit as your reward. It should make training your tailoring skills a bit easier.
column2: 在这里。把这个裁缝套件作为你的奖励。它应该会让你的裁缝技能训练变得更容易一些。

column1: But this is troublesome... I have a feeling Grendel the Really Old will keep making requests like this. It seems I might be relying on your help more often. I'll call on you again next time.
column2: 但这很麻烦……我预感老格伦德尔会不断提出这样的要求。看来我可能更需要依赖你的帮助了。下次我会再打电话给你。

column1: You haven't gathered all the materials either. What's taking you so long?
column2: 你也没有收集到所有的材料。你怎么花了这么长时间？

column1: You haven't defeated all the monsters I mentioned, have you? What are you hesitating for?
column2: 你还没有打败我提到的所有怪物，是吗？你还犹豫什么？

column1: When I told Vicious, the carpenter of Henesys, that I wanted to become his apprentice, he gave me a test. He said woodworking requires proper strength and knowledge, and asked me to defeat monsters near Henesys and collect Tree Branches.
column2: 射手村的木匠维西似乎正在寻找值得收为学徒的人。当我告诉射手村的木匠维西想成为他的学徒时，他给了我一项测试。他说木工需要足够的力量和知识，并让我打倒射手村附近的怪物，收集树枝。你通过了射手村木匠维西给出的测试。这是否意味着我现在能成为冒险岛世界真正的木匠？

column1: Henesys is well known as a town that trains archers, but not many people realize that it's also home to some excellent woodworkers. Handling all of Athena Pierce's requests on my own is starting to get a bit overwhelming... So, I was wondering, would you be interested in becoming a Carpenter ?
column2: 赫尼西斯（射手村）因训练弓箭手而闻名，但没有多少人意识到它也是一些优秀木工的故乡。独自处理雅典娜皮尔斯的所有要求开始变得有点难以承受……所以，我想知道，你有兴趣成为一名木匠吗？

column1: Oh? You're asking what a carpenter is? Haha, fair enough. A carpenter is someone who works with wood to craft various wooden armor pieces and consumable items . I have a feeling it might suit you quite well, what do you think?
column2: 哦？你问木匠是什么？哈哈，够公平的。木匠是用木材制作各种木制盔甲和消耗品的人。我有一种感觉，它可能很适合你，你觉得怎么样？

column1: You're quick to decide. That's great! Still, I think it would be best to make sure you're truly suited for the work.
column2: 你很快就能做出决定。那太棒了！不过，我认为最好确保您真正适合这项工作。

column1: To be a carpenter, you'll need not only skill, but also strength and knowledge--understanding materials, how to obtain them, and the ability to gather them yourself. Could you defeat Stumps near Henesys and bring back 20 Tree Branches ? Then we can talk further.
column2: 要成为一名木匠，你不仅需要技能，还需要力量和知识——了解材料、如何获得它们以及自己收集它们的能力。您能击败 射手村 附近的树桩并带回 20 根树枝吗？然后我们可以进一步讨论。

column1: You seem a bit busy right now. But becoming stronger in Maple World isn't only about defeating monsters. Learning how to work with wood can also open the door to a whole new level of growth. If you change your mind, please feel free to come back anytime.
column2: 你现在看起来有点忙。但在冒险世界中变得更强并不仅仅是打败怪物。学习如何使用木材也可以打开通往全新增长水平的大门。如果您改变主意，请随时回来。

column1: It looks like you defeated the monsters and gathered all the materials I asked for! In that case, I think I'm ready to teach you my skills.
column2: 看来你打败了怪物，并集齐了我要的材料！在这种情况下，我想我已经准备好教你我的技能了。

column1: From now on, I officially recognize you as a carpenter. I've added a few woodworking skills to your Crafting Journal , so please take a look.
column2: 从现在开始，我正式承认你是木匠。我在你的手工艺日志中添加了一些木工技能，所以请看一下。

column1: Actually, I asked you to gather those materials for your own benefit. It would be good to try crafting a few items with them. Just remember, you'll need to use the Woodworking Station right next to me when working with wood.
column2: 事实上，我让你收集这些材料是为了你自己的利益。尝试用它们制作一些物品会很好。请记住，在处理木材时，您需要使用我旁边的木工站。

column1: As you continue crafting with your woodworking skills, you'll gain experience and level up, allowing you to create a wider variety of items. However, if you want to raise your maximum woodworking level, you'll need to increase your character level as well, so please don't neglect either.
column2: 当您继续利用木工技能进行手工制作时，您将获得经验并升级，从而可以创造出更多种类的物品。不过，如果你想提高你的木工最高等级，你也需要提高你的角色等级，所以也不要忽视。

column1: That's all I can teach you for now. You still have a long way to go, but don't worry. With steady effort, you'll be able to reach the level of a true master, just like me. If you ever have questions, feel free to stop by anytime.
column2: 目前我能教你的就是这些。你还有很长的路要走，但别担心。只要坚持不懈的努力，你一定能达到真正大师的境界，就像我一样。如果您有任何疑问，请随时过来。

column1: It seems you haven't gathered all the materials I asked for. Perhaps this line of work isn't quite the right fit for you.
column2: 看来我要的材料你还没有收集齐。也许这一行的工作不太适合你......

column1: It seems you haven't defeated all the monsters I mentioned. Perhaps this line of work isn't quite the right fit for you.
column2: 看来你还没有打败我提到的所有怪物。也许这一行的工作不太适合你......

column1: Vicious, the carpenter of Henesys, was impressed by how much I’ve grown and suggested I show off my abilities. I need to defeat Dark Axe Stumps and craft The Red Relaxer to bring back.
column2: 看来射手村的木匠维西终于准备认可我的木工技术了。射手村的木匠维西对我的成长印象深刻，建议我展示自己的能力。我需要打倒黑斧木妖，并制作一把红色休闲椅带回去。射手村的木匠维西赞赏了我的手艺，并交给我一个装备制作促进剂。它似乎是一种特殊道具，可以在制作装备时改变装备属性。也许我该试试看。

column1: Rumors that you've become a proper carpenter have made their way here to Henesys . Naturally, I wanted to see for myself if they were true. You seem to have built up quite a bit of skill and experience--shall we take a look at your work?
column2: 关于你已经成为一名合格的木匠的谣言已经传到了 射手村。当然，我想亲眼看看它们是否属实。你似乎已经积累了相当多的技能和经验——我们可以看看你的作品吗？

column1: You sound confident! Very well, then. Please defeat Dark Axe Stumps near Perion and craft 1 The Red Relaxer for me. I'll be looking forward to it.
column2: 听起来你很有信心！那么很好。请击败 勇士部落 附近的黑暗斧头树桩并为我制作 1 个红色放松器。我会很期待的。

column1: It seems you haven't quite reached that level yet. I'm afraid woodworking isn't something you can take lightly.
column2: 看来你还没有达到那个水平。木工恐怕不是一件可以掉以轻心的事。

column1: Let's see... This truly is well made! I'm honestly impressed that you've built up this level of skill. I'd say this is more than enough to be called a proper carpenter. I admire the dedication you've shown in honing your craft. All right... I suppose I should give you a special gift.
column2: 让我们看看……这确实是制作精良！老实说，我对你已经达到这种水平的技能印象深刻。我想说，这足以称得上是一名合格的木匠了。我钦佩你在磨练技艺时所表现出的奉献精神。好吧...我想我应该送你一份特别的礼物。

column1: This Two-Handed Weapon Crafting Catalyst is a special item that can be used during crafting to alter an equipment's abilities. It's quite delicate, so the results may sometimes be disappointing--but if handled carefully, it could produce something beyond your expectations.
column2: 这种双手武器制作催化剂是一种特殊物品，可以在制作过程中使用来改变装备的能力。它非常微妙，因此结果有时可能会令人失望，但如果处理得当，它可能会产生超出您预期的结果。

column1: If you'd like to test the limits of your woodworking skills, I highly recommend giving it a try. Please keep striving forward!
column2: 如果您想测试自己的木工技能极限，我强烈建议您尝试一下。请继续努力前进！

column1: It looks like you haven't gathered the material I asked for. Show me what you can do!
column2: 看起来你还没有收集到我要的材料。告诉我你能做什么！

column2: 看起来你还没有打败我提到的所有怪物。告诉我你能做什么！

column1: Vicious, the carpenter of Henesys, received an important request but is struggling due to a lack of materials. To help him out, I need to defeat Axe Stumps and craft one Processed Wood.
column2: 看来射手村的木匠维西需要帮助。也许过一阵子我该去看看他。射手村的木匠维西接到了一项重要委托，但因缺少材料而困扰。为了帮他，我需要打倒斧木妖，并制作一个加工木材。你安全交付了维西要求的道具。到这个程度，我应该算是合格的学徒了。

column1: Perfect timing. Athena Pierce of Henesys mentioned she received a request from Perion for a special item. I'm afraid I can't finish it in time on my own. Would you be able to help me?
column2: 完美的时机。 射手村 的 雅典娜·皮尔丝 提到她收到了 勇士部落 的特殊物品请求。恐怕我一个人无法及时完成它。你能帮我吗？

column1: Thank you! What I need is Processed Wood . It seems there aren't any carpenters in Perion . You should be able to find Axe Stumps around Perion , so it shouldn't be too difficult. I'll be looking forward to it.
column2: 谢谢！我需要的是加工木材。勇士部落似乎没有木匠。你应该能够在 勇士部落 周围找到斧头树桩，所以这应该不会太困难。我会很期待的。

column1: You haven't forgotten that I'm your mentor... have you?
column2: 你没有忘记我是你的导师……是吗？

column1: Great! This is exactly what I needed. I'm really glad I asked you for help.
column2: 太棒了！这正是我所需要的。我真的很高兴向你寻求帮助。

column1: Here, as a reward, please take this Woodcrafting Kit . Using it should make training your woodworking skills a bit easier.
column2: 在这里，作为奖励，请收下这个木工套件。使用它应该会让你的木工技能训练变得更容易一些。

column1: But this is a bit of a problem... I have a feeling Athena Pierce will keep sending me requests like this. It seems I may be relying on your help even more. I'll ask you again next time!
column2: 但这是有点问题……我有一种感觉，赫丽娜会继续向我发送这样的请求。看来我可能更加依赖你的帮助了。下次我再问你！

column1: It looks like you don't have the material I asked for. We're short on time, so please hurry!
column2: 您似乎没有我要的材料。我们时间有限，所以请快点！

column1: It looks like you haven't defeated all the monsters I mentioned. We're short on time, so please hurry!
column2: 看起来你还没有打败我提到的所有怪物。我们时间有限，所以请快点！

column1: The leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City gave me a test to see if I’m worthy of becoming a partner. He said that proper strength and knowledge are required for leatherworking, and asked me to defeat monsters around Kerning City and Henesys to collect Leather.
column2: 废弃都市的皮革工艺大师街头的 JM 似乎正在寻找能成为生意伙伴的人。废弃都市的皮革工艺大师街头的 JM 给了我一项测试，看看我是否有资格成为伙伴。他说皮革制作需要足够的力量和知识，并让我打倒废弃都市和射手村周围的怪物，收集皮革。你通过了废弃都市皮革工艺大师街头的 JM 给出的测试。这是否意味着我也能在冒险岛世界堂堂正正地成为皮革工匠？

column1: All kinds of rare goods change hands in Kerning City's black market. And when it comes to the stuff I make myself? Yeah, no need to even say how popular THOSE are. And now feels like the perfect time to expand the business... Hey. You ever think about becoming a leatherworker?
column2: 各种稀有物品在废弃都市的黑市上易手。当谈到我自己做的东西时？是的，甚至不用说那些有多受欢迎。现在感觉是扩展业务的最佳时机......嘿。您有没有想过成为一名皮革工匠？

column1: What, you don't even know what a leatherworker is? Guess I'm dealing with an amateur. Fine. A leatherworker is someone who works with leather and crafts all kinds of leather armor and goods . If you lend me a hand, my business could really take off. So, what do you say?
column2: 什么，你连皮匠是什么都不知道吗？我猜我正在和一个业余爱好者打交道。美好的。皮革工匠是指从事皮革工作并制作各种皮革盔甲和物品的人。如果你帮我一把，我的生意就能真正腾飞。那么，你说呢？

column1: Heh, I like people who make quick decisions. Still, I gotta make sure you're actually cut out for this kind of work.
column2: 呵呵，我喜欢快速做出决定的人。尽管如此，我还是要确保你确实适合这种工作。

column1: Being a leatherworker isn't just about technique. You need strength and know-how, too. Understanding materials, knowing where they come from, and having the muscle to get them. Take down Pigs around Kerning City or Henesys , and bring me 5 pieces of Leather . Then we'll talk business.
column2: 成为一名皮革工匠不仅仅需要技术。您还需要力量和专业知识。了解材料，知道它们来自哪里，并有能力获取它们。干掉废弃都市或 射手村 周围的猪，给我带来 5 块皮革。然后我们就谈生意。

column1: Looks like you're busy right now. Well, getting strong in Maple World isn't just about beating monsters, you know. In the back alleys, money is power. If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
column2: 看来你现在很忙。好吧，你知道，在枫叶世界中变强不仅仅是打败怪物。在后巷，金钱就是力量。如果你改变主意，你知道在哪里可以找到我。

column1: Huh. Looks like you took care of the monsters and gathered the materials just fine. Yeah... I guess you might be worth doing business with after all.
column2: 呵呵。看来你对付怪物和收集材料都做得很好。是的...我想你可能还是值得和你做生意的。

column1: All right. From now on, I recognize you as a leatherworker. I've added a few leatherworking skills to your Crafting Journal , so go check them out.
column2: 好吧。从现在开始，我认你是皮匠了。我在你的手工艺日志中添加了一些皮革加工技能，所以去看看吧。

column1: And honestly, those materials? I had you collect them for yourself. Try using them to craft a few items. Just remember, if you want to do some leatherworking, you'll need the Leatherworking Station right next to me.
column2: 老实说，那些材料？我让你自己收集它们。尝试用它们来制作一些物品。请记住，如果您想做一些皮革加工，您需要我旁边的皮革加工站。

column1: As you craft items using your leatherworking skills, you'll gain experience and level up, letting you make more advanced goods. But if you really want to push leatherworking to its limits, your adventurer level needs to be high enough too. Can't afford to slack on either one.
column2: 当您使用皮革加工技能制作物品时，您将获得经验并升级，从而可以制作更高级的物品。但如果你真的想将制皮发挥到极致，你的冒险家等级也需要足够高。任何一方都不能懈怠。

column1: That's all I can teach you for now. You've still got a long road ahead, but don't worry. Keep sharpening your skills, and we'll be rolling in money someday. If you've got questions, come see me anytime.
column2: 目前我能教你的就是这些。你前面的路还很长，但别担心。不断提高你的技能，总有一天我们会赚到钱。如果您有疑问，请随时来找我。

column1: Looks like you didn't manage to gather all the materials I asked for. Yeah... Doing business together might've been a mistake.
column2: 看来你没能收集到我要求的所有材料。是的...一起做生意可能是一个错误。

column1: Rumors that you've become a proper leatherworker have reached even the back alleys of Kerning City . Got me curious whether they're actually true. From the looks of it, you've built up some skill and experience... but are you really better than me? Let's see what you've got.
column2: 关于你已经成为一名合格的皮革工匠的谣言甚至已经传到了废弃都市的后巷。让我很好奇它们是否真的。看起来，你已经积累了一些技巧和经验……但是你真的比我强吗？让我们看看你有什么。

column1: Tch, pretty confident, aren't you? Fine. Then go take down Wild Boars near Perion and bring me 1 Red Chair . I'll be waiting. Heh.
column2: 切，你很有信心，不是吗？美好的。然后去拿下佩里安附近的野猪队，给我带一张红椅子。我会等待。呵呵...

column1: Looks like you haven't reached that level yet. And you expect me to call you my partner like this?
column2: 看来你还没有达到那个水平。你还指望我这样称呼你为我的搭档？

column1: Let's take a look... Huh. This isn't bad at all. Tch--fine, I'll admit it. This is solid work. I'm honestly surprised you've built up this much skill. Yeah, this is good enough to call you a real leatherworker. All right, you've earned my respect. Guess I should give you something special.
column2: 我们来看看吧……呵呵。这一点也不坏。切——好吧，我承认。这是一项扎实的工作。老实说，我很惊讶你已经掌握了这么多技能。是的，这足以称你为真正的皮革工匠。好吧，你已经赢得了我的尊重。我想我应该给你一些特别的东西......

column2: 这种防具制作催化剂是一种特殊物品，可以在制作过程中使用来改变装备的属性。它非常不稳定，所以有时结果可能会令人失望——但如果处理得当，最终可能会得到超出预期的结果。

column1: If you really want to test the limits of your leatherworking skills, I'd say give it a try. Heh... and don't get lazy with your training.
