column2: 不错！这正是我所需要的。很高兴我请你来处理它。

column1: Here, this is for you. I'll give you a Leatherworking Kit . Use it and training your leatherworking skills should go a lot smoother.
column2: 在这里，这是给你的。我会给你一个制皮工具包。使用它并训练你的制皮技能应该会顺利很多。

column1: Though... this could be troublesome. Feels like Dark Lord is going to keep sending requests like this. Looks like I might be needing your help more often. Guess I'll see you again soon. Heh.
column2: 虽然……这可能会很麻烦。感觉黑魔王会继续发送这样的请求。看来我可能更需要你的帮助。我想我很快就会再次见到你。呵呵...

column1: Looks like you didn't manage to gather all the materials I asked for. Are you really taking our business seriously?
column2: 看来你没能收集到我要求的所有材料。您真的认真对待我们的生意吗？

column1: Looks like you didn't take down all the monsters I mentioned. Are you really taking our business seriously?
column2: 看起来你并没有消灭我提到的所有怪物。您真的认真对待我们的生意吗？

column1: The Arcforger master Chrishrama of Sleepywood gave me a test when I asked to become his apprentice. He said true Arcforgers must possess great wisdom, and instructed me to defeat monsters around Sleepywood and gather a Garnet Ore.
column2: 林中之城的秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛似乎正在寻找能成为他学徒的人。当我请求成为学徒时，林中之城的秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛给了我一项测试。他说真正的秘法锻造师必须拥有高深的智慧，并让我打倒林中之城周围的怪物，收集石榴石母矿。你通过了林中之城秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛给出的测试。这是否意味着我终于能在冒险岛世界成为真正的秘法锻造师？

column1: Have you ever laid eyes upon an item infused with true arcane power? Dangerous, yes, but its mystery calls to those who seek truth. There is no need to fear it; anyone who walks the path of understanding will feel that pull. Tell me, traveler... would you walk the path of Arcforge with me?
column2: 您是否曾见过一件充满真正奥术力量的物品？是的，危险，但它的神秘召唤着那些寻求真相的人。没有必要害怕它；任何走在理解之路上的人都会感受到这种拉力。告诉我，旅行者……你愿意和我一起走在 Arcforge 的路上吗？

column1: It seems you have never heard of Arcforging before, and that is only natural--this craft has long been guarded in secrecy. An Arcforger is one who works with gemstones, the crystallized essence of countless forces, and crafts not only equipment infused with magic, but also scrolls that grant special abilities to gear . It is a path that demands both wisdom and skill. Tell me... Does this interest you?
column2: 看来你以前从未听说过电弧铸造，这很自然——这种工艺长期以来一直处于保密状态。电弧锻造者使用宝石（无数力量的结晶精华）进行工作，不仅制作充满魔法的装备，还制作赋予装备特殊能力的卷轴。这是一条既需要智慧又需要技巧的道路。告诉我...你对此感兴趣吗？

column1: Good. In truth, I have hoped someone with a pure heart and earnest passion would inherit this craft. However, passion alone cannot guarantee success. Before all else, I must see whether you are truly suited for this path.
column2: 很好。其实我很希望有一个心地纯洁、热忱的人能够继承这门手艺。然而，仅凭热情并不能保证成功。首先，我得看看你是否真的适合这条路。

column1: To become an Arcforger, one must possess wisdom befitting the craft. You must learn to see through the forces of nature and handle them with respect. Go, defeat Dark Stumps near Sleepywood and bring back 1 Garnet Ore . Do this, and I shall acknowledge your potential.
column2: 要成为一名电弧锻造者，必须拥有适合该技艺的智慧。你必须学会​​看穿自然的力量并尊重它们。去，击败林中之城附近的黑暗树桩，并带回 1 个石榴石矿石。做到这一点，我就会承认你的潜力。

column1: Ah, so now is not the time for you. That is fine. Strength in Maple World is not earned by slaying monsters alone. At times, wisdom proves mightier than raw power. Return to me whenever your heart guides you.
column2: 啊，所以现在不是你的时候。那很好。枫叶世界中的力量并不是仅靠杀死怪物就能获得的。有时，智慧比原始力量更强大。每当你的心指引你时，就回到我身边。

column1: It seems you have defeated the monsters and collected the material I asked for. As I suspected—you possess the spark needed to walk this path.
column2: 看来你已经打败了怪物并收集了我要的材料。正如我所怀疑的那样——你拥有走这条路所需的火花。

column1: From this moment on, you are recognized as an Arcforger under my tutelage. I have inscribed several Arcforging techniques into your Crafting Journal --examine them well.
column2: 从这一刻起，你就被认可为我指导下的电弧锻造者了。我已将几种电弧锻造技术写入您的工艺日志中——仔细检查它们。

column1: And, truth be told, those materials were meant for you to use. Try crafting a few items with them. Remember, however, that you will need the Arcane Station beside me to perform proper Arcforging.
column2: 而且，说实话，这些材料是供您使用的。尝试用它们制作一些物品。但请记住，你需要我旁边的奥术站才能进行适当的电弧锻造。

column1: As you continue crafting through Arcforging, you will gain experience and rise in skill, allowing you to create increasingly wondrous things. But know this--if you wish to reach the highest level of Arcforging, your own adventurer level must rise as well. Neglect neither path.
column2: 当你继续通过 Arcforging 进行制作时，你将获得经验并提高技能，让你能够创造出越来越奇妙的东西。但要知道这一点——如果你想达到电弧锻造的最高等级，你自己的冒险者等级也必须提高。两条路都不要忽视。

column1: That is all I can teach you for now. Your journey will be long, but do not fear. So long as you refine your craft with patience, deeper wisdom will reveal itself to you. If you ever have questions, return to me.
column2: 目前我能教你的就是这些。你的旅程将很漫长，但不要害怕。只要你耐心地完善你的技艺，更深层次的智慧就会向你展现。如果您有任何疑问，请回复我。

column1: It appears you did not gather the material I asked for... Perhaps I was mistaken about you.
column2: 看来你没有收集到我要求的材料……也许我误会了你。

column1: It seems you have not defeated the monsters I mentioned. Perhaps... I misjudged your resolve.
column2: 看来你还没有打败我提到的那些怪物。也许……我误判了你的决心。

column1: The Arcforger master Chrishrama of Sleepywood was impressed with my growth and challenged me to prove my skill. I must defeat Horny Mushrooms and craft 1 Topaz to bring back.
column2: 看来林中之城的秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛终于准备认可我的秘法锻造技术了。林中之城的秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛对我的成长印象深刻，并挑战我证明自己的技术。我必须打倒刺蘑菇，并制作 1 个黄晶带回去。林中之城的秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛惊叹于我的手艺，并交给我一个卷轴制作促进剂。它似乎是一种特殊道具，可以在制作时创造出更强的卷轴。要不要试试看？

column1: I have heard whispers here in Sleepywood that you have become a true Arcforger. It stirred my curiosity, and now I wish to see the truth with my own eyes. I see honesty in them... but, can you prove your mastery to me?
column2: 我在沉睡林听到了一些传言，说你已经成为一名真正的电弧锻造者。这激起了我的好奇心，现在我想亲眼看看真相。我在他们身上看到了诚实……但是，你能向我证明你的精通吗？

column1: Excellent—your spirit remains passionate as ever. Go to the outskirts of Sleepywood , defeat Horny Mushrooms , and craft 1 Topaz to bring back to me. I shall wait here.
column2: 太棒了——你的精神一如既往地充满激情。前往林中之城的郊区，击败角质蘑菇，并制作 1 颗黄玉带回给我。我就在这里等吧。

column1: Ah... It seems your mind is not yet prepared.
column2: 啊……看来你的思想还没有准备好。

column1: Now then... let me see. Ho... This Topaz is crafted with remarkable precision and beauty. In some ways, it may even surpass my own work. You have earned my admiration, so I must give you a gift worthy of your achievement.
column2: 那么现在……让我看看。嗬……这颗托帕石的制作工艺极其精准且美丽。在某些方面，它甚至可能超越我自己的工作。你赢得了我的钦佩，所以我必须送给你一份与你的成就相称的礼物。

column1: This Scroll Crafting Catalyst is a special item. When used in the making of scrolls, it can produce scrolls far more powerful than ordinary ones. But be warned: such power is unstable--while the effects grow stronger, the chance of success falls. A path of risk and reward.
column2: 这个卷轴制作催化剂是一个特殊的物品。用于制作卷轴时，可以制作出远比普通卷轴威力更强的卷轴。但请注意：这种力量是不稳定的——当效果越来越强时，成功的机会就会下降。一条风险与回报并存的道路。

column1: If you wish to test the limits of your Arcforging skill, I encourage you to use it. Continue your training with dedication, and your wisdom will deepen.
column2: 如果你想测试你的电弧锻造技能的极限，我鼓励你使用它。继续精进修行，你的智慧就会加深。

column1: It seems you do not have the material I requested. Perhaps your training is still lacking.
column2: 您似乎没有我要求的材料。也许你的训练还不够......

column1: It appears you did not defeat all the monsters I spoke of. Perhaps your training is still lacking.
column2: 看来你并没有打败我所说的所有怪物。也许你的训练还不够......

column1: The Arcforger master Chrishrama of Sleepywood has received an important research request, but he is struggling due to a lack of materials. To help him, I’ll need to defeat Green Mushrooms and gather 10 Fragment of Magic.
column2: 林中之城的秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛似乎需要帮助。也许我应该再去拜访他。林中之城的秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛接到了一项重要研究委托，但因材料不足而陷入困境。为了帮他，我需要打倒绿蘑菇，并收集 10 个魔法碎片。你安全交付了林中之城秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛要求的道具。这是否意味着我现在可以被称为他的学徒了？

column1: Ah, you have arrived at just the right moment. I am developing a new scroll, yet I find myself lacking the materials needed for my research. Might you lend me your strength?
column2: 啊，你来得正是时候。我正在开发一个新的卷轴，但我发现自己缺乏研究所需的材料。你可以借给我你的力量吗？

column1: My thanks. What I require are Fragment of Magic pieces. It carries a mysterious power, though it is difficult to handle--so for research of this scale, I need quite a large amount. Please, make haste.
column2: 我的谢谢。我需要的是魔法碎片。它蕴含着神秘的力量，虽然很难驾驭——所以要进行这种规模的研究，我需要相当多的量。请抓紧时间。

column1: Hm... I had hoped you would understand why I devote myself so deeply to this research.
column2: 嗯……我本来希望你能理解我为什么如此投入这项研究……

column1: Excellent. With this much, I believe I can continue my studies for some time. Your aid has been invaluable.
column2: 太棒了。有了这些，我相信我可以继续学习一段时间了。您的帮助是无价的。

column1: I cannot allow such effort to go unrewarded. Please, take this Arcforging Kit . With it, you may find the path of Arcforge training a little easier.
column2: 我不能让这样的努力没有回报。请收下这个电弧锻造套件。有了它，你可能会发现 Arcforge 的训练之路变得更加轻松。

column1: Yet this is troubling... It seems far more Fragment of Magic pieces will be required for this study than I first predicted. I suspect I will be calling on your help again. Until then, travel safely.
column2: 然而这令人不安……看来这项研究需要的魔法碎片比我最初预测的要多得多。我怀疑我会再次寻求你的帮助。在那之前，请安全出行。

column1: It seems you have not gathered all the materials I asked for. At this rate, I cannot complete my research.
column2: 看来你还没有收集到我要求的所有材料。按照这个速度，我无法完成我的研究。

column1: It appears you have not defeated all the monsters I mentioned. At this rate, I cannot complete my research.
column2: 看来你还没有打败我提到的所有怪物。按照这个速度，我无法完成我的研究。

column1: Let's take the i4031080# Strange Mushroom Spore given by Arwen the Fairy to Grendel the Really Old for analysis. Then talk to Arwen the Fairy again.
column2: 去魔法密林找妖精艾温。她似乎有事要拜托我。把妖精艾温交给你的奇怪蘑菇孢子带给汉斯进行分析，然后再和妖精艾温说话。你把汉斯对奇怪蘑菇孢子的分析结果告诉了妖精艾温。
